jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1750174
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Being part of EY in Greece means being part of a continuously growing team, which has been announced as Top Employer for the fourth consecutive year, certified as a Great Place to Work for the third year in a row, and awarded as Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting for the second consecutive time, for our almost 3,000 professionals!
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences through coaching and training programs as well as the use of advanced technology and AI. We’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams
Join us as we commemorate 100 years of EY in Greece this year. Experience great flexibility under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, Thessaloniki and Crete and contribute to building a better working world.
The opportunity
In consulting, change is the only constant, and we like it that way. Our clients face constant disruption from AI and automation, shifting regulations and rising customer expectations. They count on us to turn that complexity into an advantage.
As a Business Transformation Consultant, you'll join the local market leader in Consulting and work in diverse, high-performing teams on projects for major organizations in Greece and abroad. You'll help clients rethink how work gets done: redesigning processes end to end, building operating models that last and putting AI agents, automation and data to work where they create real value.
From your first project, you'll learn by doing, with real responsibility, coaching from experienced practitioners and the backing of a global network. You'll also help shape where our business goes next. If you want to build a career that makes a measurable difference, this is where it starts.
Your key responsibilities
In this high-visibility role as a Business Transformation Consultant, you will participate in challenging global, regional and local projects and are expected to:
- Uncover the real problem: Take part in client workshops and interviews. Gather information, understand pain points and find improvement opportunities, spotting the real root causes behind the obvious symptoms.
- Map, measure and redesign: Analyze, improve and document end-to-end business processes and operating models, using data, best-practice frameworks and structured problem-solving. Measure performance with KPIs and data. Design leaner, more automated and better-controlled ways of working.
- Harness technology: Help assess where AI, automation, process mining and analytics can remove waste and friction, improve decisions, strengthen control and create measurable value.
- Create and deliver: Turn analysis into clear, high-quality deliverables such as process maps, assessments, target operating models, business cases, roadmaps and executive presentations.
- Grow the business: Contribute to business development, including proposals, market research, thought leadership and new service offerings to help us stay ahead of what clients will need next.
- Build something new: Help evolve our methods, accelerators and toolkits as we grow.
- Invest in yourself: Maintain a continuous desire to learn, build your professional toolkit through formal training, certifications and on-the-job coaching, and share what you learn with your team.
To qualify for the role you must have
- A university degree in engineering, business, economics, finance, mathematics, physics, computer science or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and comfort working with numbers, data and ambiguity
- Practical experience using generative AI tools to work smarter (e.g., Microsoft Copilot)
- Ability to build clear analyses and communicate them visually
- Excellent written and verbal communication in Greek and English
- Willingness to travel and work abroad when projects require it
Ideally, you’ll also
While not required, any of the following will be regarded positively:
- A Master's degree or MBA, particularly in operations, management, engineering, business, analytics, computer science or a related field
- Internship or early-career experience (up to 2 years) in consulting, professional services or a transformation, operations or process excellence role/ project
- Lean and/or Six Sigma certification (Yellow or Green Belt), or practical exposure to continuous improvement methods
- Familiarity with process modeling and mining, and with relevant tools (e.g. SAP Signavio, ARIS, Celonis, Visio)
- Data and analytics skills, such as Power BI, SQL, Python or low-code and automation platforms (e.g., Power Automate)
- Exposure to Agile ways of working or project management basics (e.g., Scrum, PRINCE2 or CAPM foundation)
- Understanding of how a company's processes connect end to end (e.g., procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, record-to-report), including awareness of internal controls and risk.
Skills & attributes for success
- Curiosity, ambition and drive: You ask "why?" often, set yourself high goals, stay motivated to grow with every project and you're always learning something new.
- A team player mindset: You do your best work in diverse teams, share knowledge freely and build trust with clients and colleagues.
- Ownership: You take responsibility for your work, meet your commitments and speak up with ideas.
- Execution discipline: You manage your time and competing priorities well and deliver high-quality work at pace.
- Structured thinking with a practical mindset: You bring order to messy problems and focus on what will make a real difference.
- Attention to detail without losing sight of the big picture: You can map a process step by step and still explain why it matters to the CEO.
- Clear communication and storytelling: You communicate with clarity and respect, and turn complex analysis into concise, compelling messages.
- Resilience and adaptability: You handle tight deadlines, changing priorities and setbacks well and you see ambiguity as an opportunity
- Integrity: You act ethically and build trust by doing the right thing.
- Creativity and innovation: You look beyond "how it's always been done," come up with fresh ideas and are willing to test new approaches and technologies.
- Passion for making things better: You’re passionate about achieving excellence and continuous improvement and energized by using technology to create lasting business value.
What we offer you
Ability to Shape your Future with Confidence by:
- Developing your professional growth:
- You'll have unlimited access to educational platforms, EY Badges and EY Degrees, alongside support for certifications. You will experience personalized coaching and feedback, and gain exposure to international projects, through our expansive global network, empowering you to define and achieve your own success.
- Dive into our innovative GenAI ecosystem, designed to enhance your EY journey and support your career growth. These advanced AI tools will empower you to focus on higher-value work and meaningful interactions, enriching your professional experience like never before.
- Empowering your personal fulfilment: We focus on your financial, social, mental and physical wellbeing.
- Our competitive rewards package, depending on your experience, includes cutting-edge technological equipment, ticket restaurant vouchers, a private health and life insurance scheme, income protection and an exclusive EY benefits club card that provides a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions.
- Our flexible working arrangement (hybrid model) is defined based on your own preferences and team’s needs, and we enjoy other initiatives such as summer short Fridays and an EY Day Off.
- Our commitment to a sustainable way of operating, encourages volunteerism, promotes sustainable practices and offers opportunities for you to create a positive societal impact.
- Our pride lies in working at EY as one of the most recognized employers in Greece through our multiple awards received over the last 3 years (Top Employer, Great Place to Work and Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting).
- Fueling an inclusive culture: We prioritize a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment, where you’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
EY  |  Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1722031
Confidence in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.
At EY, you can be sure that you’re making a difference – for your client, for society, for your colleagues and for your own development. At the same time, you’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize, broaden your expertise or grow into leadership, you’re in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field.
EY-Parthenon supports companies in making investments for organic or acquisitive growth and improvements. This includes strategy development, operational transformations, restructurings, and guiding IPOs, mergers, and acquisitions. By combining the broad knowledge and experience within our team with analytical tools and techniques, and working closely with the global EY-Parthenon network, we help clients make well-informed decisions. We then assist organizations in turning strategy, transactions, or transformations into reality. Our team culture is built on training, entrepreneurship, and creative freedom.
Your new job | About your main responsibilities
As a senior consultant, you’ll be part of the EY-Parthenon Strategy & Execution team, with a focus on People Strategy. Your focus is on advising and supporting clients throughout the entire deal life cycle, providing a range of People and HR-related services on both the sell-side and buy-side. We contribute to and validate the deal price pre-deal and assist in realizing deal synergies post-deal.
You will contribute to the following activities:
- Complex HR due diligence, day-one readiness, post-merger integration, carve-outs, and post-deal value creation such as strategic workforce planning, organization design, employee relations planning and execution, and culture, communication &change initiatives.
- Supporting clients in planning and implementing People and HR elements for organizational restructuring programs at both strategic and operational levels.
- Addressing People and HR-related matters through all stages of acquisition, divestiture, and merger, including pre- and post-deal.
- Writing and reviewing reports, project planning, data analysis, and developing presentation materials. Additionally, analyzing (financial) data and presenting high-quality, risk-managed reports, including client and executive presentations.
- Structuring and managing (international) projects that meet and exceed client expectations, while confidently and effectively recognizing and managing potential issues during client assignments.
Your new team | About your colleagues and the office
Your team
The People Strategy and M&A team works with clients to manage their employee capital agenda to drive competitive advantage and increase returns on investments. As part of a global team of professionals in 100 countries, you will advise clients on preserving, optimizing, raising, or investing capital.
Your office: Amsterdam
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.
Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution
A background in Finance is not required, but affinity with this discipline and familiarity with financial terminology is important. We invite recent graduates with a Master’s degree from a Dutch university in: Strategy, Business Administration, Finance, Organizational Studies, Econometrics, HRM, or similar to apply.
- Experience in advising clients on a range of transactions and restructurings, ideally in People topics, is a plus.
- In addition to your studies, you have developed yourself in various ways, such as through a relevant internship, a board year, or other extracurricular activities.
- You have strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and are highly proficient in both Dutch and English, spoken and written.
- You have a strong and demonstrable affinity with People and HR topics, strategy development, and mergers & acquisitions in a broad sense.
- You are highly experienced with Microsoft Office and Excel. If required, you already hold a valid work permit.
Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment
- A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).
- You’ll receive a contract for 40 hours.
- A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.
- 29 vacation days to recharge and unwind, plus the option to buy extra days.
- With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.
- At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.
- The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.
- The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.
- You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.
- Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.
- A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.
All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click here.
Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process
1. For this vacancy, we ask you to upload a motivation letter along with your CV. This gives you the opportunity to show us your drive, motivation, and personality. At EY, we support the use of AI tools like ChatGPT, as long as your own tone and unique personality remain visible.
2. Our first contact: After your application, our recruiter will call you within 5 days for a short introduction. We’ll explore whether the role could be a good match.
3. First interview: Before the interview, we’ll ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We’ll discuss the results during the interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have.
4. Second interview: If we see a match and you’re still enthusiastic, we’ll invite you for a second interview. We’ll dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics. Sometimes, a business case is part of the process. A final interview may also follow.
5. We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY!

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1733194
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity
EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.
With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.
Within EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution sub service line, the Value Creation practice helps PE firms, their portfolio companies, and corporate companies realize better returns by unlocking value and accelerating time to money through targeted operational improvements. We rapidly define, quantify, and help realize significant incremental and sustainable value through revenue enhancement, cost and margin improvement and working capital reduction.
Our Media Value Creation team works with investors and executives across Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, and Audience Monetization to identify, quantify, and realize value creation opportunities.
We help clients unlock value through commercial excellence, go-to-market transformation, revenue growth, pricing and monetization optimization, audience and customer expansion, operating model improvements, and transaction-related value creation initiatives. Our teams work across the transaction lifecycle and beyond, supporting management teams as they execute strategies designed to drive measurable EBITDA growth, accelerate revenue performance, and create long-term enterprise value.
Your key responsibilities
As a Senior Associate-Consultant in EY-Parthenon’s Strategy and Execution Value Creation practice, you will be a vital member of the team executing operational focused projects. You will work on projects that span the entire lifecycle of a transaction, including operational and commercial due diligence where we focus on EBITDA upside and operational risk; buy side carve out and integration planning to ensure a newly spun out business can stand alone and a merger quickly realize and grow anticipated synergies; post-acquisition 100 day and value creation planning; ongoing performance improvement; and exit readiness planning to inform an optimal strategy for maximizing returns and ensuring the buyer is well positioned to continue to enhance value.
You will also contribute to commercial value creation initiatives for Media investors and management teams across subscription, advertising, sponsorship, ticketing, content monetization, rights and licensing, distribution, and audience engagement revenue streams.
Skills and attributes for success
- Media Industry Knowledge – interest in Media and an understanding of relevant business models, value drivers, growth opportunities, and competitive dynamics across Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, and Audience Monetization.
- Project Management – be part of project teams comprising colleagues from across the Strategy and Transactions sub service lines.
- Business and Commercially Driven – working in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients.
- Business Development – assist in aspects of pursuits, including presentations and client meetings. Contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work.
- Learning – learn and develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and experiences.
- Building Relationships – strong working relationships with senior clients, including influence, advice and support to key decision makers.
- The expectation for this role is in person teaming, at client site or in an EY office, a minimum of 60% of the time or on average 3 days a week over the course of an engagement, project or performance year.
To qualify for the role, you must have
- A bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Marketing, Media Studies, Communications, Sports Management, or Entertainment Management and 2 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 18 months of related work experience.
- Strategy and operations management consulting experience.
- Excellent analytical, problem solving/modeling skills, and the confidence to translate complex data into meaningful insights.
- Experience in operational or commercial due diligence, operational restructuring, value creation, and performance improvement.
- Experience in business integrations, divestitures, and/or carve-outs with a demonstrated aptitude for quantitative and qualitative analysis.
- Experience supporting value creation, commercial transformation, go-to-market, revenue growth, pricing, monetization, or performance improvement initiatives.
- Understanding of financial statements and operational performance metrics, including the relationship between commercial initiatives, EBITDA improvement, and enterprise value.
- Experience working in complex business environments.
- The ability to prioritize effectively on projects and the skills to adapt quickly to new challenges and concepts.
- Excellent communication and influencing skills, and the ability to develop long-lasting relationships both internally and externally.
- You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
- The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.
Ideally, you will have
- Experience working with, advising, or conducting strategic or commercial analysis of one or more of the following Media sub-sectors: Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, Audience Monetization, or related Media sectors.
- Understanding of Media business models and value drivers, including subscription, advertising, sponsorship, content monetization, ticketing, rights and licensing, audience engagement, and distribution economics.
- Experience conducting analyses related to audience acquisition, customer retention, pricing, advertising, sponsorship, subscription growth, content commercialization, rights and licensing, ticketing, or distribution.
- Experience supporting go-to-market strategy, revenue operations, sales effectiveness, marketing effectiveness, pricing, customer acquisition, or commercial operating model initiatives.
- Experience evaluating and quantifying value creation opportunities through transaction-related, commercial transformation, or performance improvement initiatives.

- A proven record of excellence in a transactions, strategy, commercial, or analytical role.
- Experience gained within a Media company, investment organization, corporate strategy function, or large professional services organization.

- Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1687136
Les services financiers chez EY, c’est une organisation unique parmi les Big four : 1200 personnes dédiées à la banque, l’assurance, la gestion d’actif, les paiements, le private equity, etc. pour des grands groupes internationaux comme des fintech en mode start-up. Nous sommes la plus grande équipe dédiée au secteur financier sur le marché français répartie à travers les métiers du conseil, de l’audit, des transactions, de la fiscalité et du droit. Les carrières au sein des services financiers passent par différents métiers et nous valorisons particulièrement les échanges dans nos bureaux à l’étranger dans les plus grandes places financières mondiales.
Pourquoi pas vous ?
EY-Parthenon est un cabinet de conseil en stratégie de premier plan, accompagnant ses clients à la fois sur des missions de corporate strategy (plan stratégique, value creation…) et de stratégie liée aux transactions (Due diligences, post merger integration…).
EY-Parthenon regroupe plus de 7000 consultants dans le monde dont plus de 200 au sein du bureau de Paris. L’équipe EY-Parthenon Financial Services accompagne les institutions financières (banques, assurances, sociétés de gestions, etc.) ainsi que les fonds de Private Equity et les FinTech/AssurTech.
Nous poursuivons notre très forte croissance et recherchons pour notre bureau de Paris, des consultants expérimentés (grade senior consultant, case team leader et manager) H/F pour intervenir sur des missions auprès de clients d'envergure internationale.
Vos missions
Dans une équipe diverse et à taille humaine, vous participez à l’ensemble du processus de réflexion stratégique se situant en amont (due diligence stratégique, stratégie d’entrée, revue d’activités, etc.) et en aval (intégration, fusion, séparation) des transactions pour nos clients (directions générales, fonds d’investissements…)
Vous participez / pilotez des missions à forts enjeux et au plus haut niveau avec des équipes alliant expertise sectorielle et compétences en stratégie.
Notre choix de traiter en priorité des problématiques de stratégie vous permet d'avoir un impact fort sur les décisions des dirigeants et les résultats de nos clients.
Au sein de l'équipe, vous contribuez à la gestion et au développement du cabinet, vous donnant ainsi la possibilité de développer votre esprit entrepreneurial.
En intégrant l’équipe, vous bénéficiez de nombreuses formations techniques et méthodologiques (métiers du conseil en stratégie) ainsi que d’un cursus lié au développement personnel dispensé à l'ensemble des collaborateurs du cabinet.
Votre profil
Diplômé(e) d'une grande école de commerce ou d'ingénieur de premier rang, vous bénéficiez d’une expérience confirmée en conseil en stratégie, private equity, corporate finance ou au sein d’un département stratégie d’une institution financière de premier plan.
Doté d'un excellent sens relationnel, vous faites preuve de très bonnes capacités de structuration, analytiques et créatives.
Vous bénéficiez d’un fort esprit d'équipe, de leadership et on vous reconnait d’excellentes capacités à apporter de la valeur ajoutée à vos clients. Vous parlez couramment anglais.
Nous recherchons des candidats ayant un minimum de 3 ans d’expérience dans le milieu du conseil en stratégie, et/ou au sein d’institutions financières.
Notre équipe est en forte croissance et offre des possibilités d’évolution très attractives, alors rejoignez-nous !
A propos d’EY :
EY incarne à la fois des expertises, de l’innovation, de la confiance, de la transformation, des nouvelles technologies et des missions passionnantes.
EY c’est l’opportunité de :
- de travailler pour des clients internationaux et leaders dans leurs secteurs, des start-up, ou bien des entreprises familiales à forte valeur ajoutée ;
- d’évoluer au sein d’équipe internationale à taille humaine ;
- de découvrir d’autres cultures et de profiter de notre réseau avec notre programme Mobility4U ;
- de suivre un programme de formation complet et personnalisé. Un mentor vous suivra tout au long de votre carrière chez nous !
- de s’engager à travers nos réseaux internes autour de sujets liés à l’écologie, l’inclusion, l’associatif (Fondation EY), … et de participer à de nombreux événements (prix de l’entrepreneur de l’année, Women In, ...) !
Dans le cadre de sa politique Diversité, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1748092
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Risk Consulting – AI Governance - Senior
The opportunity: your next adventure awaits.
Are you a tech-savvy professional with a risk mindset who is passionate about building a better working world through the power of people, technology, and innovation? We have an incredible opportunity for you to join our dynamic Enterprise Risk team and make a real impact in the rapidly evolving world we live in. Within Risk Consulting, you will focus in the areas of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Risk Management and Governance which would cover AI Auditing techniques, AI Risk and Controls, Pre-Implementation reviews, Data Privacy reviews, AI application security and BCP review of AI Applications.
This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you’ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies.
Key responsibilities
Your key responsibilities will include:
- Consistently deliver quality client services. Drive high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget. Monitor progress manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.
- Foster relationships with client personnel to analyse, evaluate, and enhance information systems to develop and improve security at procedural and technology levels.
- Use knowledge of the current IT environment, AI models and applications and industry trends to identify engagement and client service issues and communicate this information to the engagement team and client management through written correspondence and verbal presentations. Stay abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business.
- Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Demonstrate ability to quickly assimilate to new knowledge.
Skills and attributes for success
- You will leverage your proven track record of technology plus business process internal audit experience and strong personal skills, to effectively deliver quality results in the assessment, design, and support implementation of AI Risk solutions
To qualify for the role, you must have
- A bachelor’s or master’s degree and approximately 3-6 years of related work experience
- At least 2-4 years of working experience in Internal audit, risk, compliance for both business and IT audits, with a strong understands of AI related risks and governance practices.
- IT Pre-implementation and Post implementation reviews
- Model Risk Management
- AI Compliance and regulatory assessments – Risk and Controls assessment of AI/ML applications in line with AI related regulations and frameworks
- Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify security findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified on applications and infrastructure. Develop risk control matrix in line with EU AI Act, COBIT, ISO, NIST and ITIL Best Practice and recommendations.
- Control Monitoring / Testing - Understanding of Cyber and compliance standards like PCI, ISO27001, perform test the design and operational effectiveness of the cyber controls.
- Defect / Gap Identification: Identify the confidentiality, integrity and the availability related deficiencies in the client environment and evaluate against industry standards.
- IT Infrastructure and Architecture risk assessments including data quality and data migration reviews, data privacy reviews, OS DB reviews etc.
- Control Automation – Identify controls automation opportunities through analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
- Excellent communication, documentation and report writing skills.
- Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
- Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI Ethics and AI Assurance
- Ability to identify process level risk arising from the use of AI and develop mitigation strategies.
- Good to have relevant industry certifications such as AIGP, ISO 42001, CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)

Job Description & Summary
Contribute to creating a better tomorrow
The only way we can tackle the challenges of this fast-changing world is with passionate people. Led by our purpose of building trust and solving important problems, we come together at PwC to address the biggest issues facing the world in a way that drives positive impact. Are you eager to join a team fueled by open and curious minds? People who are passionate about their work and create new solutions for a new day? Then you’re in the right place.
Bring your talent. Learn new skills. Make a positive impact
PwC Advisory is a network of multiple possibilities - where you want to make an impact is always up to you. Under the expert stewardship of our Advisory experts, you’ll delve into the inner workings of companies to find the best solutions for any challenge they might have.
From the excitement of deals to the complexities of consulting and the fascinating realm of risks and threats in forensics, you’ll help clients nurture trust and maintain their evolutionary edge, today and into the future. Now that’s making a difference.
Do you want to be part of our PwC Pharma & Life Sciences (PLS) team & practice?
PwC is looking for a talented professional with experience in PLS business consultancy to join our PwC Management Consulting department. You will join a team tackling complex challenges spanning clinical development, business operations, quality, and value-based health care. Our strategy is to build trust, deliver sustained outcomes and help clients solve their most important problems by combining human ingenuity and understanding with the right technology. First, you’ll manage R&D or Quality projects at Pharma or Biotech clients, including strategic assessment, developing recommendations and implementation of new operating models. Second, you’ll actively contribute to the development of PwC center of excellence. This means contributing to business development activities including service offering, scanning of the market and account planning, and supporting market development activities including writing thought leadership, point-of-view papers and/or blog posts.
What you’ll learn and do
As a Senior Consultant Research & Development, your main responsibility will be on any or a combination of the following activities:
-
Strategic Advising: Providing strategic advice to pharmaceutical and life sciences companies and the healthcare sector to enhance their R&D, Quality and/or value-based healthcare initiatives. This can involve evaluating current R&D, Quality and/or value-based healthcare practices and recommending improvements.
-
Process Optimization: Identifying inefficiencies in the R&D pipeline and Quality processes and suggesting process improvements to enhance productivity and reduce time-to-market for new drugs and therapies.
-
Technology implementation & innovation Management: Assisting clients by managing their innovation processes through identifying opportunities for drug development and adopting new technologies. This could include implementing efficiencies and enhancing quality processes through technology. As well as, supporting clients by generating insights on ways to improve care pathways and work on enhancing organizational readiness for value-based healthcare.
-
Data Analysis and Insights: Analysing data to provide insights that can drive decision-making in health industry and healthcare projects. This involves leveraging advanced analytics and digital tools.
-
Project Management: Leading and managing projects, ensuring they are delivered on time and within budget while meeting client expectations. Identify and mitigate risks to ensure successful outcomes.
-
Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Facilitating collaboration among various stakeholders, including researchers, healthcare providers and professionals, regulatory bodies, third party payers and authorities, and (other business units in) industry (pharma, medtech, biotech, data/digital), to ensure alignment and successful project outcomes.
-
Change Management: Supporting clients in managing the organizational changes that come with implementing new R&D & Quality strategies or technologies, and transformation efforts towards value-based healthcare principles.
Who you are:
-
Master’s degree in biomedical sciences, (health) economics, (bio-)engineering, business administration, sciences or comparable by experience
-
Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in consultancy and/or the Life Science industry
-
Knowledge of (pre-)clinical regulations as well as quality and risk management.
-
Know-how and interest in trends (science/data/digital) within Life Science & Healthcare industry
-
Ability to combine specialist technical knowledge, strong analytical and problem-solving skills with consulting skills (project management, presentation and communication skills, etc.) while working directly with management and employees on the clients’ premises
-
Fluent in English, and Dutch or French
-
Flexibility to work in different environments and locations and easily acquire new skills and expertise
-
Autonomous and proactive attitude with an entrepreneurship mindset.
Life at PwC Belgium
Our culture and workplace are something we’re proud of. Here’s a sneak peek at what life at PwC looks like:
-
Flexible work patterns: Achieve the perfect balance between office and home life with our flexible hybrid work arrangements and family-friendly schemes.
-
Lifelong learning: Grow with us! Take advantage of our diverse training opportunities and exciting career pathways to explore new disciplines and expertise.
-
Flexible rewards: Tailor your benefits to suit your lifestyle with our customizable rewards plan.
-
Sustainable mobility: Choose eco-friendly mobility options, from our soon-to-be fully electrified fleet to public transport, shared cars, ebikes, and more.
-
Inclusive culture: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive workplace that values and celebrates every individual's contributions.
-
Wellbeing focus: Enjoy a positive environment with our comprehensive wellbeing programs, engaging sports communities, and confidential support for all your professional and personal challenges.
-
Global network: Expand your horizons with opportunities to work abroad and tap into extensive industry expertise within the PwC network.
Let’s build something great together. What are you waiting for?

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all candidates and employees, regardless of race, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation and strengthens our ability to serve our people, clients and communities. Join us in fostering a culture where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to achieve their full potential.

Increasingly severe physical impacts (such as extreme weather events, resource scarcity, and infrastructure damage) combined with accelerating regulatory and market transitions are forcing governments and companies to fundamentally adapt their strategies, moving away from business-as-usual models.
When the financial services industry works well, it creates growth, prosperity, and peace of mind for hundreds of millions of people. No other industry touches so many lives or shapes so many futures. At EY Financial Services, we share a single focus — to build a better financial services industry, not just for now, but for the future.
Sustainability is at the heart of our EY brand. It is at the heart of our strategy, what we value and measure and what we do every day with our clients and within our own business. We are proud to be advocates of change to make businesses across the world more sustainable because we believe in long-term value. Delivering sustainable long-term value in Financial Services means new strategies, a new approach to managing risks, new products and services and new ways of engaging stakeholders.
Opportunity
We are looking for a high performing Consultant to join our Climate Change and Sustainable Services team dedicated to Financial Services. You will join a rapidly growing team of climate change and sustainability practitioners globally, with your base in Zurich, Switzerland, embracing a unique opportunity to make a real difference. You will be working on market leading projects, building networks, and consulting on key strategic issues in sustainable finance.
There is a wide range of exciting projects that you will be able to get involved in, across banking, insurance, pensions, wealth and asset management and private equity. You will work with clients at all levels to deliver first-class services helping them navigate the rapidly evolving sustainability agenda. Topics we cover include:
- Sustainable Finance regulatory developments and requirements by the financial sector from the EU regulatory side (such as CSRD, EU Taxonomy and SFDR) and Swiss regulatory side (such as RBI, FINMA requirements and AMAS, SBA, SIA self-regulations);
- Reporting and disclosure, including the application of ESRS, ISSB, TCFD, GRI, TNFD and other frameworks;
- Sustainable finance and net zero strategies, such as transition plans, for financial services;
- Climate change metrics and targets, greenhouse gas reporting, including the SBTi, Greenhouse Gas Protocol and PCAF;
- Responsible, sustainable and impact investment strategies and implementation;
What We Look For
- You have an agile, growth-oriented mindset. What you know matters. But the right mindset is just as important in determining success. We’re looking for people who are innovative, motivated, committed, can work in an agile way and keep pace with a rapidly changing world.
- You are curious and purpose driven. We’re looking for people who see opportunities instead of challenges, who ask better questions to seek better answers.
- You are inclusive. We’re looking for people who seek out and embrace diverse perspectives, who value differences, and team inclusively to build safety and trust.
Your Key Responsibilities
- Delivery of projects to our clients on a wide range of sustainability topics we work on, such as Regulation implementation, Sustainability Reporting & Assurance engagements for our clients from financial services organizations.
- Create innovative commercial insights for clients, adapt methods and practices to fit operational team and cultural contexts, and contribute to thought leadership.
- Actively contribute to improving operational efficiency on projects and internal initiatives, consistently driving projects to completion making sure that the work delivered is industry leading.
- Working closely with colleagues, create a positive learning culture.
- Contribute to the development of EY capabilities in technical areas and engage with clients regarding the application of these methodologies to their businesses.
- Collaborate with colleagues outside of CCaSS to deliver multi-disciplinary and cross-geographical work.
Skills And Attributes For Success
As Consultant within the team, you will be exposed to a range of assurance and advisory work in direct exchange with the clients. It is therefore essential that you bring the competencies that will allowing you to do so:
- High motivation and shared values for sustainability, social matters, governance-related topics and finance;
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills;
- Familiarity with AI topics and tools (e.g., data analytics, generative AI) and the ability to leverage them in a consulting context;
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written;
- Strong interpersonal skills;
- Ability to manage multiple deliverables in parallel projects;
- Ability to work effectively in team-oriented, multi-cultural environment.
Qualifications
We welcome applicants from a wide range of backgrounds, but are particularly interested in individuals that have the following qualifications:
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance, economics, environmental sciences or related fields of study;
- Internship or experiences within ESG, sustainable finance environment or climate risk, ideally focusing on advisory/consulting, assurance in financial institutions or in consulting firms;
- Ideally experience in projects in the field of non-financial information and/or integrated reporting, assurance of non-financial, ESG data (as ESG specialist / Investor Relation department, controlling, financial reporting etc) or as an external consultant. Good knowledge of SDGs, GHG-accounting, PCAF, carbon foot printing or Life Cycle Analysis is a plus
- A keen interest in, and understanding of ESG as it relates to financial services (banking, wealth and asset management, insurance, and/or private equity)
- Interest in and understanding of emerging technologies, including AI, and their application to sustainability, reporting, and financial services transformation
- Entrepreneurial mindset with a pragmatic approach to problem solving, dynamic working style, well organized and structured
- A demonstrated capacity to take initiative, overcome challenges and work collaboratively through relevant work or project experience;
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English, French is a plus
What’s In It For You
Here at EY, you’ll have the chance to build a truly exceptional experience. We’ll empower you with the latest technology, surround you with high-performing teams, and provide the global scale and diverse and inclusive culture you need to discover your full potential. Through our coaching and training programs, you’ll develop the skills you need to stay relevant today and, in the future, – all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.
Click here to find out more about our benefits and corporate social responsibility.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Shape the Future of Finance. Build Confidence. Drive Transformation.

EY Mauritius is looking for high-potential professionals to join its Finance Transformation team, supporting clients in reimagining and modernising their Finance function through the use of AI, automation, analytics, data platforms and emerging technologies.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity: your next adventure awaits
The EY Business Consulting team offers a broad range of functional and cross-country services dedicated to providing trusted advice to clients in the Financial Services industry across Wealth & Asset Management (WAM), Banking and Capital Markets (BCM) and Insurance sectors. The Financial Services industry is experiencing tremendous change and new challenges. This is an exciting time to join an evolving team and help our clients to navigate the changing market and customer needs. As a Consultant in our Transformation Execution Practice, you will help and support challenging transformation in WAM, BCM and insurance initiatives and design, plan and deliver solutions for our clients.
Your Key Responsibilities
- Pursuing exciting business-led, tech-enabled transformation initiatives across the Financial Services sector
- Collaborating with key stakeholders, business partners, and multi-disciplinary teams to help shape ideas, design solutions and deliver measurable, sustainable improvements in business performance
- Applying storytelling skills and presenting recommendations to our clients in a clear and analytical manner
- Leveraging and further developing our global EY methodologies, frameworks, tools, accelerators, and enablers for a range of transformation goals
- Developing your skills, through on-the-job client experience as well as internal training opportunities
- Facilitating internal- and external topic roundtables and thought leadership sessions
- Supporting go-to-market and business development initiatives to continuously provide valuable solutions for our clients
What we look for:
- Excellent academic record from a leading university or university of applied sciences
- Strong motivation to join a dynamic consulting environment and to work in the financial services sector
- Experience in team-based projects (either at university or internships)
- A curious mind with the ability to structure problems in a systematic and organized fashion
- Strong presentation skills and a highly client-oriented attitude
- Strong team player, willing to proactively support solutions within highly motivated and diverse teams across functions and geographies
- Fluency in English and German is mandatory, Swiss German and any other language is a plus.
Ideally you will also have:
- Initial work experience in consulting and / or Financial Services (e.g., internships, working student, entry-level position)
- Experience and /or interest in TOM (target operating model) design and process improvements
- Experience and /or interest in Agile and Design Thinking methodologies
- Experience and /or interest in ESG
What’s in it for you
Here at EY, you’ll have the chance to build a truly exceptional experience. We’ll empower you with the latest technology and surround you with high-performing teams. Through our coaching and training programs, you’ll develop the skills you need - all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.
Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone has equal access to opportunities. If you require any accommodation during the recruitment process, we are happy to support you.
Click here to find out more about our benefits and corporate social responsibility.

jd_text:
Position Summary
Support Deloitte’s Customer Strategy and Design practice by helping clients shape initiatives that improve customer experience, operating effectiveness, and commercial outcomes. In this role, you will contribute to strategy development and cross-functional delivery efforts across marketing/agency, customer, and digital/product development programs. The ideal candidate brings 2+ years of experience in consulting and customer strategy within marketing and/or digital transformations, along with the ability to analyze problems, structure recommendations, and support implementation.
Recruiting for this role ends on December 20, 2026
Work you'll do
As a Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation on the Customer Strategy and Design team, you will be responsible for…
- Supporting customer strategy, marketing or digital transformation, and/or product strategy engagements
- Conducting research, synthesize data, and develop insights related to customer strategy, channel performance, campaign operations, and experience design
- Creating client-ready deliverables, including presentations, process maps, business cases, journey maps, and implementation plans
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to support recommendations on customer experience improvements, while showcasing business value
- Assist with workstream management, stakeholder coordination, and execution of project deliverables across multiple priorities
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
- Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
- Effective written and verbal communication skills
- Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
- Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
- Ability to lead projects or workstreams
- Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
- Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
- Ability to meet deadlines
- Ability to provide clear guidance to others
The team
Deloitte's Customer Strategy and Design practice is the strategic and experiential hub of Deloitte Digital. We excel in customer experience, marketing strategy, commercial transformation, and innovation/design, offering insights to navigate disruption and shape client agendas. Our team includes business strategists, operations experts, designers, and technologists focused on customer-centered solutions. We specialize in customer segmentation, go-to-market strategy, channel optimization, service design, UX design, and customer analytics. Join us to drive impactful customer experiences and market success.
Qualifications
Required:
- 2+ years of experience in supporting customer strategy, marketing, digital transformation or product strategy in a client serving environment
- 2+ years of experience working with cross-functional stakeholders across strategy, marketing, product, operations, and technology
- Bachelor’s degree
- Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
Preferred:
- Experience with customer journey mapping, service design, or channel strategy
- Experience with operating model design, process improvement, or organizational transformation
- Experience in client service delivery within a professional services environment
- Experience with customer analytics, segmentation, or go-to-market strategy
- Industry experience in one or more for the following: Healthcare, Life Sciences, Consumer, FSI

The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $102,800 – $188,400.
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job Description & Summary
Strategy& – Business Strategy | Industrial Products, Consumer Goods and Business Services – Senior Associate – Milano - Role Desciption
At PwC, our Strategy& team brings together professionals with a distinctive combination of strategy, corporate finance and transformation capabilities, supporting leading corporate clients and Private Equity investors across Industrial Products, Consumer Goods and Business Services.
Our positioning is built on two key differentiating factors. First, deep strategic consulting expertise underpinned by a strong understanding of our focus industries. Second, an end-to-end perspective enabled by a broad range of complementary capabilities, spanning growth strategy, business transformation, commercial due diligence, value creation, cost optimization and execution support.
As a PwC Strategy& consultant, you will work closely with corporate clients and Private Equity investors to address complex strategic and business challenges.
You will support corporate clients on growth, portfolio, performance improvement and transformation topics. You will also work with Private Equity investors across the deal cycle, from Commercial Due Diligence engagements to value creation initiatives with their portfolio companies.
You will analyze market dynamics and industry trends, assess business performance and strategic opportunities, and contribute to the development of growth and transformation strategies. Leveraging both strategic and financial perspectives, you will help clients translate strategic ambitions into actionable initiatives and support their implementation to deliver tangible and sustainable results.
We are looking for candidates with 3-4 years of relevant professional experience and a clear entrepreneurial mindset. You will be expected to take ownership of your work, lead project workstreams, identify opportunities proactively and contribute to the development of both client relationships and the team.
Driven by curiosity, you will play an active role in shaping project outcomes, coordinating and coaching junior team members, contributing to proposals and business development, and working with clients and colleagues across different projects, industries and strategic challenges.
Examples of the skills, knowledge and experience required at this level include, but are not limited to:
- 3-4 years of relevant professional experience, preferably gained in strategy consulting or another similarly demanding environment.
- Experience in leading project workstreams and supporting junior team members, managing complex strategic, commercial and financial analyses under tight, deal-driven timelines.
- Experience working with corporate clients on topics such as growth strategy, portfolio strategy, business transformation, performance improvement and cost optimization, and/or with Private Equity investors on Commercial Due Diligence and value creation engagements.
- Knowledge of, or relevant project experience in, Industrial Products, Consumer Goods and Business Services.
- A clear entrepreneurial mindset, combined with intellectual curiosity, initiative and the ability to identify opportunities proactively, contributing to proposals, business development and team-building initiatives.
- Ability to analyze complex business issues, challenge assumptions and synthesize quantitative and qualitative evidence into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
- Strong financial acumen and advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, including business plan development and review, market modelling and EBITDA bridge analyses.
- Ability to develop and manage high-quality, client-ready deliverables, ensuring analytical rigor, clear storytelling and impactful recommendations.
- Ability to approach client challenges from an end-to-end perspective, connecting strategic objectives with financial implications and execution priorities.
- Confidence in interacting with corporate executives, Private Equity professionals and other senior stakeholders, adapting communication style to different audiences and collaborating effectively across teams and backgrounds.
- Full professional proficiency in English, written and spoken, is mandatory.
For this opportunity, we offer employment under the Level 1 Italian Commerce Collective Labour Agreement (CCNL Commercio), with an indicative annual gross salary ranging from €45,000 to €55,000. The final compensation package will be determined based on the assessment of your skills, experience, and overall fit for the role.
In addition, you will be eligible for a performance-based bonus of up to 25% of your annual base salary.
Joining PwC also means gaining access to a wide range of benefits and initiatives designed to support your wellbeing, professional growth, and work-life integration, including:
- €8 daily meal vouchers
- Supplementary health insurance, with the option to extend coverage to family members
- Dedicated welfare program
- Wellbeing initiatives and support programs
- Corporate discounts and special offers through our partner network

At A.F.Ferguson & Co, our vision is to be the first choice employer for professional staff. As a trusted business advisor, we work in a changing world which offers great opportunities for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We seek to attract and employ the best people from the widest talent pool, as well as those who reflect the diverse nature of our society. At EY, we develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. Join EY and shape your future with confidence
The opportunity
As a member of Supply Chain & Operations, you'll contribute to one of the fastest-growing consulting practices in the region. If you are looking for a cutting-edge and rewarding environment within the procurement and sourcing domain, this may be the role you've been searching for.
You will work with leading organizations to improve procurement performance, optimize sourcing strategies, strengthen supplier relationships, and transform procurement operations. Working alongside high-performing teams and senior client stakeholders, you will help clients drive sustainable value creation through procurement transformation and technology-enabled solutions.
Your key responsibilities
You will be responsible for delivering large-scale, complex procurement and supply chain transformation projects, including the design, implementation, deployment and evaluation of business solutions that improve procurement effectiveness and business performance.
You will be working with client organizations to enhance procurement capabilities through process optimization, operating model transformation and organizational redesign. You will work collaboratively with project teams to analyze client challenges, develop practical solutions and support successful implementation.
You can expect to work closely with senior client stakeholders to design, evaluate and improve procurement functions across sourcing, supplier management and source-to-pay processes.
Key responsibilities include:
- Lead and support procurement transformation engagements across various industries.
- Assess current-state procurement processes and identify improvement opportunities.
- Design and implement procurement operating models, governance structures and sourcing strategies.
- Help clients improve procurement effectiveness, efficiency and supplier performance.
- Support strategic sourcing, category management and supplier relationship management initiatives.
- Drive source-to-pay (S2P) process transformation and optimization programmes.
- Analyze client issues and develop practical, data-driven recommendations.
- Manage project workstreams, deliverables, status reporting and stakeholder communications.
- Build strong client relationships and deliver high-quality client services.
- Support business development activities including proposals, presentations and thought leadership initiatives.
Skills and attributes for success
- Demonstrated technical capabilities and professional knowledge in sourcing and procurement transformation.
- Strong understanding of procurement processes, supplier management and procurement operating models.
- Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new processes and identify opportunities to enhance client value.
- Strong analytical and process-oriented problem-solving skills.
- Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
- Ability to develop and present innovative ideas and practical solutions.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with client personnel.
- Ability to identify additional opportunities and support business development activities.
- Understanding of EY service offerings and the ability to assess how the firm can support client needs.
To qualify for the role you must have
- A bachelor's degree or master's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations Management or a related discipline.
- At least 3 years of relevant experience in procurement, sourcing, supply chain consulting, transformation or related industry roles.
- Demonstrated experience helping organizations improve sourcing and procurement effectiveness and efficiency.
- Experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Strategic Sourcing
- Category Management
- Source-to-Pay (S2P)
- Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)
- Contract Lifecycle Management
- Procurement Operating Model Transformation
- Procurement Outsourcing
- Experience delivering transformation, process improvement or consulting projects related to procurement and sourcing functions.
Ideally, you'll also have
- Experience with technology-enabled procurement transformation and implementation initiatives.
- Experience implementing procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Zycus, Oracle Procurement Cloud, SAP S/4HANA Procurement or similar solutions.
- Experience in spend analytics, supplier performance management or procurement digital transformation initiatives.
- Experience supporting large-scale procurement transformation programmes across multiple business units or geographies.
- Relevant procurement, supply chain, project management or change management certifications.

Job Description & Summary
At PwC, our Workforce Transformation Consulting team supports organizations in their organizational transformation initiatives. Our professionals accompany clients throughout their transformation journeys, including aligning operating models with business strategy, upskilling talent and human resources, improving employee engagement, and managing change. As a Senior Associate, Workforce Transformation, you will play a key role un delivering end-to-end transformation projects, leveraging your expertise and understanding of management concepts.
The Opportunity
As a Senior Associate, Workforce Transformation (Bilingual FR/ENG), unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:
- Working with PwC teams and client teams on client engagements, from strategy through implementation.
- Contributing to a wide range of business development activities to identify opportunities with new and existing clients.
- Contributing to the development of your own technical skills and those of your team at the local, national, and global levels within our network.
- Staying current on developments in your areas of expertise and in the industries served, and contributing to the development of PwC’s knowledge and points of view.
- Continuing to build strong internal relationships and strengthening one’s positioning within PwC.
What You'll Bring
Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:
- Strong interest in skills development in a digital environment and in technological trends, with an openness to learning new tools and adopting new ways of working.
- Excellent oral and written communication skills, storytelling and the design and presentation of deliverables, including the use of PowerPoint.
- Experience and achievement in one or more of the following areas: Organizational diagnosis; Operating models, organizational structures, and governance models; Change management (assessing the impact of change and developing and/or implementing change strategies to increase adoption); Facilitation and facilitation of work sessions internally or with clients by encouraging co-creation.
- Autonomy, with a real enthusiasm for working with clients and teamwork.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and to evolve in ambiguous contexts, especially during customer transformations.
- Collaborative, curious profile and a willingness to learn.
- The successful candidate requires fluency in English, in addition to French as they will be required to support or collaborate with English-speaking clients, colleagues and/or stakeholders during the course of their employment with PwC Canada.
This position ensures continuity and upholds our standards of excellence following the departure of a valued team member.
The salary range for this position is $84,700 - $134,700. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. Job Description & Summary
Vuoi essere al centro di prospettive di crescita uniche? Entra nella practice Capital Projects & Economics - ambito Transportation, Logistics and Infrastructure
Your Perspectives:
Il ruolo è inserito nel team Capital Projects & Infrastructure di PwC Business Services. La figura ricercata lavorerà su progetti complessi nei settori Infrastrutture, Trasporti e Logistica, supportando lo sviluppo di piani strategici, piani industriali e attività di pianificazione dei trasporti, con un know-how tecnico-settoriale (funzionamento delle reti e dei servizi di trasporto, materiale rotabile, standard operativi) a supporto delle analisi economico-finanziarie. Il Senior Associate collaborerà con professionisti di diverse linee di servizio (Deals, Technology), agendo come punto di raccordo tra il team di progetto e il cliente, con responsabilità diretta su specifici stream di lavoro e coordinamento delle risorse più junior.
Infrastrutture e trasporti sono al centro di una trasformazione senza precedenti: transizione ecologica, decarbonizzazione, innovazione tecnologica e apertura dei mercati stanno generando nuovi investimenti e ridisegnando modelli di business e servizi. È uno scenario complesso e in rapida evoluzione, nel quale operatori e istituzioni affrontano sfide decisive e opportunità concrete di crescita.
In questo contesto lavorerai a fianco del top management di importanti realtà italiane ed europee, trasformando dati e analisi in indicazioni operative e decisioni strategiche. Con crescente autonomia, sarai responsabile della pianificazione e dell'esecuzione delle analisi assegnate, del coordinamento delle risorse più junior e della predisposizione dei materiali per il cliente. In particolare, potrai occuparti di:
● Impostazione e supervisione di studi di pianificazione dei trasporti, analisi della domanda e dell'offerta, modelli di traffico e di esercizio ferroviario (passeggeri e merci)
● Analisi, revisione e ottimizzazione dei processi core nel settore Transportation, supportando l'implementazione delle soluzioni individuate
● Sviluppo e revisione di piani strategici, piani industriali, business plan e modelli economico-finanziari, assicurandone solidità metodologica e coerenza
● Sviluppo di analisi costi-benefici e valutazione dell'impatto macroeconomico di progetti, investimenti e policy nel settore trasporti, con comprensione tecnica dei parametri trasportistici sottostanti (capacità, performance, costi operativi)
● Conduzione di analisi di mercato, benchmark e market assessment, con sintesi delle evidenze e formulazione di raccomandazioni
● Supporto a operazioni straordinarie e processi di M&A, coordinando specifici filoni di analisi e la predisposizione dei deliverable
● Impostazione e supervisione di studi della domanda e dell’offerta di trasporto
● Mentoring: Supporto alla crescita professionale delle risorse più junior
Your Unique Strenghts:
● Hai conseguito una laurea magistrale in Ingegneria dei Trasporti, Ingegneria Gestionale, Ingegneria Civile o discipline affini, oppure in Economia o Management con specializzazione in trasporti e infrastrutture
● Hai maturato 2–3 anni di esperienza in società di consulenza, operatori ferroviari e logistici, gestori di infrastrutture, istituzioni del settore trasporti o aziende strutturate, preferibilmente su progetti strategici, piani industriali o studi di settore
● Conosci il funzionamento tecnico-operativo del settore del trasporto pubblico e ferroviario, ad esempio modelli di esercizio, gestione di flotta e infrastrutture, contratti di servizio, e sai valorizzarlo in analisi economico-strategiche
● Hai sviluppato un interesse concreto e, preferibilmente, esperienza nei settori Trasporti, Logistica e Infrastrutture
● Utilizzi con fluidità la lingua inglese, anche nella predisposizione e presentazione di documenti professionali, ed è molto apprezzata la conoscenza della lingua francese
● Hai un’ottima padronanza del pacchetto Office, in particolare di Excel e PowerPoint, e sai sviluppare o revisionare modelli economico-finanziari
● Conosci i principali metodi e strumenti di project management e sai gestire in autonomia attività, priorità e scadenze
● Affronti problemi complessi con rigore analitico, spirito critico e orientamento alle soluzioni
● Comunichi in modo chiaro ed efficace, sai interagire con interlocutori senior e contribuire alla costruzione di relazioni di fiducia con il cliente
● Sai tradurre esigenze tecnico-operative in valutazioni economiche, e viceversa, favorendo l'integrazione tra competenze multidisciplinari
● Ti trovi a tuo agio nel lavoro di squadra e sei disponibile a supportare il coordinamento e la crescita professionale delle risorse più junior
Se ti riconosci in questo profilo, in PwC siamo una realtà composta da oltre 4.000 professionisti, è il luogo in cui valorizzare l’esperienza maturata, accelerare il tuo percorso di crescita e trasformare competenze e idee in impatto concreto. Unisciti al nostro team.
Set your expectation higher:
PwC ti sorprenderà con un’opportunità di carriera che ti farà sentire al centro della società, dell’innovazione e del cambiamento. Il talento e la curiosità avranno tutto lo spazio che meritano e contribuirai a garantire la qualità dei servizi che offriamo al nostro interno. In questo percorso di crescita ti supporterà un team esperto e avrai una formazione continua e su misura grazie con la quale potrai mettere le tue competenze a disposizione della clientela interna.
Feel at home:
Ci prendiamo cura delle nostre persone, abbracciando le diversità e creando valore per la clientela, le persone e la comunità, nel rispetto dell'ambiente.
Per questa opportunità è previsto un inserimento con contratto al 1° livello CCNL Commercio con una retribuzione indicativa tra 36.000€-50.000€, la cui determinazione finale sarà definita anche in base alla valutazione delle tue competenze ed esperienze pregresse. In aggiunta, è prevista una componente variabile legata alla performance fino a un massimo del 10% della retribuzione.
Entrare in PwC significa anche poter contare su un ecosistema di iniziative e benefit pensati per supportare benessere, crescita e work-life integration, tra cui:
- Buoni pasto del valore di 8€
