1721970
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Consulting - Senior Consultant – Sales Incentive Management:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
About Global Delivery Services
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centres. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity
The Senior Consultant - Sales Incentive Management will support the design and delivery of sales incentive and compensation transformation initiatives. This role combines data analysis, solution design, and implementation support. You will work with stakeholders to assess existing compensation plans, identify gaps, and implement incentive frameworks aligned with business objectives. Additionally, you will contribute to building scalable assets and supporting practice growth initiatives.
Your Key Responsibilities
Client Engagement & Delivery
- Support sales incentive transformation engagements from assessment through implementation.
- Analyse current-state compensation structures, incentive plans, quotas, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
- Assist in designing sales incentive plans aligned to business goals, sales roles, and performance drivers.
- Develop models to simulate plan performance, payout curves, and cost implications under different scenarios.
- Support implementation of incentive management processes, governance frameworks, and reporting mechanisms.
- Assist in the configuration or deployment of incentive compensation management tools where applicable.
- Prepare documentation including incentive plan rules, process flows, and calculation logic for implementation and audit purposes.
- Ensure accuracy and quality of deliverables across project workstreams.
Technology & Analytics
- Leverage analytics to evaluate plan effectiveness, sales performance, and ROI on incentive spend.
- Support use of automation and tools for incentive calculation, reporting, and performance tracking.
Business Development Support
- Support proposal development, RFP responses, and creation of client-ready materials related to sales effectiveness and incentive management.
- Contribute to development of reusable models, accelerators, and thought leadership assets
- Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution
- Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you’ll also
Have experience or exposure to incentive compensation tools and platforms, quota setting, territory design, sales performance management, and CRM and sales analytics solutions
What we look for
- 5+ years of experience in sales operations, incentive compensation, sales analytics, or consulting.
- Experience in designing or analysing incentive plans and sales compensation structures.
- Strong analytical skills with experience in financial modelling and data analysis.
- Ability to translate business requirements into incentive design and implementation logic.
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Desde Business Transformation para la industria de servicios financieros buscamos incorporar un/a Consultor/a Senior PMO para acompañar programas de transformación de negocio, digital y tecnológica en clientes líderes de Banking, FinTech, Payments e Insurance.
Te proponemos sumarte a una organización global líder en consultoría profesional participando en proyectos de alto impacto junto a equipos multidisciplinarios, con acceso a metodologías globales, herramientas innovadoras y tecnologías emergentes, incluyendo Inteligencia Artificial.
Trabajarás en iniciativas estratégicas orientadas a transformar negocios, optimizar operaciones y acelerar capacidades organizacionales, colaborando con líderes de la industria en programas complejos de cambio y evolución empresarial.
Dentro de nuestro equipo podrás:

- Acceder a metodologías globales, frameworks de gestión, herramientas innovadoras y tecnologías emergentes.

EY trabaja con clientes líderes en toda la región, ayudándolos a resolver algunos de sus desafíos más complejos. Este es el momento ideal para incorporarte a un equipo en continuo crecimiento y dejar tu huella en la transformación de la industria de servicios financieros.
Responsabilidades
- Liderar proyectos y programas estratégicos de transformación para clientes de la industria financiera, asegurando el cumplimiento de objetivos de negocio, alcance, presupuesto y cronograma.
- Gestionar portfolios y oficinas de gestión de proyectos (PMO), coordinando dependencias, riesgos, iniciativas y recursos para garantizar una ejecución efectiva.
- Desarrollar y mantener relaciones sólidas con clientes y stakeholders ejecutivos, actuando como referente en la coordinación y seguimiento de iniciativas estratégicas.
- Impulsar la adopción de metodologías ágiles y mejores prácticas de delivery, promoviendo la mejora continua y la eficiencia operativa.
- Monitorear indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs), realizar seguimiento de avances y asegurar el cumplimiento de hitos y entregables.
- Identificar riesgos, dependencias y desvíos potenciales, definiendo e implementando planes de mitigación adecuados.
- Coordinar equipos multidisciplinarios y facilitar la gestión del cambio necesaria para asegurar la adopción de las iniciativas implementadas.

- Posgrado, especialización o MBA será un plus.
- Dominio de idioma inglés verbal y escrito.
- Experiencia mínima de 2 años en empresas de consultoría, tecnología, servicios profesionales o grandes organizaciones con programas de transformación.
- Experiencia previa gestionando proyectos para clientes externos.
- Sólidos conocimientos en gestión de portfolios, Project Management y PMO.
- Experiencia en metodologías de gestión de proyectos y transformación organizacional.
- Se valorará experiencia previa en consultoras globales o empresas multinacionales.
- Perfil orientado a resultados, con capacidad analítica, planificación, organización y excelente manejo de relaciones interpersonales.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1734664
Location: New York City, Charlotte, Boston, Chicago, Philadelphia
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The Opportunity
As a Senior Consultant within EY's Financial Services Subledger practice, you will help leading insurance, banking, asset management, and alternative investment organizations transform their finance, accounting, reporting, and data environments. You will work with clients to deliver large-scale finance transformation initiatives, investment accounting platform implementations, subledger modernization programs, data migrations, and enterprise reporting solutions.
You'll have the opportunity to work alongside business, accounting, operations, and technology stakeholders to solve complex challenges, improve financial processes, and implement scalable technology solutions that enhance operational efficiency, data quality, and financial reporting capabilities.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Support finance transformation and technology-enabled accounting initiatives
- Deliver investment accounting, subledger, and financial systems implementation programs across the financial services sector.
- Evaluate current-state processes and technologies, design future-state operating models, and support implementation roadmaps.
- Partner with business, accounting, and technology stakeholders to drive solution design and delivery.
Define accounting, reporting, and data requirements
- Gather and document business, functional, data, and reporting requirements.
- Support the design of accounting frameworks, including financial product lifecycles, accounting events, chart of accounts structures, accounting elections, and posting rules.
- Develop functional specifications and process documentation to support business and technology transformation initiatives.
Lead data conversion, reconciliation, and testing activities
- Support data migration, conversion, validation, and reconciliation efforts across complex financial systems.
- Develop and execute testing strategies, test cases, and validation procedures, including functional, integration, user acceptance, and parallel testing.
- Analyze accounting and operational data to investigate issues, resolve discrepancies, and improve data quality.
Develop reporting, analytics, and business intelligence solutions
- Establish a Finance Data Mart that centralizes finance data for downstream reporting and analytics
- Analyze client’s current state reporting processes to document business requirements and technical specifications
- Design and develop financial, regulatory, management, and operational reports and dashboards using business intelligence and data visualization tools to inform decisions and support regulatory compliance
Support solution deployment and business adoption
- Collaborate with software vendors and client stakeholders to support system configuration and implementation.
- Deliver end-user training and support post-go-live stabilization activities.
- Provide ongoing recommendations to improve processes, controls, and reporting effectiveness.
Skills and Attributes for Success
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data.
- Ability to bridge business and technology teams by translating requirements into practical and scalable solutions.
- Strong communication skills with experience presenting findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
- Demonstrated attention to detail, particularly in data analysis, reconciliation, and reporting activities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced consulting environment.
- Effective collaboration and relationship-building skills across diverse teams and stakeholder groups.
- Strong organizational skills with experience managing deliverables across multiple workstreams.
- A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for leveraging technology, automation, and analytics to solve business challenges.
- Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive solutions in complex transformation environments.
- Commitment to delivering exceptional client service and building trusted relationships.
To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Experience supporting finance transformation, investment accounting, subledger, financial systems implementation, or technology consulting engagements.
- Experience and understanding of financial products including payments, deposits, loans, securities, debt, derivatives, insurance contracts, reinsurance, etc.
- Strong analytical skills with experience using SQL, Excel, and/or other data analysis tools to solve complex business and accounting challenges.
- Understanding of financial services’ business processes, accounting operations, financial reporting, and data flows.
- Experience collaborating with business and technology stakeholders in a client-facing environment.
- Experience analyzing, reconciling, and validating financial and accounting data across system implementations, conversions, or transformation programs.
OR
- Experience defining business, accounting, data, and reporting requirements and translating them into technology-enabled solutions.
- Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25%-50%
Ideally, You'll Also Have
- Experience with investment accounting and financial platforms such as BlackRock Aladdin, Eagle, Clearwater Analytics, SimCorp Dimension, or similar solutions.
- Experience supporting ABOR, IBOR, subledger, general ledger, or investment data mart transformation initiatives.
- Experience within insurance, asset management, banking, wealth management, capital markets, or alternative investment organizations.
- Experience supporting GAAP, STAT, regulatory, management, or audited financial reporting processes.
- Experience designing data models, reporting frameworks, accounting rules, chart of accounts structures, or data integration solutions.
- Experience with business intelligence and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting technologies.
- Experience with data and automation tools including Alteryx, Python, VBA, Power Automate, or related technologies
- Experience leveraging AI enabled tools to improve workflows and processes, conduct analyses, and develop and distribute communications
- Experience with cloud-based transformation initiatives involving AWS, Azure, or modern enterprise data platforms.
- Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
- Experience supporting system testing activities, including user acceptance testing (UAT), system integration testing (SIT), regression testing, or parallel testing.
- Professional certifications such as CPA, CFA, FRM, PMP, or equivalent credentials.
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
- We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $97,300 to $178,300. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $116,700 to $202,600. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
- Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
- Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.
education: Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, construction management, architecture, business or related discipline.
keywords: strategy, generative AI, AI, cloud, automation, PowerPoint, Excel, transformation, consulting
jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1750969
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
EY is the only professional services firm with a separate business unit (“FSO”) that is dedicated to the financial services marketplace. Our FSO teams have been at the forefront of every event that has reshaped and redefined the financial services industry. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic FSO team!
The business problems our clients are facing today are not the same problems they have faced in the past. The rapid pace of development in Artificial Intelligence and the technology that enables it has created an urgent need to innovate and adapt to the new global business paradigm. Financial institutions are looking to build smarter and more efficient ways to operate their business, create new revenue streams, and better manage risk, through new opportunities uncovered by their data. We believe that to fully unlock the potential of Artificial Intelligence, we need to look not only at its application, but also at the strategy level for how best to transform the enterprise into one that is technology and data focused and ready for the new age. Our clients’ problems are becoming increasingly complex while at the same time the need to automate and streamline is rising.
The opportunity
We are seeking a Senior Consultant who can support the analysis and day-to-day delivery required to move a financial institution from data center strategy (including co-lo) and Cloud into executable decisions and plans. This is not a general project coordinator role. The candidate should have hands-on exposure to at least one substantive part of the data center lifecycle and enough range to work across critical facilities, IT infrastructure, migration, resiliency and third-party providers.
The work is focused primarily on banking, capital markets, insurance and payments clients. Selected assignments may include other highly regulated or mission-critical organizations where resilience, control, and disciplined execution are central to the client's agenda.
Your key responsibilities
-
Perform current-state assessments of data center and Cloud hosted environments using client data, interviews, site information and technical documents; convert findings into capacity, risk, dependency and decision views.
-
Support colocation and provider evaluations by developing requirements, scoring criteria, RFP content, evaluation workbooks, site-visit materials and executive comparisons.
-
Analyze readiness across space, power, cooling, connectivity, compute, storage, network, backup and operational support.
-
Support build and migration planning through integrated schedules, RAID management, dependency analysis, readiness checkpoints, test evidence, runbooks and go/no-go materials.
-
Develop application and infrastructure inventories, validate data quality, trace dependencies, and identify gaps that could affect migration sequencing or service continuity.
-
Prepare client-ready Excel models, PowerPoint decision materials, process and architecture diagrams, status reports, and executive summaries.
-
Facilitate working sessions across facilities, infrastructure, applications, network, cyber, resiliency, sourcing, finance, risk and providers.
-
Own assigned work products and escalate issues with a fact base and recommended path forward.
Required experience and qualifications
-
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, construction management, architecture, business or related discipline.
-
At least 3 years of relevant experience in data centers or Cloud , IT infrastructure, critical facilities, hybrid infrastructure, infrastructure transformation, resiliency or capital-program delivery.
-
Experience producing real delivery artifacts such as requirements, inventories, dependency maps, schedules, RAID logs, evaluation workbooks, readiness evidence, runbooks or executive reporting.
-
Experience working across multiple technical and business stakeholder groups, not only within a single support or administration team.
-
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues in business and risk terms.
-
Public-cloud migration experience is relevant and is a substitute for data center infrastructure migration, consolidation and exit experience although experience with both is preferred
Required software and analytical tooling
-
Advanced Microsoft Excel, including structured analysis, lookups, pivot tables, quality checks, and management reporting.
-
Strong Microsoft PowerPoint and the ability to create concise, executive-ready storyline and decision materials.
-
Working capability in Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart or equivalent for process, dependency, architecture or facility diagrams.
-
Practical use of Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira or Azure DevOps to manage milestones, dependencies, risks and actions.
-
Experience extracting, reconciling or analyzing information from at least one infrastructure source such as a DCIM platform, ServiceNow CMDB/ITSM, BMC Helix, Device42, BMS/EPMS, VMware vCenter or cloud inventory tooling. Expertise in every platform is not required.
AI-enabled delivery
-
Practical experience using Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot or comparable enterprise generative AI tools to improve research, analysis, requirements development, data review, documentation, reporting or workflow automation is preferred.
-
Candidates should be able to explain how they validated AI-generated outputs, protected confidential information, and applied professional judgment before using the work product.
Preferred experience
-
Financial services infrastructure, operational resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, or third-party risk.
-
Exposure to MEP and critical systems, including electrical distribution, UPS/generators, cooling, controls, and telecommunications.
-
Colocation sourcing, workload migration, data center consolidation or facility modernization.
-
Relevant credentials such as PMP, ITIL, Uptime Institute, engineering, or commissioning credentials are preferred but not required.
Skills and attributes for success
-
Ability to work through complex facility, infrastructure, and operational information and turn it into practical analysis and clear client decisions.
-
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify risks, dependencies and gaps that may affect delivery.
-
Clear written and verbal communication across technical, operational, and business audiences.
-
Ability to work effectively across client teams, EY workstreams and third-party providers while maintaining focus on quality and follow-through.
-
Curiosity and willingness to build capability across adjacent areas of the data center lifecycle.
-
A practical ownership mindset and interest in producing work that clients can use to make and execute decisions.
What we offer you

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1640233
At EY, we develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
We work together across our full spectrum of services and skills powered by technology and AI, so that business, people and the planet can thrive together.
We’re all in, are you?
Join EY and shape your future with confidence.
The opportunity
Technology is the business agenda. Customers’ expectations for access to technology products and services are rapidly increasing. Companies must consider foundational Technology Transformation to adapt and compete.
At EY, you’ll be part of a team that’s solving some of the world’s toughest challenges. You’ll drive long-term value using technology across every industry, helping clients find inventive solutions to their business problems. As you help them grow, you’ll also discover limitless opportunities to develop yourself. You’ll gain deep technical expertise, learn about business strategy, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and prototype innovative solutions. You’ll be transforming businesses, one idea at a time.
As a Business-Technology Analyst, you will deliver end-to-end transformative solutions with a strong blend of functional consulting, technical expertise, data and engineering insights, particularly valuable in sectors like Telco, Energy, Automotive, Infrastructure, Construction, and Engineering.
Your Key Responsibilities:
-
- Demonstrate a basic understanding of system design and cloud platforms, with a strong interest in modern architecture concepts and emerging technologies.
- Connect technology decisions to business goals, showing curiosity about how systems integrate and deliver value across industries.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and document scalable, resilient solutions, and communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Break down complex problems into manageable components, thinking critically about system-wide impacts and long-term implications.
- Assist in developing architecture frameworks and contributing to infrastructure modernization efforts, including cloud migration and automation.
- Work closely with business and technology stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, develop use cases, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
- Act as a bridge between business and technology teams, facilitating clear communication and alignment throughout the solution design process.
- Stay proactive in seeking feedback, continuously improving, and contributing to a culture of innovation and transformation.
Skills and Attributes for Success:
- Analytical mindset with the ability to break down complex problems and assess system-wide impacts.
- Strong communication skills, capable of explaining technical concepts to diverse audiences and documenting solutions clearly.
- Collaborative and proactive, eager to work across teams and contribute to innovative solutions.
- Growth-oriented, with a passion for learning new technologies, receiving feedback, and applying knowledge to real-world challenges.
To quality for the role you must have:
- Basic knowledge of system design and cloud architecture, with a strong foundation in analytical thinking and problem-solving.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and collaborate across teams.
- Strong teamwork and collaboration skills to thrive in a diverse, fast-paced environment.
- A proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement and the ability to identify opportunities for enhancements in technology solutions.
What we look for
Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident team player that collaborates with people from various teams while looking to develop your career in a dynamic organization.
What working at EY offers
EY offers a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. We are committed to being an inclusive employer and are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. Plus, we offer:
- Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
Company description
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
All in to shape the future with confidence.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1721958
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Consulting - Senior Consultant – Customer Service Transformation and AI
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
About Global Delivery Services
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity
The Senior Consultant - Customer Service AI led Transformation and AI will support the design and delivery of AI-enabled service transformation initiatives. This role combines analytical problem-solving, solution design, and implementation delivery. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to assess service operations, identify AI-led transformation opportunities, and deliver technology-enabled improvements across customer service and support functions. Additionally, you will contribute to building reusable assets and support practice growth initiatives aligned with business priorities.
Your Key Responsibilities
- Client Engagement & Delivery
- Support delivery of service transformation engagements from assessment through implementation, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
- Analyse current-state service processes, customer journeys, case management workflows, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
- Assist in designing AI-led service solutions such as chatbots, virtual assistants, intelligent routing, agent assist, and workflow automation.
- Support service operating model redesign including process optimization, workforce enablement, and SLA improvements.
- Contribute to implementation of AI, analytics, and service management solutions integrated with CRM/service platforms.
- Develop functional specifications, user stories, and process documentation to support solution delivery.
- Assist in preparing business cases and tracking benefits related to service efficiency, cost reduction, and customer satisfaction.
- Ensure quality and timely delivery of project workstreams.
- Technology & Innovation
- Apply AI/ML concepts, generative AI, and automation tools to enhance service processes and decision-making.
- Stay updated on emerging trends in AI-enabled service transformation, including conversational AI and intelligent service management.
- Business Development Support
- Support proposal development, RFP responses, and creation of client presentations.
- Contribute to development of reusable assets, accelerators, and thought leadership for service transformation and AI offerings
- Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
- Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you’ll also
- Have experience delivering AI-led service transformation initiatives, including chatbots, automation, knowledge management, and case management transformation.
- Have exposure to leading service platforms, including CRM/service cloud solutions and ITSM tools.
- Demonstrate an understanding of customer experience metrics (CSAT, NPS) and service KPIs, and their role in improving service operations and customer outcomes.
What we look for
- 5+ years of experience in service transformation, customer operations, process improvement, or consulting.
- Consulting experience is preferred
- Experience in analysing service processes and supporting implementation of service or CRM platforms.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
- Familiarity with AI/automation concepts and service management tools.
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Job Description & Summary
PwC Poland’s Data, Digital Solutions & AI team comprises more than 50 specialists. We help our clients design and implement a strategic and sustainable approach to capitalising on the value of their data and boosting business results. We collaborate with organisations in various industries to develop solutions tailored to their needs.
We are looking for:
Master Data Management (MDM) Consultant
You will support Polish and international clients in designing and delivering enterprise‑grade MDM and data governance solutions that generate measurable business value. You will work closely with business and IT stakeholders to define target operating models, master data processes, governance structures and implement technologies.
Your future role:
- Support client consultations and workshops, translating business and IT objectives into MDM / MDG strategies, target operating models, functional requirements and transformation roadmaps,
- Design and formalize master data management frameworks, including roles (Data Owners, Data Stewards), RACI models, policies, standards and operating principles,
- Elicit, prioritize and document requirements; map existing and define adjusted end‑to‑end master data processes (creation, change, approval, distribution, retirement) across master data domains,
- Define and validate master data models, hierarchies and attributes in close collaboration with business stakeholders,
- Design and operationalize data quality management frameworks, including validation rules, KPIs, monitoring, reporting, issue management and escalation paths,
- Assess clients’ current data and system landscapes, identify inefficiencies and design pragmatic transformation paths, including modern governance concepts (e.g. data mesh),
- Prepare and deliver executive‑level presentations, demos and pre‑sales sessions; clearly articulate recommendations to senior and C‑level stakeholders.
Apply, if you have:
- 2+ years of professional experience in MDM field, ideally in a consulting or client‑facing role,
- Proven experience designing and implementing MDM domains (e.g. Product/Material, Supplier, Customer, Reference Data),
- Demonstrated expertise in MDM governance and operating model design, including organizational enablement and processes and roles definition,
- Understanding of master data modeling, validation rules, data quality management and the full master data lifecycle,
- Hands‑on experience with at least one enterprise MDM platform (e.g. SAP MDG, Stibo, Informatica, Ataccama),
- Ability to independently lead workshops, facilitate discussions and align business and IT stakeholders,
- Excellent communication skills in Polish and English (C1+), including executive storytelling and structured thinking,
- Have demonstrated knowledge of new technologies and AI‑powered tools in your daily work (e.g., task automation, information analysis, content creation),
- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills; ability to work autonomously and take accountability for outcomes.
Nice to have:
- End‑to‑end MDM / MDG implementation experience (operating model, domains, processes, tool selection, integrations),
- Hands-on experience with SAP ERP and SAP MDG,
- Professional communication skills in German, enabling participation in workshops, interviews and presentations with German‑speaking clients,
- Experience designing data strategies and operating models for modern data platforms (e.g. Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake) and understanding their governance implications,
- Understanding of Data Management and Data Governance Frameworks.
By joining us you gain:
- work flexibility - openness for your preferences regarding contract form, hybrid working model, flexible start of the day, workation, sabbatical leave and additional summer solutions (e.g. Slow Fridays),
- development and upskilling - our full support during onboarding process, mentoring from experienced colleagues, training sessions, workshops, certification co/financed by PwC and conversations with native speaker,

- possibility to create your individual benefits package (e.g. personal concierge, veterinary packages for your pets, financial & legal assistance) and access to an online cafeteria where you may find i.a. vouchers, discounts for IT devices and car purchase,
- 3 paid hours for volunteering per month,
- and when you start enjoying PwC as much as we do, you may recommend your friend to work with us.

Job Description & Summary
Vuoi essere al centro di prospettive di crescita uniche? Entra nella practice Capital Projects & Economics - ambito Transportation, Logistics and Infrastructure
Your Perspectives:
Il ruolo è inserito nel team Capital Projects & Infrastructure di PwC Business Services. La figura ricercata lavorerà su progetti complessi nei settori Infrastrutture, Trasporti e Logistica, supportando lo sviluppo di piani strategici, piani industriali e attività di pianificazione dei trasporti, con un know-how tecnico-settoriale (funzionamento delle reti e dei servizi di trasporto, materiale rotabile, standard operativi) a supporto delle analisi economico-finanziarie. Il Senior Associate collaborerà con professionisti di diverse linee di servizio (Deals, Technology), agendo come punto di raccordo tra il team di progetto e il cliente, con responsabilità diretta su specifici stream di lavoro e coordinamento delle risorse più junior.
Infrastrutture e trasporti sono al centro di una trasformazione senza precedenti: transizione ecologica, decarbonizzazione, innovazione tecnologica e apertura dei mercati stanno generando nuovi investimenti e ridisegnando modelli di business e servizi. È uno scenario complesso e in rapida evoluzione, nel quale operatori e istituzioni affrontano sfide decisive e opportunità concrete di crescita.
In questo contesto lavorerai a fianco del top management di importanti realtà italiane ed europee, trasformando dati e analisi in indicazioni operative e decisioni strategiche. Con crescente autonomia, sarai responsabile della pianificazione e dell'esecuzione delle analisi assegnate, del coordinamento delle risorse più junior e della predisposizione dei materiali per il cliente. In particolare, potrai occuparti di:
● Impostazione e supervisione di studi di pianificazione dei trasporti, analisi della domanda e dell'offerta, modelli di traffico e di esercizio ferroviario (passeggeri e merci)
● Analisi, revisione e ottimizzazione dei processi core nel settore Transportation, supportando l'implementazione delle soluzioni individuate
● Sviluppo e revisione di piani strategici, piani industriali, business plan e modelli economico-finanziari, assicurandone solidità metodologica e coerenza
● Sviluppo di analisi costi-benefici e valutazione dell'impatto macroeconomico di progetti, investimenti e policy nel settore trasporti, con comprensione tecnica dei parametri trasportistici sottostanti (capacità, performance, costi operativi)
● Conduzione di analisi di mercato, benchmark e market assessment, con sintesi delle evidenze e formulazione di raccomandazioni
● Supporto a operazioni straordinarie e processi di M&A, coordinando specifici filoni di analisi e la predisposizione dei deliverable
● Impostazione e supervisione di studi della domanda e dell’offerta di trasporto
● Mentoring: Supporto alla crescita professionale delle risorse più junior
Your Unique Strenghts:
● Hai conseguito una laurea magistrale in Ingegneria dei Trasporti, Ingegneria Gestionale, Ingegneria Civile o discipline affini, oppure in Economia o Management con specializzazione in trasporti e infrastrutture
● Hai maturato 2–3 anni di esperienza in società di consulenza, operatori ferroviari e logistici, gestori di infrastrutture, istituzioni del settore trasporti o aziende strutturate, preferibilmente su progetti strategici, piani industriali o studi di settore
● Conosci il funzionamento tecnico-operativo del settore del trasporto pubblico e ferroviario, ad esempio modelli di esercizio, gestione di flotta e infrastrutture, contratti di servizio, e sai valorizzarlo in analisi economico-strategiche
● Hai sviluppato un interesse concreto e, preferibilmente, esperienza nei settori Trasporti, Logistica e Infrastrutture
● Utilizzi con fluidità la lingua inglese, anche nella predisposizione e presentazione di documenti professionali, ed è molto apprezzata la conoscenza della lingua francese
● Hai un’ottima padronanza del pacchetto Office, in particolare di Excel e PowerPoint, e sai sviluppare o revisionare modelli economico-finanziari
● Conosci i principali metodi e strumenti di project management e sai gestire in autonomia attività, priorità e scadenze
● Affronti problemi complessi con rigore analitico, spirito critico e orientamento alle soluzioni
● Comunichi in modo chiaro ed efficace, sai interagire con interlocutori senior e contribuire alla costruzione di relazioni di fiducia con il cliente
● Sai tradurre esigenze tecnico-operative in valutazioni economiche, e viceversa, favorendo l'integrazione tra competenze multidisciplinari
● Ti trovi a tuo agio nel lavoro di squadra e sei disponibile a supportare il coordinamento e la crescita professionale delle risorse più junior
Se ti riconosci in questo profilo, in PwC siamo una realtà composta da oltre 4.000 professionisti, è il luogo in cui valorizzare l’esperienza maturata, accelerare il tuo percorso di crescita e trasformare competenze e idee in impatto concreto. Unisciti al nostro team.
Set your expectation higher:
PwC ti sorprenderà con un’opportunità di carriera che ti farà sentire al centro della società, dell’innovazione e del cambiamento. Il talento e la curiosità avranno tutto lo spazio che meritano e contribuirai a garantire la qualità dei servizi che offriamo al nostro interno. In questo percorso di crescita ti supporterà un team esperto e avrai una formazione continua e su misura grazie con la quale potrai mettere le tue competenze a disposizione della clientela interna.
Feel at home:
Ci prendiamo cura delle nostre persone, abbracciando le diversità e creando valore per la clientela, le persone e la comunità, nel rispetto dell'ambiente.
Per questa opportunità è previsto un inserimento con contratto al 1° livello CCNL Commercio con una retribuzione indicativa tra 36.000€-50.000€, la cui determinazione finale sarà definita anche in base alla valutazione delle tue competenze ed esperienze pregresse. In aggiunta, è prevista una componente variabile legata alla performance fino a un massimo del 10% della retribuzione.
Entrare in PwC significa anche poter contare su un ecosistema di iniziative e benefit pensati per supportare benessere, crescita e work-life integration, tra cui:
- Buoni pasto del valore di 8€

Make a difference together with your colleagues

Your unique background and way of thinking will be valued and you will contribute to an environment where innovation and growth go hand in hand. Your role in shaping tomorrow’s IT and business landscapes

jd_text:
Wer wir sind
Unser Strategy& Energy, Utilities & Resources (EUR) Deals Team begleitet führende Unternehmen und Investoren bei strategischen Fragestellungen und Transaktionen rund um die Energiewende und das zukünftige Energiesystem. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir Strategien, bewerten neue Märkte und Geschäftsmodelle und identifizieren konkrete Wertsteigerungs- und Wachstumspotenziale. Unsere Projekte reichen von Commercial (Vendor) Due Diligence und Value Creation über Corporate und Growth Strategy bis hin zu Go-to-Market, Internationalisierung und Business Model Development.
Inhaltlich arbeiten wir entlang zentraler Felder der Energiewende, darunter erneuerbare Energien, Batteriespeicher und andere Flexibilitätslösungen, Stromnetze und Smart Metering, Elektrifizierung von Wärme und Industrie sowie neue digitale und softwarebasierte Geschäftsmodelle. Dabei arbeiten wir sowohl mit PE- und Infrastrukturinvestoren als auch mit Utilities, Entwicklern, IPPs, Technologie- und Serviceanbietern.
Du wirst Teil eines interdisziplinären Teams aus Expert:innen verschiedenster Fachrichtungen – von Ingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Geologie bis zu Naturwissenschaften. Viele Teammitglieder bringen zudem wertvolle Erfahrungen aus der Industrie, Startups oder anderen Beratungen mit. Neben abwechslungsreichen Projekten sorgen regelmäßige Team-Events, gemeinsame Trainings und eine offene Unternehmenskultur für starken Teamspirit und Spaß bei der Arbeit.
Was du bei uns bewegen wirst
Als Senior Associate (w/m/d) im Bereich Energy und Deals spielst du eine wesentliche Rolle bei der Beratung führender Unternehmen und Investoren rund um die Energiewende und das zukünftige Energiesystem. Deine Projekte reichen von Commercial (Vendor) Due Diligence und Value Creation bis hin zu Wachstumsstrategien und neuen Geschäftsmodellen. Inhaltlich beschäftigst du dich unter anderem mit erneuerbaren Energien, Batteriespeichern und Flexibilität, Stromnetzen sowie der Elektrifizierung von Wärme und Industrie. Mit deiner strategischen Expertise übernimmst du die Leitung einzelner Workstreams für komplexe Projekte und schlüpfst mit Leidenschaft in eine Mentor:innenrolle für deine Kolleg:innen.
Du arbeitest dich intensiv in komplexe Fragestellungen unserer Klient:innen ein, führst unabhängige Analysen durch, definierst Problemstellungen und gestaltest Strategien, die für den Erfolg unserer Klient:innen von entscheidender Bedeutung sind.
Im Rahmen des Onboardings erlernst du grundlegende Methoden und Techniken eine:r Strategieberater:in und entwickelst dich mit jedem erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Projekt zu einem bzw. einer echten Expert:in im Bereich Energy mit Fokus auf erneuerbare Energien und Deals.
Als Teil unseres Consulting-Teams analysierst du heute schon die Probleme von morgen und entwickelst Strategien für die frühzeitige Realisierung von Transformationen unserer Klient:innen. Dabei profitierst du von unserem weltweiten Expert:innenteam aller Disziplinen innerhalb des PwC-Netzwerks, auf das du für die Umsetzung zurückgreifen kannst.
Was du mitbringst

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1719594
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Join our Financial Services Office (FSO) and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global market perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including asset management and private equity, banking and capital markets, and insurance, we provide integrated assurance, consulting, strategy & transactions, and tax services to our clients. As a market segment of the FSO, the BBC includes the Bahamas, Bermuda, British Virgin Islands, and Cayman Islands. By joining the BBC, you will receive unmatched exposure and experience to our continuously growing portfolio of diverse FSO clients.
Our Strategy & Transactions (SaT) team works with clients to manage their capital agenda to drive competitive advantage and increased returns. As part of a global team of 10,000 professionals in 100 countries you will advise clients on preserving, optimizing, raising or investing capital. Major groups (or, as we call them, sub-service lines and competencies) within SaT include Mergers and Acquisition Services, Project Finance, Turnaround & Restructuring, Operational Transaction Services, Transaction Support, Transaction Tax, and Valuations, Economics and Modeling.
The opportunity
Our continued success in the BBC region has propelled rapid growth in our team. We have ambitious plans and we are seeking high-performing seniors to join our Turnaround & Restructuring services team to help in further developing our practice. This role will primarily focus on insolvency and restructuring; the successful candidates should have liquidations experience (both solvent and insolvent), while some restructuring and investigations/forensics experience would be beneficial but is not required for this role. This position is based in Bermuda and, where necessary to meet client demands, in the wider region.
Your key responsibilities
- Working under the supervision of and support the manager, senior manager, director and/or associate partner/partner, execute restructuring, liquidation and/or insolvency procedures as required and contribute to defining the engagement scope
- Actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships and make sure that delivered client work is of high quality; as part of this, you'll anticipate and identify risks and escalate issues, as appropriate
- Prepare analysis and reports supporting the engagement as required to be delivered to clients and other parties and contribute to presenting our work and its findings to the client
- Work effectively as a team member sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
- Demonstrate professionalism and confidence to deal with a range of stakeholder groups and management teams
- Undertake tasks critical for effective onboarding of new clients
- Undertake day-to-day tasks for ongoing engagements to help ensure engagements are progressed effectively and within the allocated budget
- Build strong internal relationships within SaT and across other services
Skills and attributes for success
- Advanced written and verbal communication skills. The ability to produce clear, concise, well-written reports is key to our business
- Knowledge of business trends, relevant legislation, emerging technical and industry developments
- Excellent organizational and project management skills
- Able to multi-task and deadline-driven
- A proactive approach to progressing matters effectively and efficiently and raising key matters with the case manager as required
- An awareness of the importance of recording time accurately and the impact this has on engagement economics
- Ability to work a flexible schedule and you will be expected to work additional hours as required
To qualify for the role, you must have
- Possess or be actively pursuing an internationally recognized professional accounting certification, such as an ACA, CA, CPA or equivalent, or a service line relevant certification, such as a recognized insolvency qualification
- A minimum of three (3) years of recent relevant experience in a similar position, specifically with experience of restructuring and common law liquidations either within the “Big 4” or a boutique restructuring/insolvency firm; successful candidate must have demonstrated leadership and business development skills
- Display a high level of commercial acumen, and an awareness of the key industry drivers
- Proficiency in detailed financial and commercial analysis and able to identify potential areas of sensitivity
- The ability to identify key issues on assignments and suggest workable solutions and experience in presenting findings clearly in reports and other deliverables to clients
Ideally, you may also have
- Appreciation of the risks inherent in advising distressed businesses and their stakeholders
- Knowledge of current market issues in financial services
- Experience working on project-based teams solving complex issues
What we look for
We’re most interested in well-rounded people who are naturally curious and ready to work on engagements from a wide range of backgrounds. In return, you can expect the support of great colleagues, as well the industry-recognized training you’ll need to grow in your career. If you’re a fast learner with great organizational skills, this role is for you.
What we offer
We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical, dental and vision coverage, competitive pension plan, generous vacation and leave entitlement(s), and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:
- Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

GOV :
Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.
It has multiple fields of play such as:
Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
Business Transformation - a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.
Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
- Demonstrated ability to support marketing and branding initiatives for SHG products under SRLM programs. Strong understanding of consulting-led project delivery within government and public sector transformation engagements. Experienced in analyzing program requirements and translating them into practical implementation support. Proficient in preparing structured project materials, documentation, and stakeholder-ready communication outputs. Capable of contributing to branding strategy execution and field-level coordination for livelihood and community development initiatives.

To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
- Post Graduate Diploma in Management with specialization in Marketing/Branding/International business or related field
Experience
- 5 years of experience in marketing promotions, design, branding, packaging design etc
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
What we offer
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity : Senior Project Consultant-TMT-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - FINANCE - New Delhi
TMT :
Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.
CNS - BC - FINANCE :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.
It has multiple fields of play such as:
Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
Business Transformation - a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.
Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
- Business Planning & Service Delivery
- Convert business priorities into clear operating plans, capacity requirements, service objectives and team goals.
- Own end-to-end delivery for the assigned finance process or portfolio, ensuring agreed service levels, quality, accuracy and timeliness.
- Monitor operational performance through meaningful KPIs, root-cause analysis and action plans; provide transparent updates to leadership and stakeholders.
- Plan resources effectively across business cycles, month/quarter/year-end peaks, transitions and transformation initiatives. Finance Process Leadership
- Lead one or more finance domains based on experience and business need: RTR, PTP, OTC, Treasury, Controllership and/or FP&A.
- For RTR/Controllership: oversee close, general ledger, reconciliations, journal governance, intercompany, reporting, balance-sheet integrity and audit support, as applicable.
- For PTP: oversee purchasing-to-payment operations including invoice processing, controls, vendor queries, payments, ageing and working-capital opportunities, as applicable.
- For OTC: oversee billing, cash application, collections, credit management, dispute resolution, receivables reporting and working-capital performance, as applicable.
- For Treasury: oversee cash positioning, liquidity, banking operations, payments, forecasts, controls and treasury reporting, as applicable.
- For FP&A: oversee planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, variance analysis, performance insights and decision support, as applicable. Controls, Compliance & Risk Management
- Ensure processes operate in accordance with company policies, accounting standards, delegation of authority, regulatory requirements and internal control frameworks.
- Maintain robust process documentation, SOPs, desktop procedures, control evidence and knowledge repositories.
- Identify financial and operational risks early, implement preventive and corrective actions, and support internal, statutory and external audits.
- Promote a strong controls and compliance culture while balancing governance with efficient business outcomes. Transformation & Operational Excellence
- Drive simplification, standardization, automation and productivity improvement across the assigned portfolio.
- Use data and process insights to identify recurring issues, remove non-value-added activities and improve customer experience.
- Partner with technology, process owners and business teams on system implementations, migrations, transitions and continuous-improvement programs.
- Embed scalable ways of working and share leading practices across teams and locations. Stakeholder & Change Management
- Build trusted relationships with business finance, operations, procurement, sales, tax, legal, technology, banks, vendors, customers and auditors, as relevant to the portfolio.
- Facilitate governance reviews, resolve escalations, communicate trade-offs clearly and ensure ownership of agreed actions.
- Act as a change leader during organizational, process and technology transformation. People Leadership
- Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team with clear accountability, role clarity and performance expectations.
- Plan staffing, hiring, onboarding, succession and capability development in line with current and future business needs.
- Create an inclusive, collaborative and learning-oriented environment that supports engagement, retention and internal mobility.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
- Master of Business Administration
Experience
- 5-8 years
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
What we offer
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1750042
Location: New York, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, San Francisco
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity
EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.
With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.
Your key responsibilities
Consultants participate as valued members of case teams helping clients address their most pressing strategic challenges. Consultants identify information sources, assemble data, perform analyses, structure arguments and develop presentations. Training is given in key business concepts and analytical methods immediately upon joining the firm and throughout their EY-Parthenon career. Consultants are able to gain responsibility quickly, often serving as primary contacts for clients and managing junior case team members.
Our teams work on a variety of complex and strategic client issues at the C-suite. The range of assignments includes developing long-term strategies for organizations, evaluating the potential acquisition of businesses, improving educational achievement outcomes, developing new marketing channel strategies, reducing operating costs, and evaluating new business ventures.
Skills and attributes for success
- Perform secondary research using a variety of sources (e.g., analyst reports, market research reports, news articles).
- Executing various analyses (e.g., customer segmentation, market sizing, competitor analysis, macroeconomic forecasting) to support the strategic recommendations.
- Designing and executing in-depth interview guides with key organizational stakeholders, industry experts and customers.
- Analyzing business plans and pro-forma financial models to help identify key assumptions and drivers.
- Maintaining relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels and other internal teams on the engagement.
To qualify for the role, you must have
- Outstanding academic performance, with a bachelor's degree and at least 2 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 18 months of related work experience.
- Experience in strategy consulting, private equity, investment banking, market research, or similar role performing leveraging quantitative research for health industry clients.
- Ability to conduct detailed analysis on products, markets, competitors and customers to identify risks and opportunities across the health industry.
- Proficient in the English language, including the ability to listen, understand, read and communicate effectively, both in writing and verbally, in a professional environment.
- Effective organization and time management skills with ability to work under pressure and adhere to project deadlines.
- Ability to multitask and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
- You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
- The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.
Ideally, you will have
- Excellent problem solving, project management, facilitation and interpersonal skills.
- Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.
What we look for
We are interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients' goals and think creatively to facilitate them. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and a genuine passion for taking on new challenges, this role is for you.
What we offer you
At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
- We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $130,000 to $200,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
- Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
- To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
- EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
- For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
- At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you, we are counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The Team and the opportunity
Become a part of EY’s Business Consulting Finance team as a Senior Consultant and help shape the future of finance, data and risk management. With 2+ years of experience in Finance, Data or Risk, you'll be part of a rapidly growing team tackling complex challenges and driving transformation on a global scale.
The Finance competency at EY is a multifaceted team that focuses on providing expert guidance and support to clients in navigating complex regulatory landscapes, managing and analysing finance and risk data, and implementing finance transformation initiatives. Our goal is to drive the finance functions’ effectiveness, agility and value contribution within the client’s organisation which can include integration of new technologies, optimisation of processes and the adoption of innovative practices.
At FS Consulting, we work closely with global teams and clients to solve intricate business problems through strategic solutions. We provide innovative approaches to unlock valuable insights and address our clients' most pressing issues.
Your key responsibilities
- Work as part of a client engagement teams with diverse skills and backgrounds. Strong understanding of core business and finance operations gained through involvement/ delivery of projects.
- Exceptional problem-solving ability including logical reasoning, creative thinking and the ability to untangle complex issues for improving existing business processes and workflows
- Deliver high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget
