jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1750432
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The Opportunity
We are seeking a Consultant with hands-on business analytics experience to join our Business Consulting team in Malta. This role offers an excellent opportunity for growth, learning, and career development within our organisation.
You will sit within our Business Analytics competency, helping clients across financial services, gaming, hospitality, the public sector and other industries turn data into better decisions through KPI frameworks, dashboards, customer insights and value tracking. We work as one team, so you will also have the chance to contribute to our transformation delivery and business architecture work, and we will support you in building that breadth.
This is a role for someone who sees the bigger picture. We are looking for a consultant who can walk into a client environment, spot where data is being underused, and shape the opportunity into a solution.
Your Key Responsibilities
- Analytics and Insight
- Design KPI and performance measurement frameworks aligned to client strategy, with clear definitions, targets and ownership.
- Prepare and analyse data to identify trends, drivers and root causes, and build dashboards and reporting solutions that support reliable decision-making.
- Support scenario analysis, forecasting, benefits tracking and performance improvement for clients.
- Turn analysis into clear recommendations and communicate them to executive, non-technical audiences.
- Analyse customer, product and portfolio performance to inform prioritisation, roadmaps and investment decisions.
- Apply data management and governance standards to everything you produce.
- Client Delivery
- Contribute to end to end analytics workstreams, covering scope, plan, deliverables, quality and timelines.
- Facilitate workshops to align stakeholders on metrics, definitions and business priorities.
- Identify risks and issues, escalate appropriately, and support adoption of the solutions you deliver.
- Contribute to transformation and operating model engagements so that design decisions are evidenced by data.
- Contribute to high-quality deliverables, proposals and thought leadership, and share knowledge across the team.
- Opportunity Identification and Solution Shaping
- Identify where data can create value for a client, and translate that into a clear, practical solution and business case.
- Shape analytics solutions such as anomaly detection, risk and control monitoring, self-service analytics and automated reporting.
- Think beyond the immediate brief, connecting analytics opportunities to the client's wider strategy, operating model and transformation agenda.
Skills and Attributes for Success
- At least 2 years of hands-on experience in business analytics, business intelligence or data-driven advisory work, ideally in a client-facing environment.
- Strong capability in Power BI (data modelling, DAX, report design), SQL and advanced Excel; familiarity with Python or an equivalent analytics language.
- Solid understanding of KPI design, performance measurement and management reporting.
- Excellent data storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts simply.
- Structured problem solving, and experience gathering requirements through interviews and workshops.
- Results-oriented, adaptable, and able to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
- Exposure to AI and advanced analytics use cases, and a view of where they add business value.
- Experience in customer, product or portfolio analytics, or working knowledge of transformation delivery methods (Agile, Scrum, SAFe) or process and operating model design, is considered an asset.
- Sector experience in financial services, gaming, hospitality or the public sector is considered an asset.
Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree (MQF Level 6) in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, Engineering, Business and Computing, or a related field.
- A Master’s degree or relevant certification (e.g. Microsoft PL-300, AI-900, PSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP, Lean Six Sigma) would be considered an asset.
What we offer
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1717664
Senior Consultant - Business Consulting – Finance
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
Se cerchi un percorso di crescita in un contesto internazionale dove le tue idee contano davvero, sei nel posto giusto. In EY puoi dare forma alla tua carriera e contribuire a costruire un mondo del lavoro migliore, insieme a chi lo sta già trasformando ogni giorno.
Perché candidarsi in EY?
Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti:
- Investimento sulle competenze del futuro: fin dal primo giorno, eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, disponibili per tutti;
- Formazione continua: oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona;
- Sviluppo e progressione di carriera: solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera;
- Mobilità e opportunità internazionali, compresa la possibilità di lavorare in smart working dall’estero fino a 20 giorni senza essere in trasferta;
- Lavoro ibrido senza giornate prestabilite centralmente.
- Un network internazionale su cui poter contare.
Vuoi dare forma al tuo futuro insieme a noi?
Scopri nel concreto che cosa fa un/una Senior Consultant - Business Consulting – Finance
In Business Consulting accompagniamo i nostri clienti lungo percorsi trasformativi in un’ottica end-to-end, offrendo valore di lungo termine attraverso le competenze, le soluzioni, gli strumenti e l’innovazione di EY. Aiutiamo a risolvere le sfide complesse delle organizzazioni bancarie che affrontano il cambiamento nell'era digitale, ridisegnando e trasformando strategie e modelli di business, stimolando la crescita, generando l’efficienza, rispondendo ai nuovi needs regolamentari e superando le sfide operative. Nello specifico, il nostro team si occupa di progetti di trasformazione riguardanti principalmente gli ambiti Risk, Regulatory e Lending, con focus sulla gestione end-to-end degli stakeholder (business, IT, fornitori terzi) al fine di garantire la messa a terra delle iniziative nel rispetto delle scadenze progettuali.
Per cominciare, cerchiamo un professionista senior che abbia:
- Esperienze progettuali maturate presso primari istituti bancari in ambito IT con ruolo di Business Analyst/PMO
- Padronanza degli aspetti legati al mondo dati (nozioni di interfacciamento tra sistemi/motori, servizi online, costituzione basi dati, ETL, tracciati, aggregazione)
- Conoscenze pregresse dei mondi Regulatory e Risk inclusa la conoscenza delle principali metriche in ambito Credit Risk e Crediti
- Laurea in discipline ingegneristiche (gestionale, preferibilmente con esami svolti in ambito bancario e finanziario) o economiche
- Attitudine ad interfacciarsi direttamente con il cliente e dimostrata capacità organizzativa (ad es., raccolta e gestione di dati/evidenze a supporto della preparazione dei deliverables di sintesi)
- Un mindset analitico e spirito di squadra
- Capacità di utilizzo di Excel (la conoscenza del linguaggio SQL / SAS/ SAS Guide / Python costituirebbe un plus)
In EY potrai:
- Accelerare le tue competenze: Grazie a corsi e programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro, utilizzando tecnologie smart e applicazioni AI che ti liberano dalle attività ripetitive: da Copilot365 al tool proprietario EYQ, passando per PowerBI
- Allargare i tuoi orizzonti: Lavora in team internazionali, disponendo di un network di professionisti globali
- Dare il meglio di te: Investi costantemente nel tuo benessere personale e nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno.
Avrai infine l’opportunità di:
- accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati;
- partecipare a programmi di leadership.
Per la presente posizione è previsto un range retributivo compreso tra 34.000€ e 39.000€ definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rapporto di lavoro è regolato dal CCNL Commercio; il livello di inquadramento contrattuale e collettivo e la relativa disciplina applicabile saranno determinati in coerenza con l’esperienza e il profilo professionale della risorsa inserita nel processo di selezione.
In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico:
Le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva.
Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva, dove tutte le voci sono ascoltate e valorizzate: Together, all in.
Valorizziamo ogni forma di unicità — età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità e background socioeconomico — e assicuriamo che tutte le nostre offerte siano aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in linea con la legge italiana L.68/99.
Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile nel processo di selezione, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali esigenze o supporti di cui potresti avere bisogno.
EY | La nostra missione? Building a better working world
In EY ci occupiamo di consulenza direzionale, strategica, legale, tributaria, tecnologica, organizzativa e di revisione contabile. Lo facciamo attraverso un network mondiale di servizi professionali presente in oltre 150 Paesi in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo un Team di oltre 9.000 persone, distribuite in 20 città in tutta Italia.
Crediamo fortemente nella creazione di valore a lungo termine, attraverso una crescita economica che sia inclusiva e sostenibile per tutti, dai colleghi ai clienti, dall'ambiente alla società.

GOV :
Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.
It has multiple fields of play such as:
Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
Business Transformation - a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.
Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.

- Bachelor of Commerce

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1685451
Competitive business today is all about making intelligent, informed decisions. As an Associate within EY-Parthenon you will help make that happen. You will be an important part of our diversely talented, highly experienced team. From Mauritius, we support a uniquely diverse portfolio of clients across Africa and EMEIA - from major corporates to fast-growing mid-market companies and family-owned businesses. Our projects can range from defining a comprehensive strategy for the C-Suite, designing operating models for regional conglomerates, to supporting SMEs in their international expansion and governmental and global instances on economic development.
The opportunity
In today’s complex business landscape, creativity has become a necessary ingredient for sustained success. EY-Parthenon Strategy has an ideal balance of strengths – deep and concentrated skills with broad executional capabilities, intimate client relationships with larger networks of support, and proven processes along with a progressive spirit to unlock opportunity for our clients, amplify the impact of our strategies, and make EY-Parthenon Strategy the global advisor of choice for business leaders. You have the opportunity to develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring and formal learning. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities.
Joining EY-Parthenon Mauritius means contributing to one of the fastest-growing strategy practices focused on Africa. It is an opportunity to shape high-impact strategies, work directly with senior decision-makers, and play an active role in driving transformation across the continent, combining intellectual rigor, entrepreneurial energy, and real on-the-ground impact.
What’s in it for you?
- You will gain a unique global and Africa-focused exposure across Mauritius, Madagascar, Kenya, Rwanda, South Africa, Morocco, Côte d'Ivoire, and beyond.
- You will take on a strategic role at the intersection of leadership alignment, culture, operations, and human performance.
- You will work directly with C-suite executives, sponsors, and business leaders.
- You will benefit from accelerated career growth within a fast-expanding strategy practice.
- You will have access to EY’s global transformation frameworks, accelerators, and learning programmes.
- You will join an entrepreneurial environment where you help shape and scale the transformation capabilities of the Mauritius practice
Skills and attributes for success
- Performing secondary research using a variety of sources (e.g., analyst reports, market research reports, news articles)
- Executing various analyses (e.g., customer segmentation, market sizing, competitor analysis, macroeconomic forecasting) to support the strategic recommendations
- Designing and executing in-depth interview guides with key organizational stakeholders, industry experts and customers
- Reviewing business plans to identify key assumptions and drivers
To qualify for the role, you must have
- A bachelor’s degree in business, economics, finance, or STEM, along with 2-3 years of experience in strategy consulting or a related field
- Outstanding academic performance, including coursework relevant to the position, preferably including quantitative courses in mathematics, business, economics, biologic sciences or engineering
- Ideally some related work experience through internships
- Demonstrated interest in related fields through internships, coursework or extracurricular activities
- A strong aptitude for quantitative and qualitative research and analysis
- Proficient in English and French, including the ability to listen, understand, read and communicate effectively both in writing and verbally in a professional environment
- Willingness to travel to meet client obligations
Ideally, you’ll also have
- Excellent problem solving, project management, facilitation and interpersonal skills.
- Willing and able to learn and work independently with minimal supervision
- Effective organization and time management skills with ability to work under pressure and adhere to project deadlines
- Able to multitask and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment
We are excited about the impact you will have on organizations in Mauritius and beyond!

La oportunidad:
EY es una firma global líder en auditoría, consultoría, estrategia y transacciones, y servicios legales y fiscales, que acompaña a organizaciones públicas y privadas en sus retos más complejos.
En EY:
- Apostamos por la innovación continua
- Desarrollamos talento a largo plazo dentro de equipos multidisciplinares

El área de Climate Change & Sustainability Services (CCaSS) ayuda a las empresas a abordar la crisis climática, la pérdida de la biodiversidad y la desigualdad. Tendrás la oportunidad de involucrarte en el desarrollo de soluciones innovadoras en sostenibilidad estratégica, regulación ESG, reporting y transformación operativa, con creciente foco en cadena de suministro, diligencia debida y generación de valor tangible, así como trabajar con equipos multidisciplinares y construir relaciones duraderas con los clientes.
Como Consultor/a de Sostenibilidad (Estrategia, Transformación y Reporting), te involucrarás en el diseño y desarrollo de soluciones de sostenibilidad para clientes, aportando una visión creativa, estructurada y orientada a la generación de valor. Participarás en la transformación de estrategias en planes de acción y narrativas sólidas que faciliten la toma de decisiones. Asimismo, colaborarás en procesos de verificación de EINF y en el análisis de la consistencia y calidad de la información reportada.
Tus funciones principales:
- Apoyar en el diseño de estrategias, planes de acción y hojas de ruta de sostenibilidad para clientes.
- Realizar benchmarks, análisis de tendencias y revisión de buenas prácticas sectoriales.
- Contribuir a la definición de narrativas, mensajes clave y materiales de presentación para cliente.
- Participar en talleres, entrevistas y dinámicas de trabajo con equipos internos y clientes.
- Apoyar la elaboración de entregables de consultoría con enfoque estructurado, visual y orientado a impacto.
- Identificar oportunidades de mejora e iniciativas innovadoras que conecten sostenibilidad y negocio.
- Coordinar información con diferentes áreas y asegurar coherencia entre objetivos, iniciativas y KPIs.
- Utilizar herramientas digitales para análisis, gestión de información, visualización y preparación de propuestas.

Job Description & Summary
Job Overview:
This position is for an Associate to be part of a fast-growing Strategy& practice within our Advisory Acceleration Centre.
Strategy& (S&) is our global strategy consulting business. It is a specialist team within PwC that combines strategy consulting capabilities with leading industry and sector insights and know-how. The team helps clients identify and build the capabilities essential to their advantage, and develop strategies based on these capabilities.
S& serves four main go-to-market channels: Deal Execution (M&A), Post-Deal Value Creation, Portfolio Companies, Corporate and Public Sector Clients (non-deals) across industries (including Technology, Media, Telco, Consumer Products, Retail, Industrials, Professional Services, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, Pharma).
The Deals channel is the largest channel for our UK team. Our work shapes the M&A landscape by supporting private equity (PE) and corporate clients in developing investment perspectives and value creation strategies that make a difference in the highly competitive M&A market.
We serve PE clients with over £2.5 trillion in assets under management, and publicly traded companies with a combined market capitalisation of over £4 trillion. From initial investment strategy development to commercial due diligence, value creation post-close and exit, we’re here to help our clients drive growth.
The S& Acceleration Centre in India is a specialist team within our broader PwC Kolkata Acceleration Centre that plays a critical role working with the UK team in project preparation and executing, including all responsibilities typically required of a UK-based team member from Experienced Associate to Manager. This includes analysis, research, output creation, presentation and discussion.
Responsibilities include:
- Work in a team setting on delivery modules such as market analysis (sizing, forecasting, etc.), competitive analysis (benchmarking, differentiation, landscape analysis), business plan analysis, customer and financial analysis, survey analysis, website scraping, industry research, etc.
- Conduct rigorous analysis in Microsoft Excel, and produce client-ready output in Microsoft PowerPoint
- Ability to build solid and collaborative relationships with team members
- Proactively assist the team in various aspects of the client engagement
- Contribute to the development of your own and team’s technical and functional acumen
- Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct
Other areas:
- Contribute to practice enablement and business development activities
- Learning new tools and technologies including generative AI (genAI) as required
- Develop/implement automation solutions and capabilities that are aligned to clients’ business requirements
- Develop internal relationships to build trust in an effort to develop and market the KAC brand
- Keep up to date with local and global business and economic issues
- Staying in the loop and on top of the latest M&A trends
Desired Experience and Skills:
- 2 to 3 years of industry experience
- Relevant experience in private equity, commercial due diligence, target screening and / or M&A advisory is an asset
- Ability to understand, contextualise, and solve commercial problems through independent analysis and research
- Ability to work as an integrated team member with the UK team in delivering client work
- Effective written and excellent verbal business communication skills when interacting with team members and/or clients in a professional setting
- Multi-tasking and balancing time effectively, keeping a rapid pace without sacrificing quality
- Relevant experience in conducting primary research (including desktop research, surveys and web scraping) and secondary research is an asset
- Relevant experience in analysis of complex data (e.g. survey outputs, financial statements, business plans) is an asset
- Relevant experience in creating client-ready deliverables including PowerPoint slides and reports is an asset
- Experience in using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint is required, and experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI and other similar tools is an asset
Desired Soft Skills:
- Strong work ethic, proactive and professional behaviour
- Strategic and creative thinker, problem solver
Educational Background:
- MBA from premier B-Schools (preferred)
- Strong academic credentials, analytical ability and leadership skills
Additional Information:
- Time type: Full time
- Work timings: Work hours may vary for specific projects
- Travel requirements: None
- Past experience: Past experience in consulting and exposure to a multinational environment will be an added bonus.

Not Specified

jd_text:
#KGS
Consultant Pricing Strategy
About us
The position in discussion is with the Deal Advisory team at KPMG Global Services (KGS), which is KPMG’s global delivery centre and is an integral part of the firm’s strategy to enhance innovation, build scalability, and improve profitability, globally.
KGS’ Deal Advisory Group is a team of 1500+ professionals, with three offices in Gurgaon, Mumbai and Bangalore.
KGS DA has been providing solutions to KPMG member firms globally. Leveraging insights and applying best practices, the team helps create customized approaches to M&A transactions. The team’s capabilities include Corporate Finance, Transaction Services, Strategy, Business Modeling, Accounting Advisory Services, Deal Advisory Research and Benchmarking
About the team
The Strategy team works with C-level Executives to identify, structure and solve their most critical strategic issues across the economic and transaction cycles. As part of a fast-paced and dynamic group, our consultants offer strategic advice on financial, business and operating models to corporate, public sector and private equity clients.
KGS Strategy team in India is organized by sectoral and functional capabilities to provide practical and actionable recommendations that can be delivered by the client in a cost-effective manner, both in a deal and non-deal environment. Key member firms with which KGS Strategy team works include KPMG UK and KPMG US.
About the role
Within the Strategy team we have an established Pricing strategy practice, serving number of sectors including retail, consumer goods, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, transport and industrial manufacturing sectors serving US, and other international clients. We work with C-level executives to identify, structure and solve their most critical strategic issues related to deal strategy, and growth strategy.
KPMG’s Pricing strategy practice is a specialised team focused on solving pricing and revenue optimisation problems for its clients using data and analytics techniques to deliver a sustainable solution which can deliver both short- and long-term margin improvements. As a team, we are a group of bright committed individuals who are passionate about delivering fantastic client work, solving complex data related problems, investing our time in acquiring new analytical skills, and having fun both inside and outside of work.
Responsibilities:
We are recruiting for a consultant with Pricing / Data Analytics experience. The role is currently part of KPMG’s Pricing Strategy team based in India that works closely with KPMG US and includes following core responsibilities:
- Work collaboratively with senior onshore stakeholders and client teams, in the development and implementation of pricing strategy, solutions/ recommendations
- Support in developing proposals and enhancing sales strategies for potential clients
- Understand client system and data structures and designing and executing data intensive analysis to support development of evidence-based insights
- Managing engagement work-streams and analysis, including defining deliverables, setting timelines, and develop high quality output, taking responsibility for teams when required
- Leverage analytical tools & platforms such as Alteryx, Power BI, Python etc. to manage large data sets and drive insights
- Develop documentation and insights in PowerPoint decks
- Plan and undertake primary and secondary research to develop insightful analysis for clients
- Implementation of solutions/tools in client environment and train client to implement new approach and appropriate tools
- Contributing to thought leadership and knowledge management to support practice development
Required qualifications:
- Education/professional qualifications: MBAs/ B. tech/ B.E. from a leading Indian/International educational institution
- Extensive professional experience (minimum of 2-3 years) in strategy or analytics roles, acquired from corporate positions, analytic boutique firms, or strategic consulting firms
- Minimum of 2 years of specific experience in pricing strategy and revenue optimization, handling complex pricing problems and developing effective strategies
Required key Skills:
- Experience in business research and data analytics with strong understanding of databases and data manipulation (data cleansing, aggregation and summary)
- Experience of complex modelling and analysis by using tools such as Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL, etc.
- Proven ability to identify complex pricing problems, develop innovative solutions, and implement effective pricing strategies to drive business growth and profitability
- In-depth understanding of pricing methodologies, including value-based pricing, cost-based pricing, competitive pricing, dynamic pricing, and pricing optimization
Preferred skills:
- Good to have hands-on experience in developing Python codes (using IDEs like Spyder, Jupyter, etc.) and working with python libraries Pandas, Numpy, Scipy etc.
- Experience in designing/implementing machine learning models for pricing applications including but not limited to price elasticity models, forecasting, customer segmentation, linear regression, logistic regression, random forest etc.
- Possesses strong numerical, analytical, and strategic skills, with sound commercial acumen
Responsibilities
- Conduct pricing strategy and revenue optimization analyses using large and complex datasets to identify pricing opportunities, assess market dynamics, and develop data-driven recommendations that enhance profitability and growth.
- Leverage analytics tools such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, and Power BI to perform data cleansing, modeling, forecasting, customer segmentation, and pricing optimization while translating insights into impactful client deliverables and executive presentations.
- Collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams to develop and implement pricing solutions, manage project workstreams, support business development initiatives, and deliver strategic recommendations for clients across diverse industries.
Qualifications
3+ years of experience in pricing, analytics or revenue strategy

The Senior Consultant will support the delivery of business transformation initiatives within the Financial Services (FS) sector, with a focus on banking and insurance. This role contributes to meeting growing client demand by driving execution excellence, supporting cross-functional coordination, and enabling effective collaboration across client engagements and software/vendor partnership models.
- Support the execution of FS transformation initiatives by applying structured delivery approaches, using standardized methodologies and tools, and contributing to the management of timelines, deliverables, and quality outcomes.
- Lead specific workstreams or project modules, including planning, execution, stakeholder coordination, issue escalation, and quality assurance of deliverables.
- Coordinate across business, technology, data, and operations teams to facilitate collaboration across workstreams and ensure aligned, integrated delivery.
- Work closely with client stakeholders and software vendors to support coordinated, multi-party delivery, ensuring effective communication and timely resolution of implementation challenges.

- Support business analysis, requirements gathering, operating model design, customer journey assessment, process improvement, and implementation-related activities.
- Assist in program execution by tracking risks, issues, dependencies, actions, decisions, and progress, while contributing to governance, reporting, and adherence to delivery standards.
- Support and mentor junior consultants, including reviewing analysis, documentation, and project deliverables.
- Contribute to practice development by supporting the development of deliverables, reusable assets, proposal materials, client credentials, and internal knowledge assets.
To qualify for the role, you must have
- MBA / Bachelor’s degree in business administration, finance, economics, engineering, information systems, or any related fields.
- 3–5 years of consulting or industry experience in business transformation, process improvement, operating model, customer experience, or technology-enabled transformation initiatives.
- Demonstrated experience supporting delivery of transformation programs within banking and/or insurance sectors.
- Experience leading business analysis, process redesign, implementation, or project delivery workstreams within larger transformation programs.
- Good understanding of business operations, with exposure to areas such as process improvement, operating model design, customer journey design, system implementation, Agile delivery, and/or Waterfall delivery.
- Awareness of industry trends and emerging technologies, including digital, automation, data analytics, and AI in Financial Services.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and structured thinking skills.

Highly motivated individuals with good problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. - Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, on your way
- Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching, and confidence to be the leader the world needs

- Design, build, and maintain automated workflows in Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Power Automate to support supply chain risk assessment intake, routing, notifications, and approval processes
- Support the modernization of legacy analytical tools by maintaining and enhancing Microsoft Access (MS Access)-based databases, processes, and reporting workflows
- Develop and sustain Microsoft Power BI dashboards that provide users and program stakeholders with exposure, contract, and operational analytics
- Integrate, import, and validate data from multiple sources, including procurement, commercial, government, and intelligence-related data sets, into centralized repositories and reporting solutions
- Support the use of human-reviewed Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) tools to accelerate data ingestion, draft risk assessment outputs, and identify data anomalies

- Effective written and verbal communication skills
- Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
- Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
- Ability to lead projects or workstreams
- Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
- Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
- Ability to meet deadlines
- Ability to provide clear guidance to others
The Team
Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Our Supply Chain & Network Operations offering advises, implements, and operates transformational solutions that bring world class supply network capabilities.
The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.
Qualifications
Required:
- Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, information systems, business, data analytics, engineering, or a related field
- 3+ years of experience developing and maintaining Microsoft Access (MS Access) databases, queries, forms, or reports
- 3+ years of experience building automated workflows using Microsoft Power Automate and Microsoft SharePoint
- 3+years of experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions in Microsoft Power BI
- 3+ years of experience integrating, importing, or validating data from procurement, contract, logistics, or operational data sources, including Federal Procurement Data System (FPDS) or USAspending.gov
- Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
Preferred:
- 3+ years of experience supporting supply chain risk management, logistics operations, or defense supply chain analytics
- 2+ years of experience using Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) tools in human-in-the-loop workflows
- 3+ years of experience automating risk assessment outputs using structured data
- 2+ years of experience supporting federal, defense, or government clients
- 3+ years of experience working with cloud-based workflow modernization or enterprise data integration initiatives

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1725478
Procurement & Strategic Sourcing Senior Consultant
Location: Katowice - 2 days in office / 3 days remote
Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Consultant with an expertise in Procurement and Sourcing to join our team at EY GDS-SC&O. This is a remarkable chance to work with a top-tier company and play a key role in expanding the range of new service offering.
The opportunity
By joining our team, you will assist clients in enhancing their supply chain efficiency. Utilizing EY GDS-SC&O's proprietary frameworks, you will help clients to improve the reliability, flexibility, and responsiveness of their supply chain while reducing the total cost. Your responsibilities will involve creating an operating model, re-engineering procurement processes, optimizing working capital, performing rapid assessments, building assets/tools, and coming up with thought leadership.
Your key responsibilities
- Deliver consulting engagements across procurement strategy, operating model design, category management, sourcing optimization, and procurement transformation.
- Collaborate with the extended teams and clients to design and implement effective supply chain transformation projects for diverse industries.
- Perform advanced spend analytics to identify value creation opportunities. Translate procurement and operational data into strategic recommendations to enhance competitiveness, reduce costs, and optimize the supply chain.
- Assess the maturity level of procurement processes and initiate improvements to the current processes and systems/technologies.
- Conduct procurement benchmarking across operating models, organization structures, processes, sourcing outcomes, and supplier rates and develop fact-based recommendations.
- Assess procurement operating models and design future-state target governance frameworks, organizational structures, capability requirements, and sourcing delivery models.
- Support strategic category management through fact-based market intelligence. Analyze supplier markets, industry trends, inflationary pressures, and cost drivers.
- Review and validate data and further build optimization models, analytical reports, dashboards and presentations.
- Support digital procurement and AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Evaluate and implement procurement technologies and automation opportunities.
- Acquire knowledge of new age procurement tools; such as Ariba, COUPA, Ivalua, SAP MM, PP etc. and work on process design/ reengineering/ implementation projects related to the process and/or tool.
Skills and attributes for success
- Experience in strategic procurement, category management (direct and/or indirect spend), procurement excellence, procurement systems
- Effective communication skills and experience in customer-facing role
- Ability to work independently and proactively
To qualify for the role, you must have
- Minimum 5 years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, procurement transformation, category management, or supply chain advisory.
- Knowledge of Procurement Methodologies: Procurement Matrix, Vendor selection and evaluation methods
- Sourcing, offer analysis and benchmarking
- Strategic approach and negotiation skills
- Understanding of legal and contractual requirements
- Expertise in end-to-end procurement process covering one or more of the following areas: spend analytics, E2E process redesign, Source to Contract, Procure to Pay, data integration, etc.
- Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
- Entrepreneurial mindset, design thinking and passion for improvement and optimization
Ideally, you’ll also have
- Experience in Data Visualization using Tableau /Power BI / QlikView etc.
- System Knowledge like Ariba, Coupa, SAP modules etc.
- Knowledge of other languages (German, French) will be an additional asset
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
- Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Job Description
Job Overview:
This position is for a Senior Associate to be part of a fast-growing Strategy& practice within our Advisory Acceleration Centre.
Strategy& (S&) is our global strategy consulting business. It is a specialist team within PwC that combines strategy consulting capabilities with leading industry and sector insights and know-how. The team helps clients identify and build the capabilities essential to their advantage, and develop strategies based on these capabilities.
S& serves four main go-to-market channels: Deal Execution (M&A), Post-Deal Value Creation, Portfolio Companies, Corporate and Public Sector Clients (non-deals) across industries (including Technology, Media, Telco, Consumer Products, Retail, Industrials, Professional Services, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, Pharma).
The Deals channel is the largest channel for our UK team. Our work shapes the M&A landscape by supporting private equity (PE) and corporate clients in developing investment perspectives and value creation strategies that make a difference in the highly competitive M&A market.
We serve PE clients with over £2.5 trillion in assets under management, and publicly traded companies with a combined market capitalisation of over £4 trillion. From initial investment strategy development to commercial due diligence, value creation post-close and exit, we’re here to help our clients drive growth.
The S& Acceleration Centre in India is a specialist team within our broader PwC Kolkata Acceleration Centre that plays a critical role working with the UK team in project preparation and executing, including all responsibilities typically required of a UK-based team member from Experienced Associate to Manager. This includes analysis, research, output creation, presentation and discussion.

- Help create and review delivery modules such as market analysis (sizing, forecasting, etc.), competitive analysis (benchmarking, differentiation, landscape analysis), business plan analysis, customer and financial analysis, survey analysis, website scraping, industry research, and more

- Assist with KAC team onboarding and training programmes
- Contribute to the development of your own and team’s technical and functional acumen
- Demonstrate critical thinking, an ability to bring order to unstructured problems, and excellent commercial acumen

- Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct

- Learning new tools and technologies including generative AI (genAI) as required
- Develop/implement automation solutions and capabilities that are aligned to clients’ business requirements
- Know how and when to use tools available for a given situation and explain reasons for this choice
- Develop internal relationships to build trust in an effort to develop and market the KAC brand
- Keep up to date with local and global business and economic issues
- Use feedback and reflection to develop self-awareness, personal strengths and address development areas
- Use straightforward communication, in a structured way, when influencing and connecting with others

- Relevant experience in creating client-ready deliverables including PowerPoint slides and reports required
- Experience in using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint is required, and experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI and other similar tools is an asset
- Multi-tasking and balancing time effectively, keeping a rapid pace without sacrificing quality

- Strong academic credentials, analytical ability and leadership skills

1721060
Business Transformation Senior Consultant

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
Se cerchi un percorso di crescita in un contesto internazionale dove le tue idee contano davvero, sei nel posto giusto. In un contesto in cui l'intelligenza artificiale sta ridefinendo il modo di lavorare, crediamo che il vero valore nasca dalla capacità delle persone di interpretare la complessità, costruire relazioni di fiducia e trasformare le opportunità tecnologiche in impatto concreto per clienti, organizzazioni e società.
Perché candidarsi in EY?
Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti:
-
Investimento sulle competenze del futuro: In EY la tecnologia non sostituisce il contributo delle persone: lo amplifica. Per questo investiamo nello sviluppo di competenze, relazioni e capacità di giudizio che permettono di affrontare le sfide più complesse e generare valore sostenibile nel tempo. Fin dal primo giorno, avrai accesso a eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, per imparare a usare la tecnologia come leva per amplificare il tuo impatto.
-
Formazione continua: oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona; per integrare apprendimento e lavoro quotidiano, trasformando ogni progetto in un’occasione di crescita.
-
Sviluppo e progressione di carriera: solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera; con percorsi in cui competenze, potenziale e contributo individuale diventano elementi centrali.
-
Mobilità e opportunità internazionali, compresa la possibilità di lavorare in smart working dall’estero fino a 20 giorni senza essere in trasferta;
-
Lavoro ibrido senza giornate prestabilite centralmente.
-
Un network internazionale su cui poter contare.
Vuoi dare forma al tuo futuro insieme a noi? Scopri nel concreto che cosa fa un Business Transformation Senior Consultant in ambito Road&Transportation in EY!
Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:
- Supportare nell’analisi e nel ridisegno di processi, procedure e definizione di modelli organizzativi e operativi dei clienti;
- Effettuare attività di benchmark e analisi di mercato su operatori di mercato nazionali e internazionali;
- Supportare nel processo di ideazione e sviluppo di use cases su servizi innovativi, dalla fase concettuale fino all'implementazione;
- Eseguire analisi e design di nuovi KPI di business e di processo;
- Effettuare attività di analisi dati per monitoraggio delle performance ed identificazione di tendenze/opportunità
- Svolgere attività di PMO, pianificazione e governance di progetti, definendo report e presentazioni di SAL operativi e direzionali
- Guidare i consulenti junior, favorendo un ambiente collaborativo e orientato alla crescita
Per cominciare, cerchiamo un professionista senior che abbia:
- Esperienza 2-3 anni in primarie società di consulenza o in società operanti nel settore delle infrastrutture, trasporti, logistica, multiutilities;
- Aver preso parte in progetti di PMO, digital transformation, business process design;
- Utilizzo di programmi come Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point, Power BI per la creazione di report e dashboard dinamiche e interattive;
- Ottime capacità di comunicazione e relazione interpersonale;
- Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale, in modo collaborativo, virtuale e indipendente;
- Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e con scadenze ravvicinate, gestendo le priorità in modo efficace;
- Ottima conoscenza di italiano e inglese.
In EY potrai:
- Accelerare le tue competenze: Grazie a corsi e programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro, utilizzando tecnologie smart e applicazioni AI che ti liberano dalle attività ripetitive: da Copilot365 al tool proprietario EYQ, passando per PowerBI
- Allargare i tuoi orizzonti: Lavora in team internazionali, disponendo di un network di professionisti globali
- Dare il meglio di te: Investi costantemente nel tuo benessere personale e nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno.
Avrai infine l’opportunità di:
- accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati;
- partecipare a programmi di leadership.

In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico:
Le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva.

EY | La nostra missione? Building a better working world

Lo facciamo attraverso un network mondiale di servizi professionali presente in oltre 150 Paesi in tutto il mondo. Crediamo fortemente nella creazione di valore a lungo termine, attraverso una crescita economica che sia inclusiva e sostenibile per tutti, dai colleghi ai clienti, dall'ambiente alla società.

Senior Business Consultant - Logistics & Supply Chain Transformation
Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.
The opportunity
EY GDS is a global leader in delivering value-added Digital Supply Chain and Operations Transformation services to clients across industries. As organizations continue to rethink their supply chains to improve resilience, efficiency and customer service, there is a growing demand for professionals who can combine logistics domain expertise with strong consulting capabilities.
As a Senior Business Consultant, you will work with clients to assess, redesign and optimize logistics and supply chain operations. You will support strategic and operational initiatives across transportation, warehousing, inventory management, distribution networks and end-to-end supply chain processes, helping organizations improve performance and drive sustainable business value.
This role offers the opportunity to work on large-scale transformation programs, operational assessments, strategy engagements and process improvement initiatives while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across geographies and industries.
Your key responsibilities
- Conduct logistics and supply chain assessments to identify operational inefficiencies, improvement opportunities and value creation potential
- Analyze current-state business processes and design future-state operating models across transportation, warehousing and inventory management functions
- Lead workshops, interviews and stakeholder discussions to gather business requirements and define transformation roadmaps
- Support clients in developing supply chain and logistics strategies aligned with business objectives and growth plans
- Evaluate logistics operating models, organizational structures and governance frameworks.
- Perform supply chain diagnostics and benchmarking exercises using industry leading practices and performance indicators
- Analyze logistics networks, transportation operations and warehouse processes to identify optimization opportunities
- Develop business cases and value assessments for transformation initiatives.
- Prepare executive presentations, reports and recommendations for senior client stakeholders
- Support business development activities, proposals, client pursuits and thought leadership initiatives
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams supporting supply chain, operations, technology and transformation programs
- Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies and leading practices in logistics and supply chain management
Skills and attributes for success
- Strong understanding of logistics and supply chain processes, including transportation, warehousing, inventory management and distribution operations
- Ability to analyze complex business challenges and develop practical, value-driven recommendations
- Experience facilitating workshops, stakeholder interviews and business process assessments
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities supported by quantitative and qualitative analysis skills
- Ability to structure and communicate insights effectively to business and executive stakeholders
- Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Excellent communication and presentation skills in client-facing environments.
- Self-driven, collaborative and client-focused mindset with a passion for operational excellence and continuous improvement
To qualify for the role, you must have
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field
- 5+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain consulting, operations transformation or process improvement initiatives
- Experience conducting business assessments, operational reviews, maturity assessments or strategic transformation projects
- Strong knowledge of supply chain and logistics operating models and industry leading practices
- Experience working directly with business stakeholders and senior leadership teams.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and presentation development capabilities
- Experience developing recommendations, business cases and transformation roadmaps based on quantitative and qualitative findings
Ideally, you’ll also have
- Experience in Manufacturing, Retail, Consumer Products, Automotive, Life Sciences or Distribution industries
- Exposure to transportation management, warehouse management, inventory optimization or supply chain planning processes
- Experience supporting business development activities, client pursuits and proposal preparation
- Knowledge of supply chain network design, logistics optimization and performance management methodologies
- Exposure to digital transformation and emerging supply chain technologies.
- Experience working in international and multicultural project environments
- Professional certifications related to Supply Chain, Logistics, Lean, Six Sigma or Project Management
What we look for
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand client challenges and transform them into actionable recommendations
- Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to continuously learn new business concepts, methodologies and industry practices
- Adaptability and willingness to thrive in dynamic, fast-paced and evolving client environments
- Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities
- Proactive, results-oriented and solution-focused approach to problem solving
- Ability to work effectively within diverse and geographically distributed teams
- Strong collaboration, communication and knowledge-sharing skills
- Passion for delivering measurable business outcomes and operational excellence
- Excellent oral and written communication skills. Professional proficiency in English is mandatory, while knowledge of additional languages will be considered a valuable asset
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across ten locations – Argentina, China, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
- Continuous learning:You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
- Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

jd_text:
Position Summary
Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team delivers integrated, end-to-end support and advisory services covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, government operations modernization, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. Work alongside clients every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and provide practical solutions at every stage of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
Work You’ll Do
We are seeking an experienced Government Sector Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate will bring deep experience in the critical minerals ecosystem (e.g., exploration, extraction, processing/refining, separation, recycling, supply chain, and end-use demand), and a strong understanding of how government programs, policy, and funding mechanisms shape efforts across supply chain resilience and innovation across the critical minerals value chain. This role requires a strategic thinker, with the ability to work independently, mentor junior staff, and provide clear, actionable briefings to senior leaders on key critical minerals issues, risks, and opportunities.
The Team
Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.
Our Sustainability, Infrastructure, Real Estate, & Resilience offering advises clients on climate and disaster-related risks through comprehensive strategy, planning, and crisis management, while also providing expertise in capital investments, infrastructure projects, and real estate portfolio optimization.
Qualifications
Required:
- Bachelor’s degree in geology, chemical engineering, industrial engineering, geology, earth sciences, or other relevant engineering/science field; Master’s degree preferred.
- 2+ years of experience working on matters related to the strategic materials ecosystem or critical minerals value chain.
- Must be located in Washington, DC and able to work part-time onsite.
- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
- Ability to travel up to 40% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Preferred
- Demonstrated ability to succinctly brief senior leaders on critical minerals topics, including supply risk, industrial capability, and value-chain bottlenecks.
- Comfortable working on a team, communicating with clients, preparing technical deliverables, and working efficiently across multiple workstreams.
- Experience collaborating with junior staff to structure analyses, quality-check outputs, and deliver research and operational activities.
- Experience publishing in technical journals, conducting academic/applied research, or supporting R&D processes.
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $93,200 to $155,400
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Benefits
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
Our people and culture
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. This role combines CRM process design, sales effectiveness improvement, requirements structuring, delivery support, and stakeholder coordination. You will work with client teams to assess current-state sales and CRM processes, identify improvement opportunities, support solution design, and help implement CRM-enabled workflows that improve pipeline discipline, customer engagement, forecasting quality, and sales productivity.

Job Description & Summary
Kia ora,
Be a catalyst for transformation. Shape the future at PwC New Zealand.
At PwC, our purpose is clear: to build trust in society and solve important problems.
This is a place to keep growing. You’ll learn from the best, take on meaningful challenges, and make a lasting impact for our clients, our communities, and Aotearoa.
Ngā kōrero mo tēnei tūranga / About the role
Due to growth, we’re looking for a Senior Analyst to join our Finance and Operations Transformation team in Tāmaki Makaurau / Auckland.
In this role, you’ll focus on procurement and supply chain transformation engagements. Our team supports private and public sector clients across procurement strategy, operating model design, strategic sourcing, category management, supplier performance, cost optimisation and broader operations transformation.
Your day-to-day could include:
-
Working with clients on strategic procurement, supply chain and cost transformation programmes, helping shape and deliver initiatives that create lasting commercial and operational impact.
-
Tackling complex business and supply chain challenges, using data, structured problem solving and market insights to identify opportunities and develop practical solutions.
-
Developing new strategies and approaches across areas such as procurement, supply chain, operating models, cost optimisation and broader business transformation.
-
Turning analysis into clear insights, recommendations and compelling stories that support senior leaders to make informed decisions.
-
Working alongside client teams to translate strategy into action, supporting the design, implementation and delivery of transformation initiatives.
-
Building trusted relationships with clients and stakeholders, collaborating across organisations to solve problems and drive change.
-
Contributing to the growth of our practice by bringing new ideas, developing proposals and helping shape solutions for current and future clients.
Ngā pūkenga ka kawea mai e koe, ka whakawhanakehia rānei i tēnei tūranga / Skills you will bring or develop in this role
-
Around 3–5 years’ experience in consulting, procurement, supply chain, operations, commercial or another relevant business environment.
-
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work through complex or ambiguous problems and turn information into meaningful insights.
-
Experience contributing to projects, transformation programmes or initiatives focused on improving business performance, reducing cost or delivering better outcomes.
-
Commercial curiosity and an interest in understanding how organisations operate, how markets and suppliers work, and where opportunities for improvement exist.
-
Strong communication skills, with the ability to develop clear recommendations and communicate effectively with a range of stakeholders.
-
Confidence building relationships and working collaboratively with clients, colleagues and senior stakeholders.
-
An adaptable and proactive mindset, with the ability to learn quickly, take ownership and work across different clients, industries and challenges.
-
Curiosity about emerging technology, data and A.I., and how these can be used to transform the way organisations operate.
Ngā āhuatanga hirahira o te mahi ki PwC / Highlights of working at PwC NZ
Rewards - Discretionary bonus opportunities; generous referral bonuses; retail discounts & deals
Growth - Global network; leadership development; A.I. tools and training; formal learning pathways
Wellbeing - $250 annual wellbeing allowance; Life & income protection; Sonder/EAP/Headspace; 15 days’ paid sick leave; group-rate health insurance (eligibility applies)
Reputation - PwC is known for shaping tomorrow. Join us and you’ll accelerate your career while helping clients and communities solve their most important problems.
Flexibility - Flexible working; supportive coaching culture
Time off - Two paid recognition days off provided each year during our annual summer shutdown period; purchase up to two extra weeks’ annual leave
Whānau & community - Paid parental leave for all parents with flexible options and financial planning support; inclusive networks; paid volunteering leave

Hit Apply now. To learn how you can grow and shine in your career at PwC, visit our careers site at https://www.pwc.co.nz/careers.html.
Grow here. Go further.

Motuhake / Independence: Maintaining independence is fundamental to demonstrating that PwC has not been influenced by any relationships or situations that undermine our objectivity. This role requires an independence review process.

Requisition ID:
1645882
Technology Consulting - Technical Analyst, Senior Consultant
General Information
Location: Ireland - Dublin
Available for Work Visa Sponsorship: No
Business Area: UKI Tech consulting
Contract Type: Full-Time – Permanent
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you, we are counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
EY have a number of career opportunities available, and we are interested in meeting candidates who are looking for a new challenge, one where you can develop your range of skills significantly. Be that a move out of industry into practice, or from within practice into advisory services. We are looking for future leaders with a genuine creative vision and the confidence to make it happen. Our opportunities will allow you to apply your expertise to a variety of projects whilst offering you excellent career progression opportunities.
The Team and the opportunity
Here at EY you’ll work with a team of amazing Technologists who are always growing, learning, and adapting, in and out of the office. Technology is changing the world, and we’re at the centre of it all. With a team list that reads like a who's who in tech, and a highly disruptive business model, we’re advancing the art of team collaboration. Driven by honest values, an amazing culture, we’re out to unleash the potential of every team. We are looking for people like you who are powered by passion and eager to do the best work of their lives in a highly autonomous yet collaborative environment.
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
You will play a key role in supporting the development and strengthen existing client relationships and help our clients, who are leaders in the Financial Services industry, navigate the complex finance issues facing their business. As part of this growing team, you will also get to help shape the innovative culture that makes EY such a great place to work.
Your key responsibilities
- As a Technical Analyst, you will work with our clients to understand business goals and priorities, capture these as requirements and translate the requirements into key technical business artifacts.
- You will build valuable relationships with our clients through demonstrating exceptional delivery.
- You will have responsibility to help grow and win new business by contributing to proposals and client presentations.
- You will also get to draw on your skills and experience, creating innovative insights for clients looking to develop their change agenda to deliver value and improve their operations.
Skills and attributes for success
To qualify for the role, you must have
- At least 2 years’ experience within a consulting firm, industry or government organisation within the local, European or US market.
- Demonstrated continuous learning including a third level degree or equivalent, preferably in an IT related area
- Experience in one or more of our focus industries including Power & Utilities, Financial Services, Life Sciences, Health, TMT and Government & Public Sector
- Ability to effectively work across all phases of the project lifecycle.
- Experience in performing analysis, consulting, and providing recommendations to clients.
- Good knowledge of relevant technology concepts (e.g. cloud, databases, Business Intelligence, software development and integration)
- Strong communication skills, including prioritising, problem-solving and interpersonal relationship building
- Experience gathering, defining and documenting business and solution requirements for the enhancement, replacement, or introduction of IT systems
- Experience in Waterfall and/or Agile methodologies
Ideally, you will also have
- Experience in Functional Design
- Experience analysing systems and procedures, process design and modelling, and documenting ‘As is’ and ‘To be’ assessments for a Target Operating Model
- Experience in performing gap analysis and collaborating with technical resources on solution proposals, technical user manuals, system configuration documents and other technical reports
- Experience conducting workshops and interviews
- Experience with Stakeholder Management and working collaboratively with Development and Testing teams to deliver high quality solutions that meet client and user business needs
- Experience in the delivery of large-scale business/technology programmes
What working at EY offers
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
- Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around
- Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
- The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
All our employees are given a benefits package which they can tailor to suit their individual preferences. Our range of benefits include:
- Pension
- Maternity & Paternity leave
- Discounted health insurance
- Bike to work Scheme
- Web Doctor - Free unlimited online GP consultations for you and your family
- Recognition Awards
- The purchase of additional annual leave
- Cash incentives for referrals
- Hybrid Working
- Work Mobile
- Free Gym membership
- TECH MBA paid by EY
- Travel Pass
- Wellness rooms Available in some offices

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Du willst mehr als reine Strategieberatung? Du willst tiefer einsteigen als im klassischen M&A? Dann komm dorthin, wo beides zusammenläuft: Bei EY-Parthenon begleitest du CEOs, Vorstände und Private-Equity-Gesellschaften bei transaktionsbasierten Transformationen vom ersten strategischen Gedanken bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Hier arbeitest du an wegweisenden Projekten in vielfältigen Branchen: von der Neuausrichtung und Optimierung von Strategien bis hin zu transformativen Deals und Restrukturierungen. Mit datenbasierten Insights und dem gezielten Einsatz von KI-Technologien eröffnest du neue Märkte, treibst Wachstum voran und entwickelst Unternehmens- und Kapitalstrategien, die den entscheidenden Unterschied machen.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Mitglied unseres Healthcare-Teams an den Standorten Hamburg, Frankfurt/Main, Stuttgart, München, Berlin oder Düsseldorf gestaltest du die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens – strategisch, operativ und digital. Ob Transformation, Digitalisierung, Prozessoptimierung oder Restrukturierung: Du begleitest Projekte mit echtem Impact und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen passgenaue Lösungen für ein leistungsfähigeres, innovativeres Healthcare-System. In unserem Team wirst du vielfältige Aufgaben übernehmen, darunter:
- Du analysierst und erhebst fachliche Anforderungen in enger Abstimmung mit Kund:innen und Stakeholdern.
- Du übersetzt Anforderungen in strukturierte User Stories und begleitest deren Abstimmung über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg.
- Du erstellst und pflegst fachliche sowie technische Spezifikationen für digitaler Lösungen.
- Du moderierst Workshops zur Anforderungsdefinition, Prozessanalyse und gemeinsamen Lösungsfindung.
- Du stellst sicher, dass Anforderungen bis zur Implementierung nachvollziehbar, konsistent und qualitativ hochwertig umgesetzt werden.
Dein Skillset
- Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder einesvergleichbaren Studiengangs.
- Du bringst Kenntnisse im Requirements Engineering und Anforderungsmanagement mit und hast idealerweise bereits erste Erfahrung in IT- oder Digitalisierungsprojekten gesammelt.
- Du kommunizierst sehr sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch mindestens C1-Niveau – sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich.
Dein Mindset
- Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
- Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
- Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY-Parthenon arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.
