jd_text:
Position Summary
Our Deloitte Human Capital team helps organizations create value through people performance. We work with clients to reimagine work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise and to transform their HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today’s world, you will help clients answer questions like: How do I access, develop, and motivate my workforce? What should my AI strategy be for the HR function? Do I have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to make work better for humans and humans better at work.
Work You’ll Do
As a PMO OCM Analyst on the Organization, Workforce, & Change team, you will be responsible for:
- Translating complex project data and information into actionable insights, status updates, and client recommendations
- Developing clear, concise, and client-ready PowerPoint presentations, briefings, and written communications
- Coordinating PMO activities, including scheduling, meeting preparation, milestone tracking, action-item follow-up, and management of assigned deliverables
- Supporting client workshops, meetings, events, and site visits, including logistics, facilitation materials, and follow-up activities
- Collaborating on cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution while building consulting and delivery skills
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
- Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
- Effective written and verbal communication skills
- Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
- Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
- Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
- Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
- Ability to meet deadlines
- Ability to provide clear guidance to others
The Team
Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.
Our Organization, Workforce, & Change offering shapes market-leading organizational strategies, delivers impactful change, and generates client value through the workforce, while leveraging data-driven insights and exceptional delivery execution.
Qualifications
Required:
- Bachelor's degree
- 1+ years of experience in supporting change management, communications, or training activities, including stakeholder communications, written content development, and/or workshop facilitation support
- 1+ year of experience supporting project management office initiatives, including synthesizing complex project information, maintaining milestone and dependency tracking, elevating risks, and independently advancing assigned project activities
- Experience analyzing project data and synthesizing information into actionable business insights
- Experience in Microsoft PowerPoint, including developing and formatting client-ready presentations, executive communications, and meeting materials
- Ability to travel 80%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
Preferred:
- Experience supporting projects or client engagements in the Medicaid industry

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1743491
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The Opportunity
The financial services landscape is undergoing profound change. Banks and insurers are navigating heightened market volatility, rising cost of risk, evolving client expectations, competition from Tech and Fintech players, and an ever more demanding regulatory agenda — from Basel IV/CRR3-CRD6 and IFRS 9 to ECB supervisory priorities, IRB model reform, ESG and climate risk, and BCBS 239 data governance. In this environment, risk and credit are no longer just control functions — they are strategic levers for growth, capital efficiency and resilience.
At EY, we go further than simply helping our clients cope with these changes: we are part of the change, and we help shape the financial sector of the future. That is why we have built a strong Business Transformation competence team in Belgium, within which our Risk & Credits Transformation experts partner with financial institutions to modernize their credit and risk value chains — from origination and underwriting to monitoring, provisioning, remediation and reporting. Our goal is to help institutions turn regulatory pressure and risk complexity into competitive advantage, by co-creating pragmatic solutions, redesigning credit processes end-to-end, and delivering data-driven, technology-enabled risk assets.
Unlock the door to an exciting career with our Business Transformation team! We're looking for professionals brimming with enthusiasm to elevate their careers to new heights. Whether you're a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Project/Program Manager, or a Risk/Credit specialist, your expertise will be pivotal in steering transformative risk and credit strategies within the financial sector.
Key Responsibilities
Joining our Risk & Credits Transformation team means working shoulder-to-shoulder with clients to reshape their credit and risk operating models, translate complex regulatory requirements into workable business solutions, and deliver measurable improvements in risk management, capital and cost of risk. You'll play a pivotal role in growing our competence team and contributing to the broader success of EY.
As a Risk & Credits Transformation Consultant, your responsibilities will include:
- Designing and optimizing the end-to-end credit lifecycle across banking segments (Retail, SME, Corporate, Real Estate) — including origination, credit decisioning and underwriting, loan servicing, monitoring, early-warning, collections and workout.
- Supporting clients in interpreting and implementing regulatory and prudential change — e.g. Basel IV / CRR3-CRD6, IFRS 9 impairment, IRB model landscape, ECB / NBB expectations, loss data (LossDB) and RDARR / BCBS 239 requirements.
- Redesigning credit risk processes, policies and controls, embedding efficiency, automation and a strong risk-and-control mindset.
- Bridging business, risk and data: framing requirements for rating and provisioning models, credit data quality, risk reporting and management information.
- Ensuring the client's risk and business perspective stays central to the delivery of digital and data-driven solutions in the market.
- Participating in or managing projects and programs from inception to completion — including scoping, planning, budgeting, stakeholder management and team staffing (particularly at Manager level).
- For Manager profiles: leading workstreams and client relationships, coaching junior colleagues, and contributing to business development, proposals and thought leadership.
- Sharing your domain-specific knowledge and expertise to enhance our collective capabilities.
This is an opportunity to join a team that is not only responding to the transformation of risk and credit in financial services, but is actively leading it. If you're passionate about leveraging your experience to help shape the future of finance, we invite you to explore a career with EY Belgium's Business Transformation team.
Skills and Attributes for Success
- Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g. Economics, Finance, Commercial/Civil Engineering, Business, Mathematics or equivalent).
- Professional experience (typically 2 – 5 years for Consultant), in consulting and/or the financial sector, ideally in credit risk, risk management, or credit/lending transformation.
- Familiarity with one or more of the following is a strong asset: credit risk frameworks, IRB / rating models, IFRS 9, Basel / CRR-CRD, credit processes and lending products, risk data & reporting (BCBS 239 / RDARR), or regulatory remediation programs.
- An excellent knowledge of business English, and a solid level of French and/or Dutch.
- Strong team spirit, balanced by a healthy sense of autonomy.
- Excellent analytical skills, conceptual thinking and a pragmatic, delivery-oriented approach.
- Solid communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both business and risk stakeholders up to senior management (Manager level: proven stakeholder and team leadership).
- Certifications such as Agile, Scrum, PMP/Prince2, FRM, PRM or CFA are a differentiator for more experienced candidates.
- Knowledge of lending banking products and processes (e.g. Consumer Loans, Mortgages, Corporate & SME lending, Public Sector lending, Leasing, Factoring) is a major asset.
What working at EY offers
- You will be part of a leading global professional services firm.
- You will be part of the EY family where everyone is willing to offer support and senior management is very accessible.
- You will join a dynamic and growing team with a great mix of young and experienced professionals focusing on financial services.
- You will get extensive trainings on technical matters, as well as soft skills and project management, and you will have access to new technologies and innovative equipment.
- We are proud of our flexible working arrangements, and we will support you to build a successful career and deliver excellent client service, without sacrificing your personal priorities.
- While our client-facing profession might require part-time working at client site and business traveling at times, we are committed to helping you achieve a lifestyle balance
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1750517
Location: Anywhere in Country
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
Role Snapshot
Client-facing Life Sciences manufacturing professional who helps design, build, test, and deploy digital solutions for regulated plant operations. The role combines practical knowledge of manufacturing processes with hands-on skills in manufacturing systems, industrial data, integration, analytics, and AI-enabled workflows.
The Opportunity
As a Senior in Supply Chain Manufacturing, you will work with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical-device clients to connect production, quality, laboratory, engineering, and supply chain needs with deployable technology. You will contribute across the delivery lifecycle, from plant and system assessments through requirements, solution design, configuration support, testing, deployment, adoption, and stabilization.
You will work directly with operators, engineers, quality teams, IT and OT specialists, data teams, and technology providers. You will own assigned technical and functional deliverables, help resolve implementation issues, and make clear recommendations to your workstream lead. The role calls for someone who can examine a shop-floor workflow, trace the data and systems behind it, and turn what they learn into a design or testable requirement.
Your key responsibilities
In this role, you will:
- Assess manufacturing and quality workflows, user needs, system interfaces, equipment data, and current-state pain points through site observations, interviews, workshops, and data review.
- Document process flows, user stories, functional requirements, data mappings, interface requirements, controls, and acceptance criteria for digital manufacturing solutions.
- Support the design and implementation of capabilities such as manufacturing execution, electronic batch records and electronic device history records (eDHRs), recipe and routing management, batch and unit genealogy, review by exception, connected-worker workflows, and plant performance reporting.
- Trace information across relevant systems, including MES/MOM, ERP, LIMS, QMS, historians, SCADA, DCS/PLC, and asset-management platforms; identify data gaps, inconsistent definitions, and integration dependencies.
- Develop and review equipment and batch hierarchies, source-to-target mappings, data-quality rules, and contextualized datasets with manufacturing, automation, and data specialists.
- Work with solution architects and engineers on interface specifications, APIs, industrial connectivity, and the movement of data between plant, edge, and enterprise environments.
- Configure or prototype solution components where appropriate to your experience and the engagement, and document design decisions for review by technical and client leads.
- Prepare and execute functional and integration test scripts, record defects, support resolution and retesting, and maintain traceability between requirements and test evidence.
- Support deployment readiness, cutover, user training, hypercare, and handover by preparing clear technical documentation and responding to issues from plant users.
- Partner with client quality and validation teams to prepare or review applicable documentation concerning GxP, data integrity, electronic records, change control, and computer system validation or risk-based assurance.
- Contribute to analytics and AI use cases by assessing source-data quality, defining manufacturing context, checking outputs against operational workflows, and documenting where human review is needed.
- Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and recommended next steps to client counterparts and engagement leaders; coordinate defined tasks with junior colleagues when needed.
Skills and attributes for success
To thrive in this role, you should be able to work in depth in at least one technical area while collaborating across the broader manufacturing solution. You will bring:
- Manufacturing and quality understanding: Knowledge of how production execution, batch records, equipment, materials, laboratory results, deviations, and quality review connect in a regulated plant.
- Manufacturing technology skills: Hands-on functional, configuration, integration, testing, or support experience with one or more manufacturing, quality, laboratory, automation, or industrial-data solutions.
- Data and integration skills: Ability to identify source systems, interpret batch and equipment data, document mappings and interfaces, investigate data-quality issues, and explain how information moves between OT and enterprise systems.
- Delivery discipline: Ability to produce accurate requirements, design documents, test scripts, defect records, and deployment materials, and to follow issues through resolution.
- Technical communication: Ability to discuss an operational problem with a plant user and document it clearly enough for a developer, data engineer, automation specialist, or tester to act on.
- Regulated-delivery awareness: Understanding of why documentation, traceability, controlled changes, and reliable data matter when a solution supports GxP activities.
- Analytical judgment: Curiosity about AI and advanced analytics, paired with the ability to test whether the underlying data, workflow, and proposed output are fit for use.
To qualify for the role, you must have:
- A bachelor’s degree in engineering, life sciences, manufacturing, information systems, computer science, supply chain, or a related discipline.
- At least 3 years of relevant experience in Life Sciences manufacturing, manufacturing systems, automation, industrial data, systems implementation, technology consulting, or a related field.
- Experience working with manufacturing or quality processes in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical-device, or comparably regulated environment.
- Experience producing technical or functional delivery artifacts, such as requirements, process maps, data mappings, interface specifications, configuration documents, test scripts, or deployment materials.
- Experience collaborating with both operational stakeholders and technical delivery teams to investigate requirements, resolve issues, or implement a solution.
- Ability to travel as needed based on business and role requirements. Travel can range from 80-100%.
Ideally, you’ll also have:
- Experience with MES/MOM, electronic batch records or eDHRs, recipe management, LIMS, QMS, historians, SCADA, DCS/PLC, connected-worker solutions, or industrial data platforms.
- Experience examining manufacturing data from more than one source and relating it to assets, materials, products, orders, recipes, batches, or quality events.
- Familiarity with ISA-88/IEC 61512 batch concepts, ISA-95/IEC 62264 manufacturing information models, or industrial connectivity approaches such as OPC UA and MQTT/Sparkplug.
- Exposure to GxP computer system validation, risk-based software assurance, data-integrity controls, electronic records, or OT cybersecurity considerations relevant to the system being delivered.
- Familiarity with Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and continuous improvement practices, including the use of manufacturing data to monitor process performance, identify variability, and improve quality, throughput, and operational performance.
- Experience supporting analytics or AI use cases in manufacturing or quality, such as process monitoring, predictive maintenance, deviation investigation, or decision support.
- Experience with drug substance, drug product, biologics, sterile manufacturing, medical devices, or technology transfer.
- Relevant platform, cloud, data, automation, Agile, or manufacturing certification.
What we look for
We are looking for a Senior who enjoys getting close to the manufacturing process and the technology that supports it. The strongest candidates ask precise questions, produce dependable technical work, recognize when data or design assumptions do not hold up, and collaborate well with plant, quality, and technology teams to make solutions usable in practice.
What we offer you
At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
- The salary range for this job is:
- New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $116,700 to $194,500
- Bay Area California offices – $121,600 to $202,600
- All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $97,300 to $178,300
- Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

title: Data Management Consultant (Junior / Senior)
summary: Pomůžeš nám řešit praktické problémy s daty napříč projekty.
Budeš komunikovat s technickými i byznysovými stakeholdery a sbírat jejich požadavky.
Budeš definovat a automatizovat pravidla pro kvalitu dat a podílet se na jejich technické implementaci.
education: Zapojíš se do oblastí Data Governance, Metadata Management, Master Data Management a AI Governance.
keywords: AI
jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
Baví tě práce s daty nejen na strategické, ale i na praktické úrovni? Rozumíš datovým modelům a chceš umět ověřit a nastavit kvalitu dat tak, aby fungovala v reálném provozu, nejen na papíře? Chceš se nebát zapojit do jakéhokoliv datového projektu – ať jde o nastavení pravidel kvality dat, návrh datových struktur nebo řešení konkrétního technického problému? A zároveň umíš svoje řešení srozumitelně vysvětlit klientovi i týmu? Pak se připoj k naší rostoucí praxi v oblasti Data Management a Governace v týmu Data & AI společnosti PwC.
Jaký bude tvůj tým
Jako člen týmu pro Data Management a Governance se budeš podílet na řešení konkrétních technických i procesních výzev v oblasti dat. Zaměříš se především na kvalitu dat a práci s datovými modely, navrhneš, jak ověřit a udržet data správná, konzistentní a bez duplicit, a pomůžeš to i technicky zrealizovat. Vedle toho se dostaneš i k širšímu záběru řízení dat, jako je Data Governance, Data Lifecycle Management, Master Data Management, Metadata Management nebo AI Governance. Budeš spolupracovat s odborníky z Data & AI týmu a podílet se na projektech pro přední společnosti napříč trhem.
Na koho se můžeš spolehnout
Tamás Kuczik je manažer pro oblast řízení dat. Vystudoval Data a IT na VŠE v Praze, kde propojil svět dat, technologií a byznysu, a tomuto spojení zůstává věrný i dnes. Před nástupem do PwC pracoval na straně dodavatele platformy pro Data Governance, díky čemuž dobře rozumí technologiím a nástrojům používaným v oblasti řízení dat. Věří, že řešení musí přinášet reálnou hodnotu a nezůstat pouze na papíře.
Ve volném čase je aktivní jak sportovně (běh, turistika, cyklistika, posilovna), tak kulturně, rád zajde do kina, divadla nebo na koncert.
O čem bude tvoje role
- Pomůžeš nám řešit praktické problémy s daty napříč projekty.
- Budeš komunikovat s technickými i byznysovými stakeholdery a sbírat jejich požadavky.
- Budeš definovat a automatizovat pravidla pro kvalitu dat a podílet se na jejich technické implementaci.
- Zapojíš se do analýzy datových modelů a databází.
- Budeš sledovat a mapovat tok dat mezi systémy (data lineage) a navrhneš, jak data v organizaci efektivně strukturovat a řídit.
- Vyzkoušíš si práci s různými nástroji pro správu a zpracování dat, API a automatizací.
- Zapojíš se do oblastí Data Governance, Metadata Management, Master Data Management a AI Governance.
- Získáš zkušenosti s regulatorními tématy, jako jsou GDPR, EU AI Act a Data Act.
Tohle je pro nás důležité
- Zájem o praktickou práci s daty, od analýzy a modelování po nastavení a ověřování jejich kvality.
- Základní znalost principů Data Governance (např. role, odpovědnosti, standardy pro práci s daty).
- Znalost alespoň jednoho programovacího nebo skriptovacího jazyka, orientace v databázích a datových modelech.
- Vynikající komunikační a prezentační dovednosti.
- Silné analytické myšlení, proaktivní přístup a plynulá znalost angličtiny a češtiny/slovenštiny.
A tohle ti dá náskok
- Zkušenost s cloudovými platformami (Azure, AWS, GCP), API nebo automatizací procesů (ETL, BI nástroji).
- Praktická zkušenost s některou z oblastí správy a řízení dat (např. Data Quality, Master Data Management, Metadata Management).
- Zkušenost s big data platformami nebo nástroji pro streamování dat (např. Kafka, Spark, Databricks).
- Znalost frameworků DAMA nebo DCAM a zkušenost s jejich zaváděním do praxe.
- Znalost oblasti informačních systémů, enterprise architektury nebo umělé inteligence.
Čím tě potěšíme my
- Rozvoj, který odpovídá tvým ambicím a tempu. Možnost získat během krátké doby zkušenosti, které jinde sbíráš roky.
- Férovou mzdu bez rozdílů. Patříme mezi několik málo firem v ČR s Equal Pay Certifikací.
- Flexibilní benefitní program s 30 000 body, který si nastavíš podle vlastních priorit.
- 30 dní placeného volna, ve kterých jsou zahrnuty tři dny well-being a dva dny volna na konci roku.
- Příležitost vrátit něco zpět společnosti – jeden dobrovolnický den ročně na nás.
- Možnost vyzkoušet si práci v některé ze zahraničních kanceláří PwC (od úrovně Senior Associate)
- Podporu tvého rozvoje a vzdělávání: Školení a certifikace v oblasti business a digitálních dovedností odpovídající tvému zaměření, rozvoj soft skills včetně prezentování, koučinku a efektivní komunikace a další. Hradíme technické certifikace.
- Buddy systém a pravidelná zpětná vazba na tvoji práci, také konzultace s koučem, se kterým můžeš řešit svůj další rozvoj i kariérní směr.
- Širokou podporu well-beingu a zdravého životního stylu – od programů Dr. Digital a Human Dynamic až po např. jógu na pracovišti a běžecké závody.
- Ultrabook a iPhone s neomezenými daty.
- Mimopracovní aktivity a Away Days
V PwC pomáháme klientům řešit současné i budoucí výzvy napříč oblastmi auditu, poradenství, daní, práva, technologií a dat. Vytváříme prostředí, ve kterém se lidé mohou učit, růst a budovat kariéru podle svých představ. Věříme, že nejlepší výsledky vznikají díky různorodým zkušenostem a pohledům. Proto budujeme inkluzivní kulturu, ve které má každý možnost být sám sebou, využít své silné stránky a přispívat k práci, která má skutečný dopad.
Zaujala tě naše nabídka? Dej nám o sobě vědět a probereme spolu další podrobnosti!

Job Description & Summary
At PwC, our people in deals focus on providing strategic advice and support to clients in areas such as mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, and restructuring. They help clients navigate complex transactions and maximise value in their business deals.
Those in deal strategy at PwC will focus on providing strategic advice and support to clients in areas such as mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, and restructuring. Your work will involve analysing market trends, assessing business opportunities, and developing strategic frameworks to guide clients in making informed decisions regarding their deals. You will help clients navigate complex transactions, identify potential risks and opportunities, and develop strategies to maximise value and achieve their business objectives. Working in this area, you will play a crucial role in assisting clients in formulating and executing effective strategies to optimise outcomes in their deal-making processes.
Focused on relationships, you are building meaningful client connections, and learning how to manage and inspire others. Navigating increasingly complex situations, you are growing your personal brand, deepening technical expertise and awareness of your strengths. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you are comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, you ask questions, and you use these moments as opportunities to grow.
Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
- Respond effectively to the diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.
- Use a broad range of tools, methodologies and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems.
- Use critical thinking to break down complex concepts.
- Understand the broader objectives of your project or role and how your work fits into the overall strategy.
- Develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is changing.
- Use reflection to develop self awareness, enhance strengths and address development areas.
- Interpret data to inform insights and recommendations.
Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.
Core responsibilities:
- Pre-deal value creation advisory looking for value in a deal on behalf of our clients, and exploring whether full value potential has been both identified and accurately quantified
- Providing operational due diligence on both the buy and sell side of a transaction.
- Identifying or reviewing synergies available as the result of a transaction and assessing plans for their realisation.
- Supporting divestment of subsidiary businesses and planning to ensure the carved-out entity can continue to operate on day 1.
- Assisting the purchaser with 100 day planning, taking control of the new entity and delivering quick wins.
- Supporting our clients on the integration of their acquisition, in order to deliver the value identified pre-deal, reduce risk and successfully merge the two organisations.
Must-have skills:
- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage and communicate with senior business leaders.
- Excellent quantitative and written skills, able to build analyses or an evidence base to support a position, often in situations with imperfect or incomplete information.
- A healthy curiosity, coupled with a disciplined approach to understanding and solving problems.
- Able to work from first-principles and stay focused on the ‘why’ when performing analyses or reviewing documentation.
- Comfortable under pressure and managing through ambiguity to deliver tasks in an environment where there are many unknowns.
- Adaptable, and up for the challenge of mastering new industries and developing experience in a wide variety of product types.
- Capability or willingness to develop skill in data analytics e.g. Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau.
Experience
- Operational management or business transformation experience in a corporate environment across consumer goods (e.g. FMCG), retail sector (e.g. grocery stores, fashion retailers, etc), or leisure sector (e.g. hotels, restaurant chains, cinemas, etc),
- Or
- Experience providing professional services (either in a Deals or Consulting background) to Retail, Consumer or Leisure team industries
Eligibility Criteria:
- MBA in Strategy/ Marketing/ Finance from a premium B-School
· Past Experience:
- 3 - 6 years of prior relevant work experience
- Experience in M&A or management consulting domain

jd_text:
Requisition ID:
1750440
UKI Business Consulting - Supply Chain & Operations – Laboratory & Quality Operations Transformation, SC
General Information
Location: Ireland
Available for Work Visa Sponsorship: No
Business Area: Business Consulting
Contract Type: Full-Time – Permanent
At EY, we are continuing to grow our Supply Chain & Operations Consulting practice to meet increasing client demand for digital transformation across Life Sciences manufacturing, laboratory, quality, supply chain, and AI-enabled operations.
Within our Life Sciences Supply Chain Manufacturing Operations & AI Transformation Delivery team, we help pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device organizations modernize laboratory and quality operations, unlock value from digital technologies, improve data quality and governance, and accelerate adoption of next-generation capabilities including AI, advanced analytics, and intelligent automation.
In addition to delivering client engagements, you will contribute to the growth of EY's Life Sciences consulting practice through business development, solution development, thought leadership, and team development activities.
As a Senior Consultant in Supply Chain Manufacturing Operations & AI Transformation Delivery, you will work with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical-device clients to transform laboratory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain processes through the implementation of modern digital solutions.
Your Key Responsibilities
Competitive business today is all about making intelligent, informed choices. We are looking for an individual who is passionate about helping our clients to solve their toughest supply chain problems.
As a Senior Consultant in Supply Chain, you will:
- Build valued relationships with client stakeholders and internal EY teams.
- Support proposal development, business development activities, and market growth initiatives.
- Contribute to the development of EY methodologies, accelerators, and Life Sciences transformation offerings.
- Support the development of thought leadership and market insights related to laboratory, quality, and digital transformation.
- Participate in practice-building activities and support the continued growth of EY's Supply Chain & Operations team.
- Assess laboratory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain processes through stakeholder interviews, workshops, site observations, and operational data reviews.
- Partner with laboratory SMEs, quality teams, manufacturing operations, and technology stakeholders to understand current-state processes and identify opportunities for standardization and digital transformation.
- Facilitate business process assessments, requirements workshops, and design sessions to define future-state operating models and system capabilities.
- Develop and maintain process maps, user stories, business requirements, functional specifications, and operational workflows to support digital transformation initiatives.
- Review, update, and support the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and supporting process documentation.
- Translate business and operational requirements into master data, configuration, reporting, analytics, and integration requirements.
- Support the implementation of laboratory and manufacturing systems, including LIMS, MES, quality systems, and associated data platforms.
- Work with solution architects, data teams, and implementation partners to ensure proposed solutions align with business objectives and operational requirements.
- Support master data design activities by identifying business rules, data definitions, process dependencies, and governance requirements.
- Develop and execute test scenarios, document defects, support issue resolution, and maintain traceability between requirements and testing outcomes.
- Support deployment readiness, end-user training, hypercare activities, and business adoption efforts.
- Contribute to analytics and AI use cases by assessing process workflows, evaluating data quality, and helping identify opportunities to improve decision-making, efficiency, compliance, and operational performance.
- Communicate project progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to client stakeholders and engagement leadership.
Skills and Attributes for Success
To thrive in this role, you should be comfortable working at the intersection of business operations, process transformation, data, and technology. You will bring:
- Strong stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation, and communication skills.
- Ability to develop innovative approaches to client challenges.
- Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
- Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and project activities.
- Commercial awareness and the ability to identify growth opportunities.
- Ability to balance operational detail with strategic thinking.
- Business process analysis and requirements gathering expertise.
- Strong understanding of QC laboratory operations and related quality processes.
- Experience documenting current-state and future-state business processes.
- Process mapping and business process design capabilities.
- Knowledge of SOP, Work Instruction, and controlled documentation development.
- Ability to translate business processes into technology, configuration, master data, and reporting requirements.
- Understanding of regulated GxP environments and the importance of documentation, traceability, and data integrity.
- Interest in leveraging analytics and AI-enabled capabilities to improve operational effectiveness.
To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have
- A bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or a related discipline.
- At least 3 years of relevant experience in Life Sciences operations, laboratory informatics, quality operations, business process transformation, technology consulting, or a related field.
- Experience working in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical-device, or other regulated environments.
- Experience conducting business process analysis and gathering requirements from operational stakeholders.
- Experience documenting business processes, workflows, SOPs, work instructions, or functional requirements.
- Experience collaborating with laboratory, quality, manufacturing, and technology teams to design and implement process improvements.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including workshop facilitation and stakeholder management.
- Ability to travel as needed based on business and role requirements.
Ideally, You'll Also Have
- Experience with LIMS platforms such as Veeva LIMS, LabWare, LabVantage, or similar laboratory systems.
- Experience supporting laboratory digital transformation, quality transformation, or business process standardization programs.
- Knowledge of master data management concepts and governance frameworks.
- Experience supporting system implementation projects, including configuration, testing, validation, deployment, and adoption activities.
- Familiarity with MES, ERP, QMS, manufacturing data platforms, and integration concepts.
- Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, or data-driven process optimization initiatives.
- Experience working with global and cross-functional teams across multiple regions and time zones.
- Understanding of GxP compliance, computer system validation, electronic records, and data integrity requirements.
- Relevant technology, Agile, quality, laboratory, or project management certifications.
What Working at EY offers
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
- Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
- The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
Career Progression:
- When you join EY, you will be supported to ensure that you are enhancing your skills from day one.
- Continuous learning, where you can develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
- As you grow and develop here, you’ll discover opportunities to help customise your career journey, so that it’s as unique as you are - success is defined by you, we will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
- Transformative leadership, we will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
- Diverse and inclusive culture, you will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
- We have embraced Hybrid working at EY adding greater flexibility and autonomy to the roles of our employees.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.
Unser Bereich Financial Services fokussiert sich auf Finanzdienstleistungen und unterstützt Banken, Versicherungen und Asset Manager dabei, in einer sich stets verändernden und schnelllebigen Welt erfolgreich zu sein.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres Business Transformation - Customer Teams in München, Frankfurt/Main, Berlin, Hamburg, Stuttgart, Köln oder Düsseldorf hilfst du unseren Kund:innen in der Finanzbranche, Antworten auf strategische, operative und regulatorische Fragestellungen zu finden und Transformationsprozesse erfolgreich zu gestalten. Gleichzeitig treiben wir moderne Organisationsmodelle voran – kunden- und mitarbeiterzentriert, technologiebewusst und zukunftsorientiert. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:
- Change Management & Transformation: Unterstützung bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung wirkungsvoller Change-Management-Ansätze für komplexe Transformationsprogramme – von Stakeholder- und Impact-Analysen über Kommunikations- und Trainingsmaßnahmen bis hin zur nachhaltigen Verankerung neuer Arbeitsweisen.
- AI Enablement & Governance: Mitwirkung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von AI-Enablement- und Governance-Ansätzen, z. B. durch zielgruppenspezifische Befähigungskonzepte, AI-Literacy-Programme, Kommunikationsformate sowie organisatorische Leitplanken für den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz von KI.
- Target Operating Model & Organization Design: Unterstützung bei der Gestaltung zukunftsfähiger Organisations- und Operating-Modelle, einschließlich Rollen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Strukturen, Prozessen und Governance-Mechanismen für Finanzdienstleister.
- Projektmanagement & Umsetzung: Mitarbeit in nationalen und internationalen Transformationsprojekten – von der Analyse über die Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung – inklusive Vorbereitung von Workshops, Erstellung von Präsentationen, Durchführung von Recherchen und Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen.
- Team- und Geschäftsentwicklung: Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Customer & People Advisory Teams, z. B. durch Angebotsprozesse, Thought Leadership, interne Initiativen, Wissensaufbau sowie Unterstützung von Kolleg:innen im Projektalltag.
Dein Skillset
- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Psychologie, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder vergleichbar) sowie erste oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Beratung oder im Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld mit Schwerpunkt auf Change Management, Transformation, Organisationsentwicklung, HR oder Innovation
- Begeisterung für Change Management und Transformation, ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie Interesse an aktuellen Entwicklungen in der Finanzbranche, Digitalisierung, Künstlicher Intelligenz und der Gestaltung zukunftsfähiger Organisationen. Dabei gelingt es dir, komplexe Fragestellungen strukturiert zu analysieren und in verständliche Konzepte, überzeugende Präsentationen sowie konkrete Maßnahmen zu überführen
- Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (mindestens C1-Niveau) und Englisch
Dein Mindset
- Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
- Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
- Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.

jd_text:
Position Summary
Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart-of-the-business solutions.
Work You’ll Do
As a Consultant, Strategy, Growth and Transformation on the Supply Chain & Network Operations team, you will be responsible for…
- Providing strategic and tactical consulting services to support supply chain risk management priorities and organization-level alignment
- Authoring and managing annual updates to a supply chain risk management guidebook, including incorporation of frameworks such as International Organization for Standardization 31000 and National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800-161
- Facilitating enterprise-level working groups and coordinating stakeholder input across multiple organizations and program teams
- Deploying and managing a comments resolution process to adjudicate enterprise-level feedback
- Coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to align supply chain risk management activities with enterprise standards
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
- Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
- Effective written and verbal communication skills
- Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
- Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
- Ability to lead projects or workstreams
- Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
- Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
- Ability to meet deadlines
- Ability to provide clear guidance to others
The Team
Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.
Our Supply Chain & Network Operations offering advises, implements, and operates transformational solutions that bring world class supply network capabilities.
Qualifications
Required:
- Bachelor’s degree
- 3+ years of experience maintaining and governing Microsoft SharePoint portals, Microsoft Teams collaboration spaces, or similar knowledge management environments
- 3+ years of experience developing and delivering training content in presentation, video, or digital learning formats
- 3+ years of experience drafting and distributing stakeholder communications such as newsletters, briefs, or awareness materials
- 3+ years of experience planning and facilitating working groups, meetings, or stakeholder events
- 3+ years of experience developing training plans or learning content for multiple stakeholder audiences
- Active Secret clearance required
- Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
Preferred:
- 3+ years of experience learning design or instructional design
- 3+ years of experience with video editing, animation, or multimedia learning assets
- 3+ years of experience event management or session coordination
- 3+ years of experience translating stakeholder needs into training, communications, or creative briefs
- 3+ years of experience supporting knowledge management or communications efforts in a public sector environment
Deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the Global Call Center (GCC) at USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com.
Recruiting tips
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.
Benefits
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
Our people and culture
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas, and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Requisition ID:
1694210
What if your next role wasn't about who you are today-but who you could become?
At EY, we don't just offer jobs-we help you build futures. Join a globally connected, diverse and inclusive organization where technology, innovation, and high performing teams come together to help you thrive.
We're looking for talented graduates and early career professionals to join our Finance Transformation team, part of our Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) practice within Assurance.
Role Overview
EY Mauritius is looking for high-potential professionals to join its Finance Transformation team, supporting clients in reimagining and modernising their Finance function through the use of AI, automation, analytics, data platforms and emerging technologies.
The role is suited for individuals who understand the challenges faced by CFOs and Finance teams, and who are passionate about using technology to improve finance processes, enhance decision-making, reduce manual effort, and create more agile, insight-driven Finance functions.
The successful candidate will work on transformation projects covering areas such as finance process improvement, reporting and analytics, automation, digital finance tools, data management, AI-enabled use cases, performance management, and operating model redesign.
Key Responsibilities
As a Consultant, you will support the delivery of Finance Transformation projects by combining finance understanding with strong analytical, technology and problem-solving skills. Your responsibilities will include:
- Assist in analysing current-state finance processes, systems, reports, data and pain points.
- Support the identification of improvement opportunities across finance operations, reporting, analytics, automation and controls.
- Help translate Finance function challenges into practical technology-enabled solutions.
- Support the development of dashboards, reports, analytical models, automation workflows and process documentation.
- Use tools such as Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python, Power Automate, VBA and GenAI tools to support project work.
- Assist in preparing client presentations, workshop materials, process maps, data analysis outputs, business requirements and transformation recommendations.
- Support Finance Transformation diagnostics, benchmarking, opportunity assessments and roadmap development.
- Work closely with senior team members and client stakeholders to gather information, analyse findings and develop practical recommendations.
- Contribute to internal knowledge development around AI, automation, analytics and digital finance use cases.
The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong interest and practical capability in data, analytics, automation and digital finance, including:
- Strong experience or hands-on exposure to ETL tools, Python, Power BI, SQL and data management tools.
- Fundamental understanding of Generative AI tools and their practical applications.
- Ability to demonstrate how GenAI has been used, or can be used, in current work, academic projects or previous roles.
- Exposure to Python / PySpark, AI/ML concepts and advanced analytics will be an advantage but is not mandatory.
- Experience with automation tools such as VBA, UiPath and Microsoft Power Automate will be an advantage but is not mandatory.
- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
- Ability to analyse data, identify patterns, structure findings and communicate insights clearly.
Interest in emerging technologies relevant to Finance, including AI, automation, analytics, fintech, blockchain and cloud-based finance solutions.
Professional Experience
- Minimum 2 years of experience in finance transformation, consulting, advisory, analytics, automation, data, digital transformation, audit transformation, finance operations improvement or related roles.
- Experience supporting projects where technology, data, automation or analytics was an important component.
- Exposure to finance process improvement, reporting, dashboards, automation, analytics or digital transformation projects.
- Understanding of current CFO and Finance function challenges, including manual processes, fragmented data, slow reporting cycles, limited automation and the need for better insights.
- Exposure to Finance processes such as Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, FP&A, budgeting, forecasting or management reporting will be an advantage.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation and communication skills.
- Ability to work effectively in teams and manage assigned tasks independently.
Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Engineering, STEM, Data Analytics, Information Systems or a related field.
- Professional qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CFA, CIMA or equivalent will be an advantage.
- Certifications or coursework in Power BI, SQL, Python, data analytics, automation, AI or finance transformation will be considered positively.

1645874
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
Technology Consulting - Business Analyst, Senior Consultant
General Information
Location: Ireland - Dublin
Available for Work Visa Sponsorship: NO
Business Area: UKI Tech consulting
Contract Type: Full-Time – Permanent
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you, we are counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
EY have a number of career opportunities available, and we are interested in meeting candidates who are looking for a new challenge, one where you can develop your range of skills significantly. Be that a move out of industry into practice, or from within practice into advisory services. We are looking for future leaders with a genuine creative vision and the confidence to make it happen. Our opportunities will allow you to apply your expertise to a variety of projects whilst offering you excellent career progression opportunities.
The Team and the opportunity
Here at EY you’ll work with a team of amazing Technologists who are always growing, learning, and adapting, in and out of the office. Technology is changing the world, and we’re at the centre of it all. With a team list that reads like a who's who in tech, and a highly disruptive business model, we’re advancing the art of team collaboration. Driven by honest values, an amazing culture, we’re out to unleash the potential of every team. We are looking for people like you who are powered by passion and eager to do the best work of their lives in a highly autonomous yet collaborative environment.
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
You will play a key role in supporting the development and strengthen existing client relationships and help our clients, who are leaders in the Financial Services industry, navigate the complex finance issues facing their business. As part of this growing team, you will also get to help shape the innovative culture that makes EY such a great place to work.
Your key responsibilities
- As a Business Analyst, you will work with our clients to understand business goals and priorities, and to work with functional teams to formulate solutions to meet these goals.
- You will build valuable relationships with our clients through demonstrating exceptional delivery.
- You’ll also have the responsibility to help grow and win new business by contributing to proposals and client presentations.
- You will also get to draw on your skills and experience, creating innovative insights for clients looking to develop their change agenda to deliver value and improve their operations.
Skills and attributes for success
To qualify for the role, you must have
- At least 2 years' experience working within a consulting firm, industry or government organisation within local, European & US markets.
- Experience gathering, defining and documenting business and solution requirements for the enhancement, replacement, or introduction of IT systems.
- A strong academic record including a third level degree.
- Experience in one or more of our focus industries including Power & Utilities, Government & Public Sector, Financial Services, Life Sciences and Telecommunications & Media.
- Experience operating in a fast paced, multi-vendor environment in a client facing role.
- Experience in business development such as client relationship management and proposal support.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strives to identify new opportunities and to create proposals to help solve our client’s most complex problems.
Ideally, you will also have
- Experience analysing systems and procedures, process design and modelling, and documenting ‘As is’ and ‘To be’ assessments for a Target Operating Model.
- Experience in Waterfall and Agile methodologies, including the creation of User Stories or Use Cases and working closely with a Product Owner.
- Experience conducting workshops and interviews.
- Experience with stakeholder management and working collaboratively with Development and Testing teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet client and user business needs.
- Experience in the delivery of large-scale business/technology programmes and ideally in ERP or CRM implementations (Oracle, MS Dynamics, SAP).
What working at EY offers
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive benefits package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs: covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
- Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around.
- Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
- The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.
All our employees are given a benefits package which they can tailor to suit their individual preferences. Our range of benefits include:
- Pension
- Discounted health insurance
- Web Doctor – Free unlimited online GP consultations for you and your family
- The purchase of additional annual leave
- Hybrid Working
- Free Gym membership
- Travel Pass
- Maternity & Paternity leave
- Bike to work Scheme
- Recognition Awards
- Cash incentives for referrals
- Work Mobile
- Tech MBA paid by EY
- Wellness rooms available in some offices

Bundesweit

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres Finance-Teams an den Standorten Berlin, Hamburg, Hannover, Düsseldorf, Köln, Frankfurt/Main, Stuttgart oder München berätst du unsere Kund:innen bei der Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und Optimierung von Prozessen im Rechnungswesen und Controlling. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:
- Mitarbeit in Teams von AI-Spezialisten und Finanzfachleuten bei der Entwicklung innovativer Agentic AI-Lösungen sowie Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zur Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Transformation von Finanzprozessen
- Entwurf und Implementierung von Agentic AI-Lösungen, die die neuesten agentischen Rahmenwerke nutzen, um wesentliche Teile von Finanzprozessen zu automatisieren
- Zusammenarbeit mit Teams von Near- und Offshore-Ressourcen sowie Verwaltung von Projektzeitplänen, Budgets und Ressourcen, um die erfolgreiche Bereitstellung von Lösungen innerhalb der festgelegten Parameter sicherzustellen
- Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen, um deren Bedürfnisse zu verstehen, fachkundige Beratung zu bieten und sicherzustellen, dass die strategischen Ziele der Kund:innen eingehalten werden
- Überwachung von Branchentrends und Fortschritten in der AI-Technologie, um die Dienstleistungsangebote kontinuierlich zu verbessern und einen Wettbewerbsvorteil zu erhalten
Dein Skillset
- Studienabschluss im Bereich Finanzen, Informatik, Datenwissenschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich sowie je nach Einstiegslevel 2-8 Jahre Erfahrung in der Transformation von Finanzprozessen, der Entwicklung von AI-Lösungen oder verwandten Bereichen
- Starkes Verständnis von AI-Technologien, insbesondere im Kontext von Finanzen, nachweisliche Erfolge in der Führung von Teams und im Management komplexer Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung sowie idealerweise Erfahrung mit Prozessumwandlungen im Kontext von GBS und/oder S/4HANA
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeit in Deutsch und Englisch auf C1 Niveau sowie die zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeit, Stakeholder auf allen Ebenen zu enablen und anzuleiten

keywords: digital transformation, transformation
jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
Nossa equipe de tecnologia está na vanguarda das soluções digitais, trabalhando com as mais recentes ferramentas e metodologias para oferecer resultados excepcionais aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos com projetos desafiadores que impactam diretamente nossos clientes e a sociedade.
Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais altamente qualificados e dedicados, que colaboram para alcançar resultados extraordinários.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Digital Transformation Consultant para se juntar à nossa equipe. Se você gosta de resolver problemas complexos e criar soluções inovadoras, queremos conhecer você!
Seu papel nessa jornada:
Você será responsável por apoiar clientes em suas jornadas de transformação digital, promovendo a adoção e o uso estratégico das soluções Microsoft. Atuará na condução de projetos, workshops e reuniões executivas, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e garantindo que as soluções implementadas gerem valor para o negócio.
Sua rotina envolverá contato constante com clientes, levantamento de necessidades, acompanhamento de projetos e apoio na implementação de ferramentas da Power Platform, contribuindo para o fortalecimento do relacionamento comercial e para o sucesso das iniciativas de inovação e transformação digital.
Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:
- Experiência com Power Platform, incluindo Power Automate e Power Apps.
- Conhecimento em Copilot Studio.
- Vivência em gestão de projetos e iniciativas de transformação digital.
- Experiência com adoção e implementação de tecnologias Microsoft.
- Atuação prévia em consultoria, Customer Success ou projetos de tecnologia.
- Experiência na condução de workshops e apresentações para diferentes públicos.
- Vivência em gestão de stakeholders e relacionamento com clientes.
- Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
- Capacidade de influência, negociação e apresentação executiva.
- Perfil organizado, adaptável e orientado a resultados.
Formação:
- Ensino Superior completo em Tecnologia, Administração, Engenharia, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas.
Pode ser um diferencial, se você tiver:
- Experiência em empresas de consultoria ou Big Four.
- Vivência em ambientes consultivos e projetos estratégicos.
- Certificações Microsoft.
- Conhecimento em ferramentas Google Workspace e automação.
- Experiência em projetos de adoção tecnológica em larga escala.
São nossos valores:
Agimos com integridade
Fazemos a diferença
Cuidamos das pessoas
Trabalhamos juntos
Desafiamos o limite do possível
Você está pronto(a) para fazer a diferença? Aqui, você pode crescer de forma real.
Nós somos a PwC. Somos visionários. Trabalhamos com tecnologias de ponta, impulsionados pelas nossas pessoas, para entregar valor, gerar impacto e levar nossos clientes à vanguarda.
Em tempos de transformação acelerada, utilizamos nossa expertise em indústrias, nossa experiência, competências e serviços integrados para construir confiança e resolver problemas importantes.
Somos guiados pelos nossos valores, consistentes em nossa qualidade e dedicados a fazer a diferença. Aqui, seu desenvolvimento e crescimento se tornam uma vantagem para nossos clientes e influenciam o futuro do mundo.

title: HR Transformation Consultant
summary: udział w projektach transformacji funkcji HR oraz transformacji organizacyjnych realizowanych dla klientów z różnych branż,
wspieranie klientów w projektowaniu i wdrażaniu docelowych modeli operacyjnych HR (HR Target Operating Model),
analizowanie procesów HR end-to-end, struktur organizacyjnych oraz sposobów funkcjonowania organizacji w celu identyfikacji obszarów wymagających zmian,
keywords: AI, change management, operating model, project management, workforce, HR transformation, SAP, Oracle, transformation, consulting
jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
People & Organisation w PwC Polska tworzy 20 specjalistów. Pomagamy klientom PwC w każdym wyzwaniu związanym z zarządzaniem najbardziej wrażliwym kapitałem przedsiębiorstw - ludźmi, którzy je tworzą. Zajmujemy się szerokim zakresem usług od zagadnień formalnych, przez wdrażanie transformacji organizacyjnej, po zarządzanie zespołami i tworzenie przyjaznego i stymulującego miejsca pracy. Pracujemy z klientami z Polski i zagranicy; wspieramy też zespoły PwC w Polsce i za granicą.
Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy:
HR Transformation Consultant
Twoja przyszła rola:
-
udział w projektach transformacji funkcji HR oraz transformacji organizacyjnych realizowanych dla klientów z różnych branż,
-
wspieranie klientów w projektowaniu i wdrażaniu docelowych modeli operacyjnych HR (HR Target Operating Model),
-
analizowanie procesów HR end-to-end, struktur organizacyjnych oraz sposobów funkcjonowania organizacji w celu identyfikacji obszarów wymagających zmian,
-
ocena wpływu planowanych zmian na pracowników, liderów i organizację oraz opracowywanie rekomendacji wspierających skuteczne przeprowadzenie transformacji,
-
projektowanie i realizacja działań z zakresu change management, obejmujących m.in. zarządzanie interesariuszami, komunikację transformacyjną oraz budowanie adopcji zmiany,
-
prowadzenie warsztatów, sesji roboczych oraz spotkań z klientami i kluczowymi interesariuszami,
-
opracowywanie analiz, prezentacji oraz materiałów dla kadry zarządzającej wspierających podejmowanie decyzji transformacyjnych,
-
współpraca z liderami biznesowymi, zespołami HR oraz ekspertami technologicznymi przy wdrażaniu nowych procesów i rozwiązań HR,
-
wspieranie rozwoju oferty i budowanie eksperckiej wiedzy zespołu w obszarze transformacji HR i zarządzania zmianą.
Aplikuj, jeśli:
-
masz minimum 4 lata doświadczenia zawodowego w jednym z obszarów: HR Transformation, Organizational Change Management, HR Business Partneringu, Organizational Design, Workforce Transformation lub HR Consulting,
-
uczestniczysz w projektach obejmujących transformację funkcji HR, zmianę modelu operacyjnego, reorganizację struktur organizacyjnych lub wdrażanie nowych procesów i technologii HR,
-
znasz zagadnienia związane z change managementem, komunikacją transformacyjną oraz zarządzaniem adopcją zmiany,
-
rozumiesz funkcjonowanie nowoczesnych organizacji HR, w tym role HR Business Partnerów, Centrów Kompetencyjnych (CoE) oraz Shared Services,
-
masz doświadczenie w prowadzeniu warsztatów i współpracy z klientami oraz kadrą zarządzającą,
-
bardzo dobrze komunikujesz się w języku angielskim (minimum C1),
-
wykazujesz się znajomością nowych technologii i narzędzi opartych na AI w codziennej pracy (np. automatyzacja zadań, analiza informacji, przygotowywanie treści),
-
cechujesz się samodzielnością oraz umiejętnością budowania relacji.
Mile widziane:
-
doświadczenie zdobyte w firmie konsultingowej,
-
udział we wdrożeniach systemów HR, takich jak Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM lub podobnych rozwiązań,
-
certyfikacje z obszaru change management lub project management.
Dołączając do nas zyskujesz:
-
elastyczne warunki - hybrydowy model pracy (min. 2 dni pracy z biura w tygodniu), elastyczny początek dnia, workation, sabbatical leave,
-
rozwój i podnoszenie kwalifikacji - pełne wsparcie zespołu podczas procesu wdrożenia, mentoring, szkolenia, warsztaty, certyfikacja współ-/finansowana przez PwC oraz konwersacje z native speaker,
-
szeroki program medyczno-wellbeingowy - pakiet opieki medycznej (m.in. opieka stomatologiczna, swoboda leczenia, fizjoterapia), coaching, sesje mindfulness, wsparcie psychologiczne, edukacja poprzez dedykowane webinary i warsztaty, doradztwo finansowo-prawne,
-
możliwość stworzenia indywidualnego planu benefitowego (wybór m.in. lunch pass, pakiet ubezpieczenia, concierge, pakiet weterynaryjny dla pupila czy masaże) oraz dostęp do kafeterii - w środku m.in. vouchery, zniżki na urządzenia IT i zakup samochodu,
-
3 godziny płatnego urlopu w miesiącu na wolontariat,
-
dodatkowy dzień wolnego z okazji urodzin,
-
a kiedy polubisz to miejsce tak, jak my, możesz polecić znajomych do PwC.
Jak wygląda proces rekrutacji?
-
​uzupełnij formularz oraz prześlij CV,​
-
​​porozmawiaj telefonicznie z Rekruterem,​
-
​​poznajmy się lepiej na rozmowie rekrutacyjnej!​
W razie problemów, napisz do nas: pl_kariera@pwc.com. Uprzejmie informujemy, że mail nie służy do wysyłania CV.
Administratorem danych osobowych przetwarzanych w celu przeprowadzenia rekrutacji jest PwC Advisory sp. z o.o. sp.k., lub inna spółka z sieci PwC (lista spółek), do której kierujesz aplikację. Jeśli wyrazisz odrębną zgodę, dane osobowe będą przetwarzane również w innych celach zgodnie z treścią udzielonych zgód. summary: Piedalīsies konsultāciju projektu īstenošanā un/vai patstāvīgi vadīsi projekta komandu 2-5 cilvēku sastāvā. ​
Konsultāciju projekta ietvaros būs jāveic:​
informācijas izpēte, apkopošana, datu analīze un vizualizēšana; ​
jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
Kā vecākais konsultants Tu piedalīsies stratēģiski svarīgu projektu īstenošanā sadarbībā ar Latvijas publiskās pārvaldes iestādēm, pašvaldībām, kapitālsabiedrībām un Eiropas Savienības institūcijām. Kopā ar projekta komandu Tu izstrādāsi stratēģijas, novērtēsi organizāciju un procesu efektivitāti, kā arī ieviesīsi pārmaiņas.​
Ko Tu darīsi?​
- Piedalīsies konsultāciju projektu īstenošanā un/vai patstāvīgi vadīsi projekta komandu 2-5 cilvēku sastāvā. ​
- Konsultāciju projekta ietvaros būs jāveic:​
- informācijas izpēte, apkopošana, datu analīze un vizualizēšana; ​
- intervijas, anketēšana, procesu kartēšana un koprades darbnīcas;​
- ziņojuma gatavošana.​
- Gatavosi piedāvājumus publiskā sektora un starptautisko organizāciju klientiem;​
- Veidosi un uzturēsi attiecības ar esošajiem un jaunajiem klientiem.​ ​​​
Par Tevi:​
- Obligāta pieredze pieredze konsultāciju jomā - analītiska darba veikšanā, t.sk. informācijas izpētē, datu analīzē un pētījumu ziņojumu sagatavošanā;
- Vēlama pieredze projektu vadībā, stratēģiju, procedūru aprakstu izstrādē.​
- Augstākā izglītība; ​
- Ļoti labas latviešu un angļu valodas prasmes, kas ir nepieciešamas veiksmīgai darbībai starptautiskā vidē, saziņai un sadarbībai ar ārvalstu kolēģiem un klientiem;​
- Proaktivitāte un orientācija uz rezultātu; ​
- Motivācija tiekties uz profesionālu izaugsmi un iegūt jaunas zināšanas.​
​
Ko Tu iegūsi, pievienojoties PwC Latvija komandai?​
- Atbalstoša, draudzīga un uz sadarbību vērsta komanda;​
- Iespēja sadarbībā ar starptautiskām institūcijām strādāt pie Latvijai stratēģiski nozīmīgiem projektiem;​
- Ikgadēja atalgojuma pārskatīšana, bonusu programma, papildus ikgadējā atvaļinājuma dienas un prombūtnes dienas nozīmīgos dzīves notikumos; ​
- Individuāli radīts attīstības plāns Tavai profesionālajai izaugsmei un pieredzējis mentors Tev līdzās;​
- Iespēja attīstīt savas profesionālās prasmes caur dažādiem semināriem vietējā un starptautiskā mērogā, kā arī caur e-apmācībām;​
- Apmaksāts sertifikācijas process (PRINCE2, PMP, CFA, u.c.);​
- Pievilcīgs labumu grozs pēc pārbaudes laika beigām (veselības apdrošināšana, 3. pensiju līmenis, budžets ēdināšanas vai sporta/veselības pakalpojumiem);​
- Iespēja strādāt arī attālināti (hibrīda modelī);​
- Regulāras komandas saliedēšanās aktivitātes un labbūtības iniciatīvas;​
- Atalgojums no 1900 līdz 3000 EUR (bruto) mēnesī atkarībā no kandidātam piemītošajām kompetencēm.​ ​

jd_text:
Established in the region for 40 years, PwC has around 12,000 people in 12 countries across the region: Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, the Palestinian territories, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
Our regional team operates across the Middle East bringing international experience delivered within the context of the region and its culture. We can bring the collective knowledge and experience of more than 370,000 people across the entire global PwC network in advisory, assurance and tax to help you find the value you are looking for.
About Us
With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organisations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.
Line of Service Overview
Our Deals practice helps clients create, capture, and deliver value through mergers and acquisitions, restructuring, and strategic investments. We provide end-to-end advisory services, combining deep industry knowledge with technical expertise to support clients in achieving their growth and transformation objectives.
Business Unit Overview
The Deals Strategy & Operations (DSO) team delivers strategic, commercial, and operational insights to corporates, private equity firms, family offices, and government entities. We advise on investment and divestment decisions, evaluate business plans, and address critical operational and transformational challenges to help clients achieve sustainable outcomes.
How You’ll Contribute
As a DSO Senior Associate supporting Healthcare and Pharma, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Conduct feasibility studies, commercial due diligence, market assessments, and growth strategies for healthcare and pharma clients
Structure analysis and apply strategic frameworks to solve client problems and develop actionable recommendations
Take ownership of engagement components and collaborate with team members to deliver high-quality reports and presentations
Research, aggregate, and analyse data to extract insights and support strategic decision-making
Assist in preparing business plans and evaluating company strategies against market performance and competitor strength
Support internal business development activities and contribute to proposals and thought leadership
Actively participate in client engagements, working closely with Managers and Senior Managers
What You’ll Bring
3+ years of relevant experience in M&A, strategy consulting, or corporate finance, preferably within healthcare or pharmaceuticals
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field; a master’s degree or professional certification (e.g., CFA) is a plus
Strong understanding of feasibility studies, market research, and business plan development
Experience conducting commercial due diligence and strategic assessments for large organisations
Excellent analytical skills and ability to synthesise complex information into clear insights
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to deliver messages effectively to diverse audiences
Arabic language skills are an advantage
Your flexibility to travel 20%–40% of the time. This means we may require you to work away from your base office location on a regular basis and frequent overnight stays may be required. Where possible, we will take your preferences into account and strike a balance between meeting your career development/personal needs and those of the business and our clients
How You’ll Make a Difference
At PwC Middle East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.
Why You’ll Love Working at PwC
At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job – you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference? Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East.

Business Unit Overview
The Infrastructure Finance team is part of PwC’s global Infrastructure and Project Finance network of over 600 professionals.
