How You’ll Contribute
As a Senior Associate, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Supporting procurement and transaction advisory mandates for large-scale infrastructure projects
Drafting and reviewing procurement documents and schedules, including benchmarking against precedent projects
Preparing business cases, conducting risk analysis and quantification, and performing financial analysis of project finance structures
Developing financial and Excel-based models to support decision-making
Conducting infrastructure sector and financial market research and drafting industry papers
Preparing reports, memos, and client presentations, ensuring clarity and quality
Assisting with proposal writing and contributing to business development activities
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and engaging with clients to deliver high-quality outcomes
What You’ll Bring
3–5 years of experience in infrastructure advisory or related sectors (Natural Resources, Transportation, Power & Utilities)
University degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Law or related discipline; MBA or professional designation (CFA, CPA) is an asset
Strong financial and Excel modeling skills
Knowledge of Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) and their financing structures

AI Strategy & Technology at PwC Middle East combines strategic foresight with digital innovation to accelerate transformation. We shape operating models, design technology roadmaps, and deliver integrated solutions that drive growth and resilience. Own the adoption strategy for firm-wide AI tools and agents across PwC Middle East, setting the direction, priorities, and targets that move staff from aware to actively using AI in their daily work, and closing the gap between licences held and value realised.
Own the measurement and value framework for AI adoption: define the KPIs, build and maintain the dashboards (Power BI and platform analytics), and turn usage and engagement data into the decisions on where to focus adoption effort next.
Own the ROI and value-realisation story, running the surveys, time-and-value studies, and benefit analysis needed to evidence impact, and presenting the results and investment recommendations to senior leadership, including ExCo.
Provide senior leadership of the AI champions network — shaping its strategy, curating the playbooks and enablement assets it runs on, and steering where champions focus — working alongside the wider team who deliver day-to-day activity.
Design the firm's adoption interventions and enablement approach — onboarding journeys, use-case clinics, and targeted campaigns — prioritising the teams, licences, and capabilities where usage is lagging and directing effort to the highest-value gaps.
Drive AI to become embedded in everyday ways of working, partnering with line-of-service and team leads to integrate tools into rituals, templates, and processes so that usage becomes the default and is sustained beyond initial launch.
Translate adoption and value insight into compelling, data-driven narratives and recommendations for leadership, and inform licence optimisation and future investment decisions.

Years of experience:
4+ years of relevant experience in AI/digital adoption, enablement, transformation, or benefits/value realisation, ideally within professional services or a large enterprise environment, including experience owning an initiative end to end.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline. A relevant Master's degree is an advantage.

Data analytics or BI certifications (e.g. Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate) are highly desirable.
Change management certification (e.g. Prosci / ADKAR) is an advantage.

Strong data and measurement capability: hands-on building and interpreting dashboards and adoption metrics in Power BI and advanced Excel, defining KPIs and ROI models; familiarity with SQL is an advantage.

Able to shape enablement strategy and curate high-quality assets — playbooks, prompt libraries, and campaign materials — that build capability across non-technical audiences.

Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence and present with credibility to senior leadership, including ExCo audiences.
Strong analytical and storytelling skills, comfortable turning usage and value data into clear recommendations that drive decisions.

jd_text:
PERL Associate- Consumer

As an Associate at Kearney, you'll help drive the next chapter of our Product Excellence and Renewal Lab (PERLab) — the team helping some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands rethink and reinvigorate their product portfolios for growth.

PERLab sits at a rare intersection: world-class product design fused with Kearney's operational rigor. In partnership with TEAMS Design — renowned for its work in product design, UX, and industrial design — we don't just advise from the outside. We tear products apart, walk the manufacturing line, and rebuild the supply chain from the inside, unlocking margin and efficiency at every stage of the product life cycle.

Our work spans the full arc of a product life — from shaping the category strategy behind a new launch and engineering products that win at scale, to finding the margin hiding in a portfolio and reinventing brands that have lost their edge.

As an Associate, you'll be in the middle of it all — leading workstreams, shaping recommendations that clients act on, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with designers, engineers, and category experts to solve problems that change what actually ends up on shelves.

What you will do

Are you ready to:

Work alongside a dedicated and diverse group of people to offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients?
Leverage your consumer goods, commercial, or technical background to solve complex consulting challenges?
Work at the intersection of consumer insight, consulting, and design?
Use your knowledge of products, categories, and consumers to create real business impact?
Let your curiosity about what consumers choose—and why—and your passion for solving tough problems sparks new solutions?
Learn and grow by taking advantage of every opportunity available to you?
Join a company that prides itself on its shared values and inclusive culture?
Be the difference and make it happen?

Who You Are

After 100 years, we know this business is fundamentally about making connections—between facts, figures, insights, strategies, tools, technologies, and above all, people. That’s why we look for collaborative, insightful, and inquisitive problem-solvers who don’t accept the first thing in front of them and who are always unapologetically themselves.

A highly analytical problem solver
Curious about what consumers choose, why they choose it, and how products, brands, and categories win in the market
Ready to take ownership of identifying and developing new capabilities that help our clients design stronger product portfolios, accelerate innovation, and drive profitable growth
Bring 5–10 years of relevant professional experience
Have experience in one or more of the following areas: consumer goods, consumer insights, category management, brand or product management, innovation, product development, packaging, R&D, commercial strategy, or supply chain
Hold an MBA or other advanced degree; backgrounds in business, economics, engineering, design, retail, innovation management, supply chain, or related fields are preferred
Are located near, or willing to relocate to, Chicago
Are fluent in English
What we can offer you

Every day, our people work to be the difference for our clients, our communities, and our colleagues. Helping them to make an impact, they are sustained by a competitive remuneration package plus comprehensive benefits and perks, including but not limited to:

Generous retirement/pension saving contributions

Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and their families

Structured and on-the-job learning and development opportunities

Personalized opportunities to help you chart a unique journey to pursue your own personal and professional goals

Compensation and benefits

PERL Associate – Electronics compensation range: $192k-194k

It is important to note that at Kearney, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role. Individual salaries within each range are determined through a wide variety of factors, including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, and skills. Kearney reviews compensation regularly and may adjust base salaries to reflect market competitiveness. In addition to salary, individuals may be eligible for a discretionary performance bonus. Our full suite of benefits includes paid time off, paid sick leave, 401(k) match and profit sharing, medical, dental, and vision coverage, healthcare concierge services, backup child/adult care, annual employer HSA contributions, a home office stipend, subsidized gym membership, an annual wellness program, and leaves of absence when needed to support employees’ physical, mental, and emotional well-being.

Equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination

Kearney prides itself on providing a culture where our employees belong and thrive equally, which means our people feel comfort, confidence, and joy as they do great things for our firm, our colleagues, and our clients. That’s why Kearney is committed to building a diverse workforce and inclusive environment. Kearney is an equal opportunity employer; we recruit, hire, train, promote, develop, and provide other conditions of employment without regard to a person’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, religion, age, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other differences consistent with applicable laws. This includes providing reasonable accommodation for disabilities or religious beliefs and practices. We encourage everyone to apply, including those who may not feel historically represented in consulting.

Associate

Who are we

As a global consulting partnership in more than 40 countries, our people make us who we are. We’re individuals with different passions and strengths who take as much joy in the work we do as from those we work with. Over the years we’ve fostered a culture in which we are united by shared values—passion, solidarity, generosity, curiosity and boldness—and these come alive in the work we do and how we do it.

Together, we know our people are our difference—for our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. That’s why we take pride in being individual and inclusive and create a place where everyone can bring their full self to work.

Make your mark as an Associate at Kearney

Are you ready to:

Work alongside a dedicated and diverse set of people to offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients?
Learn and grow by taking advantage of every opportunity available to you?
Join a company which prides itself on its shared values and inclusive culture?
Be the difference and make it happen?

If so, we are ready to help you:

Discover. Collaborating with our clients across a range of industries and service practices, our people are always learning. At Kearney, you will broaden your knowledge and experience across a breadth of areas, no matter your role. Being rooted in expertise, we know our people deserve opportunities to go places and further their exposure to the business world.

Grow. We believe in the power of apprenticeship. At Kearney, you work alongside colleagues who help you be the best you can be. Through both, our structured programs and apprenticeship model, you will continue to learn and develop every day. After all, we are here to help you not just perform, but to thrive in your career.

Be yourself. At Kearney, we give you the freedom to contribute creatively while you also pursue your dreams. We want you to bring your whole self to work and to find joy in what you do. That’s why we support our people when they want to let their uniqueness show and offer personalized opportunities including tuition support, flexible work programs, and externships.

Who you are

If you’re reading this, you’re smart enough to already know what we’re looking for. Insightful, yes. Inquisitive, naturally. Collaborative, of course. But we’re also looking for problem-solvers who think further than that, who don’t accept the first thing in front of them, and who are always unapologetically themselves.

This business is fundamentally about making connections—between facts, figures, insights, strategies, tools, technologies and above all, people. That’s why we expect you to be:

Analytically inclined and love solving problems
Ready to share your ideas and opinions as soon as you join a team
Experienced in your chosen field
In your final year of or hold an MBA degree
Fluent in English

What We Seek

There is no standard model for Kearney associates. We look for talented problem-solvers with intellectual curiosity who are ready to be active members of a client team. Associates are typically involved in every phase of an engagement, from pre-proposal research to final implementation. The following qualifications are preferred:

‒ A proven record of academic excellence

‒ Outstanding written and verbal communication skills

‒ Strong critical thinking and analytical capabilities

‒ An innovative and collaborative approach to problem-solving

‒ Natural self-direction, with the ability to operate in ambiguity and learn quickly

‒ Eagerness to collaborate, coach, mentor, and help others grow professionally

‒ Four to eight years’ success in a rigorous environment, such as a global or Fortune 500 company or consulting firm

To apply please fill in the online form and upload your CV and cover letter. There is no need for any other documents

This position is for the London office only.

Applications will close: Tuesday 27th October 2026

Equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination
Kearney prides itself on providing a culture where our employees belong and thrive equally, which means our people feel comfort, confidence, and joy as they do great things for our firm, our colleagues, and our clients. That’s why Kearney is committed to building a diverse workforce and inclusive environment. Kearney is an equal opportunity employer; we recruit, hire, train, promote, develop, and provide other conditions of employment without regard to a person’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, religion, age, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other differences consistent with applicable laws. This includes providing reasonable accommodation for disabilities or religious beliefs and practices. We encourage everyone to apply, including those who may not feel historically represented in consulting.

Language Requirements

Must be fluent in spoken and written English

jd_text:
Do you enjoy shaping strategy and leading complex strategic projects?
Are you curious and able to translate client needs into impactful solutions?
Do you thrive as a team player in a highly collaborative organization?
To further strengthen our Amsterdam office, we are hiring a Senior Consultant / Project Manager. So, if you can answer yes to the questions above then keep reading!

The Roland Berger Amsterdam DNA
Roland Berger is a global strategy consulting firm that assists clients to grow and adapt to the challenges of today. Founded in 1967 in Munich, we are one of the leading representatives of our industry, with more than 50 offices and 3,500 dedicated colleagues around the world.
Our young, dynamic and fast-growing office in Netherlands employs 120 consultants and supporting colleagues. We are proud of the close-knit culture within our Amsterdam office. We are creative, dedicated, ambitious, entrepreneurial and passionate - and at the same time social, energetic, open-minded and respectful. We help each other to bring out the best in each other and the best for our clients. Besides our client work, we foster our office culture through many social activities together, from sports and drinks to office trips and celebrations of holidays.
What we offer
Your success is our success. We offer plenty of opportunities for development, (inter)national training courses and a mentor to support your development. In addition, we offer excellent benefits, including 30 days of vacation, transportation benefits, a non-contributory pension and a contribution to your health insurance.
What you will be doing
You will contribute to high-impact projects shaping the future of the chemical industry and its adjacent sectors. As chemistry is a critical enabler of industries ranging from automotive and construction to electronics and pharmaceuticals, you will not only address the challenges of the transition of the chemical industry, but create impact far beyond in both upstream and downsteam value chains. For example, the transition of the industry goes hand-in-hand with the energy and water transitions being equally intertwined with these challenges, and creating a wide range of questions that cut across industries and expertise.
You will work in (international) teams and collaborate closely with clients on core topics such as decarbonization, circularity, resilience & competitiveness and innovation. You will tackle complex questions at the intersection of strategy, M&A, operations, technology and innovation, from redefining strategies and portfolios and responding to changing customer needs and regulation, to transforming operations, developing new business models and driving innovation.
You will be at the forefront of an industry in transition, helping companies navigate uncertainty, solve complex challenges and build the future.
As a Senior Consultant / Project Manager at Roland Berger you will:

- Take the lead for modules in larger projects, and complete project management of smaller projects (typically leading three to five consultants).
- Coach and develop the consultants in your project teams.
- Have direct client contact and lead presentations during client meetings.
- Work closely with industry experts at Roland Berger.
- Contribute to Roland Berger’s knowledge development by capturing insights and drawing lessons from client work.
- Participate in office-wide projects (e.g. in-depth studies on current topics) that further develop Roland Berger or its thinking in a specific area or sector.

Who we seek
At Roland Berger we are looking for people who are genuinely interested in our clients and their challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work hard to deliver the highest quality. The values of “empathy”, “entrepreneurship” and “excellence” are the foundation of our work and our culture. We are looking for people who recognize themselves in these values, who can think big, dare to dream, see connections and make connections, are self-starters and can enrich our team.
Our requirements

- You have completed an academic university education (i.e. WO).
- You have between two and six years of experience in strategy and/or management consulting, and/or in strategic/business development and/or business roles at a large company.
- You have prior experience in the chemical industry or a closely adjacent industrial sector. Experience with areas such as specialty chemicals, ingredients, plastics, minerals, energy, water is relevant.

Healthy work-life balance
The right work-life balance is critical to performing at such a high level. We understand that this balance differs per person and life phase. Your mentor will help you to organize your work in a way that suits you and your goals.
Diversity
We believe that a team of unique professionals with a diversity of backgrounds and qualities brings out the best in each other and provides the best results for our clients. Our international character makes us very diverse as a firm; this is something we strive for in our office as well. We are looking for people who can and want to contribute to the office with their unique perspective and qualities.
Keen to apply?
Upload your resume with a motivation letter and grade lists (of high school, bachelor and master).
The application process starts with a review of your application documents, followed by assessment round consisting of a personality test and an analytical assessment. The personality test is completed individually and before the analytical assessment. The analytical assessment is completed via MS Teams and is selective. When the analytical assessment is completed successfully the next phase is the first round interviews, three interviews: one interpersonal interview and two case interviews. In the final phase, you will have two additional interviews and must present a case.
Our research shows that female candidates only apply when they meet 100% of the requirements while male candidates apply when they meet only 60%. So, if you recognize yourself in this role and meet at least some of the requirements, do not hesitate to contact us. We look forward to receiving your application!
Do you have questions? Then get in touch with Maxime Jansen (Senior Recruiter) at maxime.jansen@rolandberger.com. We would be happy to hear from you!

jd_text:
Sia est un groupe international de conseil en management de nouvelle génération, fondé en 1999. Nés à l'ère du digital, nous sommes augmentés par la data, enrichis par la créativité et guidés par la responsabilité. Nous collaborons avec nos clients pour relever les défis et saisir les opportunités. Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nous croyons que l’optimisme est un puissant levier de transformation. Avec une expertise couvrant un large éventail de secteurs et de services, nos 3 000 consultants accompagnent des clients dans le monde entier, depuis 48 bureaux répartis dans 19 pays. Notre expertise produit des résultats concrets. Notre optimisme change la donne.

Vous souhaitez accompagner les organisations dans la structuration et la transformation de leurs politiques RH en matière de classification et de rémunération, tout en assurant leur conformité réglementaire notamment en matière de transparence des rémunérations ?
Rejoignez la Business Unit Human Resources & Transformation , spécialisée dans l’évolution des organisations et politiques RH.
En tant que Consultant·e Senior Rewards , vous interviendrez directement auprès de nos clients (CAC 40, SBF 120, ETI/PME) sur les thématiques suivantes :
Référentiel des emplois et classification

- Construire ou ajuster le référentiel des emplois.

- Identifier la méthode de classification adaptée au besoin client (méthode conventionnel, méthode de cabinet…).

- Animer des ateliers de cotation des emplois et garantir la cohérence globale des résultats.

- Appuyer la présentation des résultats aux différentes instances projet (DRH, DG, CODIR…).

- Former les équipes RH.
Politique de rémunération

- Concevoir des fourchettes de rémunération et la formalisation d’une politique de rémunération en accord avec les objectifs stratégiques de l’entreprise.

- Structurer et/ou optimiser les processus de rémunération : campagnes salariales, mobilité, promotions, performance management.
Accompagnement à la mise en conformité

- Accompagner les entreprises dans leur mise en conformité : cadrage, diagnostic, recommandations, plans d’action.

- Adapter les processus RH impactés (recrutement, promotion, mobilité, classification, performance).

- Renforcer le dialogue social (dossiers d’information/consultation, communication managériale, animation de commission avec les partenaires sociaux supports d’acculturation) et appuyer la conduite du changement.
Exemples de missions réalisées par nos équipes

- Déploiement international de la directive européenne 2023/970 pour un groupe bancaire (8000 collaborateurs, 5 pays) incluant diagnostic RH complet, classification, adaptation des processus et conduite du changement.

- Construction d’un nouveau référentiel emplois-compétences et mise à jour de la classification pour un acteur de l’industrie de pointe.

- Refonte de la classification (avec définition de critères classants) et de la politique de rémunération dans un environnement semi-public comprenant des populations à statut.
Vous êtes également amené(e) à vous impliquer dans la vie interne du cabinet : développement commercial, rayonnement médiatique de nos offres, etc.

Vous souhaitez orchestrer des transformations d’ampleur et concevoir des stratégies qui placent le capital humain au cœur du changement ?
Participez à des chantiers majeurs de transformation des organisations et des modèles RH, au cœur de notre Business Unit HR & Transformation , spécialisée dans la transformation des directions RH, auprès de clients dans des secteurs d’activités variés (banque, énergie, transport, secteur public, retail, etc).
Vous accompagnez nos clients sur les thématiques suivantes :

- Réorganisation & Target Operating Model : accompagner les décideurs dans la définition d’un modèle opérationnel, en prenant en compte les dimensions organisation, processus, activités, gouvernance, pilotage, coût, capital humain et en intégrant l’IA comme un pilier structurant du fonctionnement de l’entreprise.
- Performance Opérationnelle : améliorer la productivité et réduire les coûts pour répondre aux enjeux économiques des entreprises, en intégrant les leviers d’efficacité offerts par l’IA.
- Accompagnement Post Merger Integration (PMI) : préparer et opérer les opérations de fusion et de démantèlement / carve-out, de l’identification des opportunités et des risques en amont jusqu’au déploiement des différents chantiers (organisation, leadership, culture…). Quelques exemples de projets réalisés récemment :

- Déploiement du nearshoring des activités IT d’un acteur bancaire majeure, dans un pays européen.

Technique

jd_text:
Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques.
Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux·ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif.
Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain.

Description de la Business Unit TIME
TIME (Transport, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, Energy) accompagne les leaders industriels et énergétiques dans leur digitalisation.
Nous soutenons leurs projets de transformation des systèmes d’information, de la définition de la stratégie IT au choix et au déploiement des solutions (ERP, EPM, TMS, WMS, CRM…), ainsi que la transformation des métiers tout au long de la chaîne de valeur (R&D, Production, Supply, Vente, Marketing).
Nous accélérons également l’adoption des technologies digitales en aidant nos clients à valoriser leurs données et à industrialiser l’innovation, notamment via l’IoT, la GenAI et les jumeaux numériques.
Notre accompagnement repose sur des expertises sectorielles, fonctionnelles et technologiques, continuellement renforcées par la veille et la formation.
Description du poste
Encadré par des consultants expérimentés, vous interviendrez dans des projets variés chez nos clients de ces différents secteurs, et notamment dans les domaines suivants :

- Innovation / R&D : accompagner la stratégie, l’organisation et la transformation des filières de recherche & innovation. Contribuer au financement de l’innovation par les leviers de subvention publique.
- Conception / Ingénierie : améliorer le développement et maîtriser le cycle de vie des produits et services par l’efficacité des processus et la digitalisation.
- Excellence industrielle : améliorer la performance des opérations (Industrie 4.0.) et repositionner la production comme maillon essentiel dans le pilotage de l'entreprise, optimiser la gestion des actifs et de la maintenance, accompagner la réalisation des schémas directeurs industriels (projection de performance, capacité, implantations, roadmaps de mise en œuvre…).
- Expérience client : transformer les offres et l'expérience client B2C & B2B de nos clients : optimisation des parcours, digitalisation de l’expérience client, développement de nouveaux services, performance des forces de vente.
- Finance et performance : améliorer l'analyse de la performance et les prévisions, renforcer le contrôle des risques, adopter des modèles opérationnels plus globaux. Les opportunités offertes par le digital (IoT, Data, Intelligence artificielle…) permettent d'opérer une transformation en profondeur de ces secteurs, tant au niveau de leurs processus que de leurs outils. Vous pourrez ainsi :

- Explorer puis maîtriser en profondeur les enjeux de ces secteurs au cœur de la transformation de nos clients.
- Monter en compétence sur le digital.
- Appréhender toutes les étapes de mise en œuvre des projets : cadrage et stratégie, organisation de la gouvernance, business model, business plan, Product Management, gestion de projet, conduite du changement…
- Développer les compétences clés d'un consultant : formalisation, prise de recul, restitution, relation client, encadrement, partage de conviction, développement commercial…). En parallèle de votre participation à une ou plusieurs missions, un sujet interne pourra vous être confié durant votre CDI, sur une thématique prospective et/ou innovante sur laquelle Wavestone et la business unit Transport, Infrastructure, Manufacturing & Energy en particulier souhaitent développer leur expertise.

Unsere Kunden im Bereich Healthcare & Life Sciences sind weltweit führende Unternehmen und zentrale Innovatoren in den Bereichen Pharma, Biotech, Healthcare Technology, Diagnostics, Health IT und Consumer Health.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir Verstärkung für unser Commercial Strategy-Team mit Schwerpunkt auf KI und weiteren digitalen Themen.

Mehr von uns für dich:

Steile Lernkurve: werde Teil unserer Projektteams und arbeite an spannenden Fragestellungen und nachhaltigen Wachstumsstrategien für unsere Kunden. In einem schnell wachsenden internationalen Unternehmen mit Start-up-Atmosphäre übernimmst du von Beginn an Verantwortung.

Gefragte Perspektiven: mit umfassenden Feedback- und Entwicklungsprozessen inklusive 360-Grad-Feedbackgesprächen
Fernweh stillen: durch die Möglichkeit zur „Office Rotation“ an einen unserer internationalen Standorte und die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten (Workation)
Attraktive Vergütung: Bonus-Zahlungen, Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg, hybrid Working-Zuschuss
Gut umsorgt: mit einem großzügigen Budget für deine Gesundheit (flexibel einsetzbar für Fitness-Studio, Sport-Zubehör, Massagen u.v.m.), vielen Angeboten zur mentalen Gesundheit und einer attraktiven betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
Easy durch den Alltag: dank Hybrid Working, Kinderbetreuungszuschuss, Firmenrabatten und einem monatlichen Zuschuss für deine (private) Mobilität – nutzbar für Taxi, Bahn, Carsharing u.v.m.
Erfolge gemeinsam feiern: bei regelmäßigen Mitarbeitenden-Events (Office-Events, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier u.v.m.)
Gemeinsam wachsen: Nachhaltig und langfristig! Darum dreht sich alles bei Simon-Kucher. Unsere Stärke: ein mitreißendes, hoch motiviertes und sympathisches Team. Und jetzt kommst du: mitten hinein in die offene, wertschätzende Start-up-Atmosphäre eines etablierten Unternehmens mit 40-jähriger Erfolgsgeschichte.
Hier bewegst du was:

Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit deinem Projektteam an verschiedenen Commercial Strategy-Projekten für führende Pharma- und Biotech-Unternehmen. Der Schwerpunkt deiner Arbeit liegt auf digitalen Fragestellungen und dem Einsatz Künstlicher Intelligenz zur nachhaltigen Wachstumssteigerung und Entwicklung von neuen, innovativen Marken- und Vertriebsstrategien.
Du analysierst und interpretierst quantitative und qualitative Daten, um Marktpotenziale zu identifizieren und konkrete, umsetzbare Empfehlungen abzuleiten – insbesondere im Kontext digitaler Geschäftsmodelle und KI-basierter Lösungen für kommerzielle Produktteams.
Die Erstellung von überzeugenden Präsentationen und Management-Reports für unsere Kunden sowie die strukturierte Aufbereitung von Analysen, Erkenntnissen und Empfehlungen zählen ebenfalls zu deinen Aufgaben.
Du nimmst an Workshops und Trainings teil, entwickelst deine Beratungs- und Business-Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiter und vertiefst dein Verständnis unserer Commercial Strategy-Methodik sowie digitaler und KI-getriebener Ansätze.
Du arbeitest in funktionsübergreifenden, internationalen Teams und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Expertise zusammen, um komplexe kommerzielle Fragestellungen in der Pharma- und Biotech-Industrie zu lösen.
Hiermit begeisterst du:

Du verfügst über zwei bis vier Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich Commercial Strategy in einer Strategieberatung oder in der Industrie und konntest dabei bereits praktische Erfahrung mit digitalen Themen und dem Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz sammeln.

Du hast bereits mit digitalen Tools und KI Marketing- und Sales-Strategien datenbasiert weiterentwickelt und dabei aktiv an der Konzeption und Umsetzung zukunftsorientierter, KI-gestützter Marken- und Vertriebsmodelle mitgewirkt.
Mit einer proaktiven, hands-on Mentalität treibst du Innovationen und Wachstum voran – sowohl eigenständig als auch im Team – und bewegst dich souverän in einem dynamischen Beratungsumfeld.
Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kannst fließende Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse vorweisen.

jd_text:
Mit wem du arbeitest
Du kommst in unser Digital Finance Transformation Team im Bereich Financial Services.
Wir arbeiten für internationale Versicherer, Rückversicherer und Banken im DACH-Raum, meist über längere Zeiträume und tief in der Organisation unserer Kunden.

Was Dich erwartet

- Früh eigene Verantwortung für Themen und Kundenkontakt, statt jahrelanger Zuarbeit
- Ein Team, in dem unter anderem auch selbst entwickelt wird. Architekturfragen werden diskutiert und nicht nach Seniorität entschieden
- Enge Begleitung durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen, mit ehrlichem Feedback
- Zugang zu aktuellen Modellen, Werkzeugen und Cloud-Umgebungen, damit du auf dem aktuellen Stand arbeitest
- Umfangreiches internes KI-Weiterbildungs- und Zertifizierungsumgebung sowie eine Kombination aus interner und externer Weiterbildungsakademie

Deine Aufgaben

- Du entwirfst und implementierst GenAI- und Agentic-AI-Lösungen für Versicherer und Banken – von der Architektur bis zum Rollout. Dabei entwickelst du auch Multi-Agent-Systeme, die mehrere Tools orchestrieren und Aufgaben zuverlässig ausführen.
- Du identifizierst, priorisierst und realisierst Use Cases entlang der Wertschöpfungskette unserer Kunden und entwickelst dafür belastbare Business Cases.
- Du setzt Lösungen technisch mit Python um und arbeitest mit LLM- und Agenten-Frameworks, dem Model Context Protocol (MCP), Tool Calling, RAG-Architekturen sowie der Integration in bestehende Systemlandschaften.
- Du baust die Produktionsschicht auf, die über den Erfolg von KI-Lösungen entscheidet. Inklusive Evaluation, Observability, Guardrails, Monitoring sowie der Absicherung gegen Prompt Injection und Tool-Missbrauch.
- Du gestaltest Angebote mit und unterstützt den Pre-Sales-Prozess auf Senior-Level.

Dein Profil

- Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der BWL, VWL, Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Physik, eines Ingenieurfachs oder einer vergleichbaren quantitativen Fachrichtung.
- Du verfügst über zwei bis fünf Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung als Consultant.
- Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung im Banking- oder Versicherungsumfeld. Beispielsweise bei einer Bank, einem Versicherer, Rückversicherer, Asset Manager oder einer entsprechenden Beratung.
- Du beherrschst Python sicher und bringst Erfahrung mit LLM-Anwendungen sowie Agenten-Frameworks wie LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, dem OpenAI Agents SDK oder der Microsoft-Plattform rund um Copilot Studio und Agent Framework mit, idealerweise inklusive Multi-Agent-Orchestrierung und Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Du hast Erfahrung mit RAG, Embeddings und Retrieval-Qualität sowie mit den zugrunde liegenden Datenplattformen und -technologien wie SQL, Data Pipelines, Lakehouse-Konzepten, Snowflake oder Databricks.
- Du bringst Praxiserfahrung mit mindestens einer führenden Cloud-Plattform mit, im deutschen Versicherungsumfeld insbesondere Azure, sowie mit Docker und CI/CD.
- Du verstehst, wie KI-Systeme messbar, zuverlässig und produktiv betrieben werden, von Evaluation und Monitoring bis hin zum operativen Betrieb.
- Du hast Freude daran, Ergebnisse vor Fachbereichen und Entscheidern überzeugend zu präsentieren und zu vertreten.
- Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Deine Benefits

- Your career, your way: Unser Personal Growth Model und Coaching & Leading-Ansatz bieten Dir eine enge, vollumfängliche Unterstützung sowohl in Deiner langfristigen Entwicklung als auch im Daily Business. In unserer Academy findest Du ein breites Angebot an Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungskursen, mit umfassendem AI Upskilling durch DataCamp und interne Initiativen, sowie individuellem Coaching. Und durch unser flexibles Karrieremodell sowie unseren Fluid Company Ansatz entscheidest Du selbst, wo und wie schnell es für Dich weiter geht.
- Karriere & Privatleben: Dank Mobile Work Policy arbeitest Du bequem von zuhause oder in einem unserer Büros in Deutschland. Mit „Mobile Work Abroad“ kannst Du bis zu 50 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland (sowie UK, NOR, ISL, LIE, CHE) arbeiten. Des Weiteren gibt es 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, zusätzliche Urlaubstage bei besonderen familiären Umständen sowie verschiedene Sabbatical-Optionen.
- Mobilität nach Maß: Mit unserem festen monatlichen Mobilitätsbudget bist Du bei uns flexibel und umweltbewusst unterwegs: egal, ob privat oder beruflich, und mit einem klaren Fokus auf nachhaltige Verkehrsmittel. Ab der Rolle Manager / Managing Consultant steht Dir alternativ ein Elektrofahrzeug zur Verfügung.
- Wert-volle Unternehmenskultur: Unsere Werte verantwortungsbewusst, energiegeladen und gemeinsam sind zentrale Bestandteile unseres Alltags. Das spürst Du z. B. bei unseren Powerdays (bei denen Du Dich gemeinnützig engagieren kannst), in unseren Netzwerken (wie dem Women’s Network), durch unsere regelmäßigen Mitarbeiterbefragungen über Great Place To Work, bei unseren Firmenevents, internen Fitnessgruppen, unserem Corporate Benefit Programm und vielem mehr.
- Vergütung & monetäre Vergünstigungen: Wir bieten faire und attraktive Gehälter, bestehend aus einem fixen und einem leistungsbasierten Anteil. Im Falle von Mutterschutz gewähren wir dabei den vollen, leistungsbasierten Anteil. Zudem gleichen wir unsere Gehälter regelmäßig über externe Benchmark Studien mit dem Markt ab – immer auch mit Blick auf Gender Equal Pay. Darüber hinaus erhältst Du monetäre Vergünstigungen im Rahmen des EGYM Wellpass, exklusiver Corporate Shopping-Rabatte sowie unseres Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOP), in welchem Du Wavestone-Aktionär:in werden kannst.

Avec une expertise couvrant un large éventail de secteurs et de services, nos 3 000 consultants accompagnent des clients dans le monde entier, depuis 48 bureaux répartis dans 19 pays. Encadré(e) par des consultants expérimentés , le consultant confirmé accompagne les directions métiers de nos clients sur des missions de conseil en management (études, audit, organisation, processus, systèmes d’information, ressources humaines/conduite du changement) en répondant aux problématiques suivantes :

- Transformation des organisations : audit des organisations, schéma directeur métier, refonte des processus, des organisations et de la gouvernance,

- Evolution réglementair e : étude des textes réglementaires et analyse d’impacts, mise en conformité des organisations et des processus,

- Gestion de projets : cadrage, assistance à maitrise d’ouvrage, pilotage de projet (PMO), accompagnement au changement,

- Marketing et relation client : études de marché, segmentation client, conception d’offres et de services (marketing mix, business plan…), CRM et connaissance client, stratégie digitale et multicanale,

- Stratégies de croissance et de performance : études prospectives, diversification d’activités, modélisation financière,

- Management des Systèmes d’Information : schémas directeurs SI, études d'opportunité et de faisabilité (« business case »), benchmark et choix de solutions, accompagnement dans la mise en œuvre.
Vous serez également amené(e) à vous impliquer dans la vie interne du cabinet , autour de différents sujets :

- Le développement ou le renforcement de nos offres au travers de formations, de groupes de travail, de diffusion de supports internes et externes,
- Le développement de nouvelles opportunités au travers de réponses aux appels d’offres et de propositions commerciales,
- La politique de publication de l’équipe (rédaction d’articles, décryptage…),
- La contribution à l'animation de l'équipe Energy & Utilities (newsletter, veille sectorielle, organisation de petits-déjeuners, Siavendventures...). Quelques exemples de projets réalisés récemment :

- Conception et déploiement d'agents IA pour les opérations d'eau potable et d'assainissement, avec comme objectifs de simplifier le quotidien des équipes de terrain et valoriser leur expertise sur trois missions clés : la recherche de fuites, le diagnostic des pannes et l'optimisation des paramètres d'exploitation.
- Etude des schémas logistiques de distribution de carburants renouvelables à destination de la mobilité lourde (aviation, routier, maritime, ferré) à horizon 2050.
- Accompagnement stratégique et opérationnel d'un fournisseur d'énergie dans le cadre d'une évolution réglementaire majeure, avec pour objectifs la maîtrise des coûts et du planning, la réalisation de livrables stratégiques (Business Plan, analyse de risques, stratégie commerciale, refonte du modèle d'activités) et l'appui au pilotage projet, notamment la coordination de dizaine de parties prenantes et la préparation des instances de pilotage.

jd_text:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity.
With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

As a Data Analytics Consultant, you will be at the heart of delivering impactful data-driven strategies to our clients. You will collaborate closely with local and international clients to bridge the gap between business objectives and technical execution.
You will help deliver actionable data-driven solutions & insights, and present the results in an interactive, easily understandable manner.
What you will do

- Collaborate with stakeholders to define business goals and shape solution blueprints through workshops and mock-ups.

- Prepare and validate data by mapping, extracting, cleaning, enriching, and performing feature engineering to establish stable datasets for analysis.

- Design, implement, and automate interactive dashboards and customized reports that cater to specific client requirements using advanced visualization tools.

- Conduct comprehensive statistical analysis and exploratory data investigations to extract actionable insights supporting decision-making.

- Translate complex technical and analytical findings into clear, understandable presentations for non-technical stakeholders.

- Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data analytics, applying innovative approaches to enhance service offerings.

- Provide guidance and support to business users and team members in leveraging data effectively, contributing to a data-driven culture and continuous learning.
Within Sia, you will

- Contribute to enhancing Sia’s Data Science and Generative AI offerings through internal training sessions, working groups, and publications.

- Represent Sia at professional events, actively contributing to thought leadership (articles, white papers, webinars).

- Support business development by crafting proposals/offers, identifying collaboration opportunities, and nurturing long-term client relationships.

About You
You bring:

- A Master's degree in Business, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

- 0–3 years of experience in data analytics or a relevant consulting or industry role.

- Fluency in Dutch and English. If you speak German, that's a plus.

- Strategic thinking with strong analytical skills and a proactive approach.

- Experience in clearly communicating and presenting complex ideas to varied audiences.

- Efficient collaboration with various stakeholders, internally and externally, to gather requirements and support data-driven decisions.

- Eagerness to work alongside and learn from more experienced colleagues while contributing fresh ideas to team projects.

- Interest in applying innovative analytics and AI solutions to drive sustainability and create meaningful business impact.
Your technical toolkit:

- Hands-on experience with Python or R for data analysis.

- Proficiency with SQL and Microsoft Excel for data manipulation.

- Familiarity with dashboarding tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.

- Knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a strong plus.
What you can expect from us
Your development is our priority. Whether it’s through challenging projects, inspiring colleagues or personal growth, we invest in your success, every step of the way.
We offer:

- An attractive salary that grows with your experience and performance.
- A yearly bonus based on your individual and team results.
- Sustainable and practical mobility options , whether you prefer to travel by train, bike, or your own vehicle.
- A solid pension plan and additional benefits to support your well-being.
- Freedom in where you work, from home, at the client’s office, or in one of our inspiring hubs in Amsterdam or Maastricht, including a home working allowance to make remote work comfortable.
- 26 days of holiday per year , with the opportunity to earn extra days as your seniority grows.
- Plenty of learning opportunities , from mentoring and training programs to international projects that broaden your perspective.
- A strong community , where connection matters – we organize regular social and sports activities to celebrate successes together. Do you have the drive and enthusiasm to help build our great company, and does this position sound like a perfect fit for you? We'd love to get to know you!

Building a generative-AI powered contract review tool reviewing the insurance sections of contracts

Developing a target operating model for the Finance and Actuarial functions of a life insurer to empower them with enhanced data and the technology they need to design products, perform pricing updates, and calculate reserves

The Insurance Practice is seeking Associates and Engagement Managers to support our continued expansion, a strategic priority for the firm. Associate / Engagement Manager Role

Our consulting roles offer excellent career and growth opportunities for talented, highly motivated professionals with relevant prior experience. As a professional member of our firm in the Associate or Engagement Manager role, your initial responsibilities will include:

Managing the execution of individual project workstreams or projects. Synthesizing findings into written presentations; reviewing and discussing with clients and other stakeholders; leading client readouts of written presentations or deliverables
Supporting our Partner group in project delivery through accurate and high-quality execution

Managing and developing junior consultants on individual project workstreams or projects. Just as every client project is different, we recognize and value the diversity of backgrounds and skill sets for successful candidates. 4-7 years of relevant experience, ideally with a top-tier strategy consulting firm (or other similar organizations with project-based, team-oriented environments)
Experience with insurance-related topics, such as organizational design, strategic planning, product design, distribution, underwriting, policy or claims administration, claims, risk and capital management, pensions, or reinsurance

jd_text:
As a Senior Consultant at Oliver Wyman in Stockholm or Copenhagen, you will lead client engagements, structure analyses, and develop recommendations to address complex business challenges. The role involves managing and coaching junior team members, building client relationships, and collaborating across industries. Candidates must have at least 3 years of experience in strategy consulting, an undergraduate or advanced degree in a quantitative discipline, and strong analytical and communication skills. Experience in Banking, Financial Services, Finance, Risk, Restucturing, or Insurance is highly advantageous. Fluency in English and another Scandinavian language, as well as willingness to travel internationally, are required. Preferred qualifications include data analytics, advanced quantitative modelling, CFA or equivalent certification, and an MBA or Master's degree.

Who we are

Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

What you will do

As a Senior Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in shaping client engagements from problem definition through implementation. You will work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.

You’ll help teams understand client strategic challenges while helping develop the next generation of consultants.

You will:

Lead workstreams on client engagements, structuring analyses and developing actionable recommendations that support client decision-making.
Frame hypotheses, identify key business questions, and direct quantitative and qualitative research to generate insights.
Apply structured problem-solving and analytical thinking to solve complex business issues.
Develop high-quality client deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, models, and discussions that help move projects forward.
You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.
You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.
Manage and coach junior team members, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team environment.
Build trusted relationships with clients through clear communication and effective stakeholder management.

Why join us?

You can be your best here

At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

Create solutions that have impact

Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.
Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.
Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

Develop as a leader

Lead workstreams and develop expertise that colleagues and clients seek out.
Mentor junior consultants while continuing to build your own leadership capabilities.
Take ownership of client relationships and increasingly complex engagements.

Learn and grow without limits

Continue developing specialized expertise through challenging projects and formal learning opportunities.
Collaborate with industry specialists and global experts across Oliver Wyman.
Build a sustainable career supported by coaching, mentoring, and continuous professional development.
You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.
Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.
Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

Experience rewards that work for you

We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.
Over time, you’ll have access to opportunities, programs, and experiences designed to help you perform, grow, and thrive — including non-profit fellowships, sabbaticals, and externships. ​
Enjoy competitive local benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and life outside of work.

Who can apply?

We are looking for top-performing professionals who are passionate about solving complex business problems, enjoy developing high-impact content, and are excited to build a long-term career at a leading strategy consulting firm characterized by sustained double-digit growth, an entrepreneurial spirit, and a strong focus on culture and career sustainability.

Required qualifications

3+ years of relevant experience in a top-tier strategy consulting firm.
Experience serving clients within Banking and Financial Services, Finance and Risk, Restucturing, Insurance, Logistic, is highly advantageous.
Undergraduate or advanced degree in STEM, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline from a leading university.
Outstanding analytical and quantitative problem-solving capabilities with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across different audiences and seniority levels.
Demonstrated experience working collaboratively in cross-functional, fast-paced environments.
Proven ability to deliver results under pressure while managing multiple priorities.
Fluent business English and another Scandinavian language
Willingness to travel internationally as client needs require.

Nice to have

Data analytics, advanced quantitative modelling, or data science capabilities.
CFA or equivalent professional certification.
MBA or Master's degree from a top-tier university.

What we're looking for?

Successful candidates demonstrate:

Intellectual curiosity and structured problem solving.
Strong ownership and accountability.
Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
An inclusive leadership style and commitment to developing others.
Adaptability, resilience, and entrepreneurial thinking.
A collaborative mindset with the ability to work respectfully across diverse teams and cultures.

How to apply? ​

Please submit your CV, cover letter, and academic transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website.

What to expect during the interviews process?

Wir bauen unser Organizational & Agile Transformation Team weiter aus und suchen dafür Dich als Consultant Agile Organisation am Standort Deiner Wahl.

jd_text:
Operations Consultant - Source, Kearney Activate

Location: Mexico, with willingness to travel as required

About Kearney

Kearney is a leading strategic consulting firm that partners with some of the largest organizations across North America and globally to drive transformational change and operational excellence. Our work spans multiple operational domains, helping clients optimize costs, enhance processes, and design future-ready operating models.

About Kearney Activate

Kearney Activate is our global capability platform, bringing together Kearney’s operations expertise with digital and AI technology to drive transformation for clients worldwide. Within Activate, the Kearney Operations System (KOS) is our global team of operations specialists. We work within client teams, bringing the right experts and the right tools to deliver measurable impact across three connected operational domains:

Plan: Optimizing end-to-end supply chain processes, demand forecasting, inventory management, and digital transformation.

Source: Driving sourcing excellence, strategic negotiations, procurement transformation, and cost optimization.

Deliver: Improving logistics, transportation efficiency, network optimization and operational execution.

Role Overview

As an Operations Consultant, focused in Source, you will lead defined work streams within Kearney Activate client engagements and help clients solve complex, procurement and related supply chain and operations challenges. You will combine functional expertise, structured problem-solving, and strong communication to design practical solutions and support implementation.

The role is suited to a professional who can own work products end to end, work directly with client stakeholders, and contribute to the continued development of Kearney Activate capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Source

Lead procurement assessments, diagnostics, and transformation initiatives.

Execute sourcing work including establishing baselines, cost models, market intelligence, RFX execution, analysis and negotiation strategy.

Lead teams in applying the latest in digital and AI-backed tools and approaches to drive procurement work streams using a range of Kearney proprietary and third-party solutions

Develop recommendations related to sourcing excellence, supplier performance, and procurement of operating models.

Lead clients, independently or with small teams, in change management to ensure value realization with program management, savings tracking, and supplier transition steps

End-to-end Operations impact

Understand and articulate sourcing impacts upstream and downstream in the value chain; i.e. communicate and plan for impacts on demand planning, forecasting, inventory, network optimization, logistics and digital transformation.

Account for broader supply chain impact in designing process improvements, analytical models, performance measures, and implementation of roadmaps.

Kearney Activate and Client Development

Contribute to proposals, client pitches and business development initiatives.

Work flexibly in dynamic environments with varying client needs and project requirements.

Develop intellectual capital, tools, methods, and case studies.

Support Kearney outreach and collaborate with technology and asset-development teams.

Who You Are

5-7 years of experience in consulting, supply chain, procurement, operations or transformation.

Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

Experience working with U.S.-based clients or North American operating environments is a plus.

Strong ownership, communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills.

Ability to structure complex problems, develop actionable recommendations, and present to senior stakeholders.

Comfortable analyzing large datasets and developing advanced Excel models.

Proficiency and ability to guide team in using LLM platforms (ChatGPT, Claude) to accelerate workflows for research, and deliverable deployment and validation.

Knowledge of tools such as Coupa, Jaggaer or Keelvar, and other Source-to-contract solutions, with the ability to guide clients and project teams on usage.

Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization platforms is a plus.

Knowledge of Procure-to-Pay process and systems a plus

Willingness to travel to client locations when required.

What we can offer you

Every day, our people work to be the difference for our clients, our communities, and our colleagues. Helping them make an impact, they are sustained by a competitive remuneration package plus comprehensive benefits and perks, including but not limited to:

Generous retirement savings contributions.

Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and their families.

Structured and on-the-job learning and development opportunities.

Personalized opportunities, including talent mobility, flexible work programs, and externships, help you chart a unique career journey and pursue your personal and professional goals.

Read more about our benefits and careers at Kearney.com/careers.

Equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination

Kearney prides itself on providing a culture where our employees belong and thrive equally, which means our people feel comfort, confidence, and joy as they do great things for our firm, our colleagues, and our clients.

That’s why Kearney is committed to building a diverse workforce and inclusive environment.

Kearney is an equal opportunity employer; we recruit, hire, train, promote, develop, and provide other conditions of employment without regard to a person’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, religion, age, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other differences consistent with applicable laws.

This includes providing reasonable accommodation for disabilities or religious beliefs and practices. We encourage everyone to apply, including those who may not feel historically represented in consulting.

The Senior Analyst in Private Capital at Oliver Wyman will engage in data analysis, market research, and financial modeling to support private equity projects. Candidates should have a bachelor's degree in Finance or related fields, with a preference for CA or CFA qualifications. The role requires at least 2 years of experience in data analytics or consulting, with strong skills in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Python, and SQL. Responsibilities include conducting due diligence, developing financial models, and preparing reports for clients. This position offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with a focus on analytical excellence and client impact.

Oliver Wyman's Data and Analytics team is hiring an Analyst or Senior Analyst specializing in Private Capital / Equity for our Hyderabad office.

OW DNA Overview

The Oliver Wyman DNA is a distinguished center of excellence for business analytics and data analytics within Oliver Wyman. This group leverages data and information to provide business insights to Oliver Wyman consulting teams driving positive outcomes and tangible impact for Oliver Wyman’s clients. The group combines cutting edge data science expertise with core consulting expertise to augment engagement teams with analytical firepower to deliver outstanding results.

Role Summary:

The Analyst will support private capital and private equity engagements by conducting rigorous data analysis, market research, and financial modeling. The role involves working closely with senior team members on due diligence, valuation, and value creation projects. The Analyst will apply structured analytical thinking, leverage advanced analytics tools, and contribute to high-quality reports and presentations that support client's investment decisions across the deal lifecycle

Key Responsibilities

Deploy structured analytics, statistical techniques, and research methodologies to support complex business and investment-related problem solving.

Support due diligence and valuation engagements for private equity clients, including buy-side, sell-side, IPO, and post-transaction value realization work.

Conduct detailed market, financial, and operational due diligence to support investment decisions and deal-value realization.

Develop and maintain financial models, valuation analyses, and data-driven insights using advanced analytics and AI-enabled techniques where applicable.

Prepare clear, concise, and well-structured reports and presentations for internal teams and client stakeholders.

Collaborate with senior team members to identify risks, growth opportunities, and value creation levers for clients.

Support business development activities by gathering market intelligence and contributing to proposal development.

Maintain and enhance data management, analysis, and reporting tools using MS Excel, PowerPoint, and other relevant software.

Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and proper documentation across analytical deliverables.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

CA / CFA qualification or candidates with strong analyst experience are strongly preferred.

MS, certification, or coursework in analytics, finance, or data science is preferred.

Experience & Skills

2+ years of overall experience in data analytics, consulting, or related roles, with at least 1+ year of exposure to market research and/or due diligence engagements.

Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint, with comfort building structured models and presentations.

Python and SQL experience is a strong plus

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to translate data into actionable insights.

Solid understanding of financial modeling concepts, valuation techniques, and analytical frameworks.

Experience with customer and market research techniques, including interviews, surveys, focus groups, and secondary research.

Exposure to business research across multiple sectors, preferably within a global consulting or professional services environment.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

Experience working with specialized financial and market data sources such as Capital IQ, Factiva, Bloomberg, or similar platforms.

Familiarity with GenAI tools and modern analytical techniques is a plus.

Quick learner with the ability to rapidly pick up new tools, platforms, and methodologies.

High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and ability to work collaboratively in fast-paced environments.

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. jd_text:
Senior Operations Analyst - Source, Kearney Activate

Location: Mexico, with willingness to travel as required

About Kearney

Kearney is a leading strategic consulting firm that partners with some of the largest organizations across North America and globally to drive transformational change and operational excellence. Our work spans multiple operational domains, helping clients optimize costs, enhance processes, and design future-ready operating models.

About Kearney Activate

Kearney Activate is our global capability platform, bringing together Kearney’s operations expertise with digital and AI technology to drive transformation for clients worldwide. Within Activate, the Kearney Operations System (KOS) is our global team of operations specialists. We work within client teams, bringing the right experts and the right tools to deliver measurable impact across three connected operational domains:

Plan: Optimizing end-to-end supply chain processes, demand forecasting, inventory management, and digital transformation.

Source: Driving sourcing excellence, strategic negotiations, procurement transformation, and cost optimization.

Deliver: Improving logistics, transportation efficiency, network optimization and operational execution.

Role Overview

As a Senior Operations Analyst, you will be a key contributor to Kearney client delivery and the development of KOS offerings and tools. You will independently manage analyses and defined work streams, translating operational data into actionable recommendations for client teams.Your work will focus on Source, sourcing excellence, procurement transformation, logistics and digital operations, and likely involve overlaps in the upstream and downstream value chain. You will also help codify reusable knowledge and coach more junior colleagues.

Key Responsibilities

Source

Execute or lead spend analysis, category baselines, sourcing strategy and cost-optimization work.

Support strategic negotiations, supplier management improvements, and design-to-value programs.

Apply the latest in digital and AI-backed approaches to drive procurement work streams using a range of Kearney proprietary and third-party solutions

Develop and implement tools and solutions that improve sourcing effectiveness and procurement performance.

Lead clients in change management to ensure value realization with program management, savings tracking, and supplier transition steps

KOS and Client Development

Contribute to proposals, client development initiatives, and solution design.

Codify methodologies, benchmarks, case examples and tools for the KOS Center of Excellence.

Review work products and coach analysts on analytical quality, communication and project execution.

Who You Are

3-5 years of experience in supply chain consulting, operations strategy, transformation, or procurement operations.

Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

Experience working with North American or U.S.-based clients is a plus.

Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with experience making data-driven decisions.

Demonstrated ability to manage work streams independently and deliver high-quality outcomes under tight deadlines.

Strong stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills.

Previously exposed to sourcing, procurement, or related operations transformations, in a consulting or similar project-based setting.

Experience / proficiency using LLM platforms (ChatGPT, Claude) to accelerate workflows for research, and deliverable deployment and validation.

Knowledge of tools such as Coupa, Jaggaer or Keelvar,and other Source-to-contract solutions, with the ability to guide clients and projects teams on usage.

Advanced Excel modeling required; Power BI, and similar visualization solutions experience is a plus.

Adaptability, ownership and a passion for delivering tangible client impact.

Willingness to travel to client locations when required.

What we can offer you

Every day, our people work to be the difference for our clients, our communities, and our colleagues. Helping them make an impact, they are sustained by a competitive remuneration package plus comprehensive benefits and perks, including but not limited to:

Generous retirement savings contributions.

Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and their families.

Structured and on-the-job learning and development opportunities.

Personalized opportunities, including talent mobility, flexible work programs, and externships, help you chart a unique career journey and pursue your personal and professional goals.

Read more about our benefits and careers at Kearney.com/careers.

Equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination

Kearney prides itself on providing a culture where our employees belong and thrive equally, which means our people feel comfort, confidence, and joy as they do great things for our firm, our colleagues, and our clients. That's why Kearney is committed to building a diverse workforce and inclusive environment. Kearney is an equal opportunity employer; we recruit, hire, train, promote, develop, and provide other conditions of employment without regard to a person’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, religion, age, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other differences consistent with applicable laws. This includes providing reasonable accommodation for disabilities or religious beliefs and practices. We encourage everyone to apply, including those who may not feel historically represented in consulting.

Digitale Lösungen spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle – von der Planung über Genehmigung, Bau bis in die Inbetriebnahme. Als (Senior) Consultant Infrastrukturgroßprojekte – Verkehrsinfrastruktur (all genders) arbeitest du an genau diesen Fragestellungen und gestaltest dabei die digitale Transformation von Großprojekten im Bereich Verkehrsinfrastruktur, Energie- und Bauprojekte. jd_text:
As a Senior Business Analyst, you will be a key contributor to the growth and development of our Strategic Operations (SOP) practice-Source Tower as we offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients.

Working alongside a dedicated and diverse set of people, you will work alongside our clients to define and implement strategies that will deliver both short-term results and longer-term competitiveness in this ever-changing market environment.

Through unique hands-on experiences, you will broaden your knowledge across a breadth of topics while developing relationships with clients and colleagues across the firm. With the freedom to be yourself and recognition for what you bring to the table, you can put your purpose into action and help build a future that works for everyone, everywhere—as a Kearney Original.

Who you are

After nearly 100 years, we know this business is fundamentally about making connections—between facts, figures, insights, strategies, tools, technologies, and above all, people. That’s why we look for collaborative, insightful, and inquisitive problem-solvers who don’t accept the first thing in front of them and who are always unapologetically themselves.

We Want to Hear From You If You Are

Insightful, inquisitive, and collaborative.
Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Have functional experience in one or more of the following areas:
Strategic sourcing and category management
Procurement operating model design
Cost optimization and value capture
Supplier collaboration and risk management
Apply strong expertise in one or more core sourcing capabilities, with a broad understanding of the broader procurement landscape, including:
Category management
Strategic sourcing
Procurement and digital purchasing transformation
Supplier relationship management (SRM)
Vendor negotiation and contracting strategies
Apply procurement expertise across industries to improve efficiency, resilience, and innovation.
Contribute to thought leadership, tools, and methodologies that strengthen Kearney’s sourcing and procurement capabilities.

In Addition, We Look for Individuals with the Following Experience or Qualities

3–5 years of professional experience.
A master's degree, or an undergraduate degree with relevant work experience.
Experience working as a Management Consultant preferred.
Located near, or willing to relocate to, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Detroit, New York, San Francisco, or Washington, D.C.
This role requires approximately 50–80% travel, based on client and business needs.

What we can offer you:

Every day, our people make a difference for our clients, communities, and colleagues. We support them with a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits, including:

· Generous retirement/pension savings contributions

· Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and immediate family

· Gym membership discounts

· Non-partner equity-based awards (for consulting managers and above)

· Structured and on-the-job learning and development opportunities

· Personalized career pathways, including mobility programs, flexible work arrangements, and externships

Senior Business Analyst base salary - $123,000 - $127,000: However, it is important to note that at Kearney, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role. Individual salaries within each range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, office location, knowledge and skills. Kearney reviews compensation regularly and may adjust base salaries to reflect market competitiveness. In addition to salary, individuals may be eligible for a discretionary performance bonus. Our full suite of benefits includes paid time off, paid sick time off, 401(k) match and profit sharing, medical, dental and vision coverage, healthcare concierge, backup child/adult care, annual employer HSA contribution, home office stipend, subsidized Gympass and annual wellness program, and leaves of absence when needed to support employees’ physical, mental, and emotional well-being.

Read more about our benefits and a career at Kearney.com/careers.
