jd_text:
This role is with our Partners in Performance team, part of Accenture.
Partners in Performance, Part of Accenture is a global management consulting firm with a focus on human performance working alongside client partners to make change happen. We’ve got offices in Australia, New Zealand, South-East Asia, Africa, North and South America and Europe but prefer to spend as little time in them as possible. Instead, we work alongside our clients to unleash their potential and deliver lasting impact that you hardly ever achieve by sitting in a boardroom. 
The Business Analyst role is an entry level role where you would be immediately exposed to being the frontline change agent for our clients. You are the primary source of reliable data and rock-solid analysis, providing the fact base the improvement team uses to make decisions in real time. 
Responsibilities include:
- 
- Assisting with the delivery of measurable improvements and in the implementation of processes and systems that will sustain ongoing improvements, especially by supporting prioritization and problem-solving
- To work closely with other team members and client team members to collect/analyze data and provide insights
- At times, the business analyst may be given the opportunity to take on front-line coaching roles, especially with client analysts, to broaden their management experience
- This position involves a significant amount of on-site travel. The ideal candidate is comfortable and available to travel 70% as part of the role. This will include US and Canadian travel, as well as other international opportunities.
Key competencies: To be successful consultant at Partners in Performance, you not only need to be an outstanding academic performer, but also be dynamic, passionate and prepared to roll up your sleeves and work inside our clients’ businesses. You need to care about people and developing them, as coaching is a big part of our success.
This position involves a significant amount of on-site travel. The ideal candidate is comfortable and available to travel 80% as part of the role. This will include US and Canadian travel, as well as other international opportunities.
How to Apply 
You must submit a cover letter, resume and transcript as part of your application. Application deadline is October 23, 2026.

#IND-DNI

- Bachelor's degree with an anticipated graduation date of Winter 2026/2027 or Spring/Summer 2027
- English proficiency is required, as this role involves regular interaction with multi-national teams across our global enterprise
Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, Environmental Science, or a related discipline
- Relevant internship or co-op experience within consulting, industrial organizations, or the natural resources sector is an asset
- Exposure to industrial, mining, manufacturing, construction, or field-based project environments is an asset
- Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
- Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to effectively communicate complex concepts using visual tools
- Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate, influence, and build trust with clients and colleagues at all levels
- Proven drive for results, ownership, and delivering measurable business impact
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI or other data visualization tools is an asset
- Willingness and ability to travel for client engagements as business needs require, including potential for frequent on-site and field-based client presence
English is required for this position as this role will be aligned to multi-national teams where English is the common language across our Global Enterprise. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English-speaking multi-national teams, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company's activities to avoid this requirement.

There is never a typical day at Accenture, but that is why we love it here! This is an extraordinary opportunity to build a rewarding career at Accenture Banking & Capital Markets Technology Unit. Working in highly collaborative cross-border teams for world-leading clients, we will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity.
Whatever you are passionate about, make the most of it in a career with Accenture. Whether you are a strategic thinker, a digital innovator, a tech wizard, or a business problem solver, you will find an exciting career path on the cutting edge. We would love to get to know your unique blend of talents and help you explore and grow them further.
Accenture Banking & Capital Markets Technology Unit is part of the Accenture’s global capability network, and we serve several clients in Nordics and globally. Banking Technology is in the intersection of business and technology, and we have pure techies and more business-oriented people in the team. You’ll get access to Accenture’s vast knowledge base and experienced colleagues to help you to grow to next level on your professional career.
We are now looking for Capital Markets Consultant. As a senior advisor, you will be leading Accenture teams, providing senior advisory services for our banking clients’ leaders and driving our growth in industry. Your main goal is to help our clients to succeed in their initiatives – no matter whether it is on planning or execution stage. Your detailed work description and responsibilities will be determined by your engagement.
Responsibilities: 
- Ensuring our clients technology adoption and transformations are aligned with business goals and processes
- Problem and issue solving, analysis and business expertise
- Acting Capital Markets expert within Accenture industry group 
- Taking part or leading our sales and thought leadership pursuits within the industry
Professional Requirements:
- Bachelor’s or Master's degree from a technical or business school
- Ideally you would have at least 2-5 years of experience working in capital markets domain, for example in Wealth Management, Asset Management or Life Insurance
- Experience on technology initiatives and projects 
- Strong business acumen & technical knowledge on the E2E capital markets processes in different asset classes. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
- High drive, entrepreneurial attitude and good interpersonal skills 
- Excellent verbal and written communications skills in Finnish and English
- Resident in Finland
What is in it for you
- Benefit package with competitive salary, bonus, health insurance, employee stock purchase program and other benefits.
- 4 weeks of paid leave for the first summer working with us - employee wellbeing is highly valued topic for us. We want to ensure everyone gets the needed rest/time off during the summer.
- We believe in bringing the best to our clients through continuous learning & improvement – from basic skills to industry-specific content
- Mentoring and continuous evaluation that ensure your career continues to progress
- We offer a performance management process that focuses on your strengths, progress and career possibilities
- Flexible work arrangements for maintaining work-life balance
- International and cross-border expert teams guiding you in client engagements
- Work-life balance: good arrangements to combine family life with work and active support for mental health.
- Diverse, inclusive, and socially active workforce

jd_text:
About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.  
The Team
As part of the Transaction Advisory Group (TAG), you will join a dynamic, collaborative team delivering financial due diligence and advisory services to a wide range of clients. Our unique delivery model gives junior team members extensive exposure to senior leadership, accelerating learning and career growth. We invest in high‑performing talent from competitor firms and leading universities, offering the opportunity to work on challenging, high‑impact projects across multiple industries.
How you will contribute
As an Analyst, you will be part of the TAG team in Amsterdam,  gaining exposure to:
Supporting clients including private equity firms, corporates and financial institutions in their pre-deal and post-acquisition, restructuring and performance improvement activities
Contributing to financial modelling and analysis including cash flow models and projections
Conducting research and analysis to contribute to client reports and recommendations
Supporting Managing Directors and other senior members of the team with client pitch production
Researching key information on company financials, business performance and additional key information
Assist on financial due diligence and Restructuring assignments
Qualifications
Graduated from a Masters program or near the end of your studies with a strong educational background including a focus on Finance and / or Mathematics
Strong desire to progress in a career within Transactions Advisory
Previous experience in Audit or at an Advisory firm or a Private Equity fund is desirable but not essential
Fluent business level English and Dutch is essential.
Well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills
Proficient with Excel, Word and PowerPoint
Your journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
Culture & Values
At Alvarez & Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. jd_text:
Job Summary:
Join one of the fastest growing transaction advisory services practices in the country, where your talent and efforts are valued. Thrive in BDO’s entrepreneurial environment with an innovative and flat organizational structure. Be challenged based on your abilities and not your title. Be part of the number one middle market deals team and truly experience the opportunity of being an immediate contributor with real opportunities for career advancement. Work with industry leaders, technical experts and most importantly, people you enjoy spending time with. While BDO prides itself on the Firm’s work quality, it equally values work/life fit for its professionals, allowing them to focus on what’s important to them outside the office.
The Transaction Experienced Advisory Services Senior Associate will be responsible for managing financial, accounting and operational due diligence engagements for both strategic and financial buyers throughout the USA.
Job Duties:
- Prepares data book, reconciles company financial statements generates financial tables and analyses for due diligence report
- Analyzes financial forecasts, historical earnings, assets and liabilities of target client
- Performs industry and company research
- Collects information from all available sources related to the target client’s business
- Conducts on-site and / or phone interviews with C-level personnel or target client to gather additional information in support of the financial analysis
- Identifies and proposes appropriate resolutions to critical issues related to the M&A process
- Manages the relationship and information flow between BDO and the target client
- Partners with Transactional Services Senior Manager and Principal/Director to identify and pursue business development opportunities 
- Researches and develops proposal documents and may participate in presentations in pursuit of acquiring new clients
- Other duties as required
Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or Finance, required
- MBA, preferred
Experience:
- Four (4) or more years of public accounting experience, required
- One (1) or more years of prior TAS experience, preferred
- Prior experience interacting and working directly with C-level personnel, preferred
License/Certifications:

Vos missions

Du kommer att spela en central roll i att stödja det svenska försvarets pågående förmågetillväxt genom strategisk rådgivning, transformation och innovation.

keywords: transformation, AI, digital
jd_text:
Om rollen
Rollen är en unik möjlighet att leda och vidareutveckla Capgemini Invents försvarsaffär i Sverige, med särskilt fokus på Försvarsmakten, FMV och andra försvarsmyndigheter. Du kommer att spela en central roll i att stödja det svenska försvarets pågående förmågetillväxt genom strategisk rådgivning, transformation och innovation. Du blir en central partner till våra kunder inom försvarssektorn och driver kritiska initiativ som bidrar till att stärka svensk försvarsförmåga. Uppdraget innebär att du sätter dig in i kundernas verksamhet och behov, identifierar möjligheter och utformar lösningar med stöd av Capgemini Groups starka globala kapacitet inom rådgivning, försvarskunnande, teknologi, data och AI. Du har ett övergripande ansvar utveckla kundrelationen, identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och säkerställa långsiktigt och lönsamt samarbete med våra nyckelkunder inom försvarssegmentet. Genom att stärka partnerskapen och skapa tydliga, mätbara resultat bidrar du direkt till våra kunders framgång och till ett starkare och säkrare Sverige. Detta är ett av våra mest prioriterade områden och rollen har därför hög synlighet och stor strategisk betydelse.
Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden
- Bygga och utveckla strategiska kundrelationer inom försvarssektorn.
- Fördjupa dig i försvarsmyndigheternas uppdrag, förutsättningar och behov samt förstå hur Capgemini Invent bäst kan bidra till att skapa verklig effekt och stärkt svensk försvarsförmåga.
- Fungera som betrodd rådgivare till tjänstemän, chefer och ledande beslutsfattare samt utmana och vägleda deras strategiska riktning.
- Driva kommersiell tillväxt och utveckla försvarssegmentet långsiktigt.
- Leda affärsutveckling, från att identifiera nya möjligheter till att forma erbjudanden och vinna strategiska uppdrag.
- Expandera och utveckla försvarskonton samt bygga långsiktiga partnerskap med fokus på konkreta och mätbara resultat.
- Designa och leda transformationsprogram inom områden som verksamhetsutveckling, digitalisering, data och analys, AI samt större förmågehöjande initiativ.
- Samarbeta med tvärfunktionella experter och leveransteam inom Capgemini Group för att erbjuda integrerade och innovativa lösningar.
- Bidra till, samarbeta med och dra nytta av Capgeminis internationella försvarsexpertis genom Defense Europe.
- Bidra till att forma framtidens försvarsförmåga genom att driva dialogen kring områden som digital suveränitet, AI, cyberförsvar, interoperabilitet, data och försörjningsberedskap.
- Representera Capgemini Invent i försvars- och myndighetsekosystemet genom ledningsdialoger, konferenser, seminarier och branschforum.
- Leda, coacha och utveckla konsulter på alla nivåer.
- Främja en inkluderande, samarbetsinriktad och innovativ kultur inom Capgemini Invent.
Din profil
Du är en erfaren ledare med stark bakgrund inom offentlig sektor, försvarssektorn eller närliggande områden samt lång erfarenhet av konsultverksamhet och komplexa transformationer. Vi söker dig som har:
- Omfattande erfarenhet från statlig verksamhet eller försvarsrelaterade organisationer med god förståelse för styrning, regelverk, ekonomistyrning och beslutsprocesser.
- Stark kommersiell drivkraft och dokumenterat resultat inom affärsutveckling, kundansvar och långsiktig tillväxt.
- Etablerat nätverk och dokumenterad erfarenhet av att navigera komplexa beslutsmiljöer inom försvars- eller statlig sektor.
- Tryggt ledarskap och mycket god kommunikationsförmåga, med förmåga att påverka och bygga förtroende på högsta nivå.
- Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda komplexa transformationsprogram, exempelvis inom digitalisering, datadriven verksamhetsutveckling, organisationsförändring eller större strategiska initiativ.
- Akademisk examen inom exempelvis ekonomi, statsvetenskap, samhällsvetenskap, teknik eller motsvarande. Officersutbildning eller erfarenhet från Försvarsmakten, FMV eller annan försvarsrelaterad verksamhet är också meriterande.
- Flytande svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
- För rollen krävs svenskt medborgarskap och möjlighet att genomgå samt godkännas i säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen.
Varför Capgemini Invent
Att bli en del av Capgemini Invent innebär att ansluta till en global gemenskap av innovatörer, strateger, teknologer och förändringsledare som formar framtidens samhälle. Vi erbjuder:
- Meningsfull påverkan: Leda transformationer för några av Sveriges viktigaste myndigheter och bidra till att stärka svensk försvarsförmåga.
- Innovation i stor skala: Arbeta med spjutspetskompetens inom AI, data, cybersäkerhet, digital suveränitet och framtidens försvarsförmågor.
- Karriärutveckling: Tillgång till världsledande utbildningar, ledarskapsprogram, mentorskap och globala karriärmöjligheter.
- En samarbetsdriven kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av marknadens främsta experter i en kultur som värdesätter samarbete, entreprenörskap och kontinuerligt lärande.
- Global räckvidd, lokal påverkan: Kombinera styrkan från ett globalt nätverk med möjligheten att göra verklig skillnad för svenska kunder och samhället i stort.
Ansökan
I linje med vår tillitsbaserade kultur erbjuder Capgemini Invent ett flexibelt arbetssätt. Rollen är baserad på vårt centralt belägna kontor i Stockholm, med resor till kund vid behov.
Befattning och ansvarsnivå baseras på en helhetsbedömning av din erfarenhet och kompetens.
Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av giltig ID-handling, och bakgrundskontroller kan komma att genomföras där så är relevant.
Om Capgemini 
Capgemini är en global partner inom affärs- och tekniktransformation som hjälper organisationer att påskynda övergången till en digital och hållbar värld, och samtidigt gör skillnad för företag och samhälle. Det är en ansvarsfull och mångsidig organisation med 423 400 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Med ett starkt arv som sträcker sig över 55 år tillbaka har Capgemini sina kunders förtroende att hjälpa dem frigöra värdet av teknik för att tillgodose hela deras affärsbehov. Capgemini levererar helhetslösningar som utnyttjar styrkan från strategi och design till teknik. Allt drivet av en marknadsledande kapacitet inom AI, generativ AI, moln och data, kombinerat med en djup branschexpertis och ett ekosystem av partners. År 2025 rapporterade Capgemini Group globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro.

Présentation
Chez Capgemini Invent, nous croyons que l’innovation est le moteur du changement. En tant que consultants en transformation digitale et organisation, nous combinons nos capacités stratégiques, créatives et scientifiques, en collaborant étroitement avec nos clients pour leur fournir des solutions de pointe. Rejoignez-nous pour conduire une transformation adaptée aux défis d'aujourd'hui et de demain.
Vos missions
Intégrez notre équipe Aerospace & Défense, à Toulouse, pour participer à des projets de la transformation numérique de bout-en-bout, de la définition de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en œuvre dans les opérations, avec la data comme réacteur et une démarche de co-construction permanente orientée résultats, principalement dans le domaine de l’engineering et des opérations.
La transformation numérique n’est pas un événement ponctuel, il s’agit d’un processus continu. Nous développons des piliers clés pour soutenir nos clients au sein de l’industrie de l’aéronautique, du spatial et de la défense à chaque étape, notamment sur le plan de la continuité numérique pour la gestion du cycle de vie des produits (PLM), l’adoption de jumeaux numériques, l’optimisation de la main-d’œuvre et des processus, les usines logicielles et les modèles zéro émission nette.
Vous accompagnez les clients dans l’activation de l’ensemble des leviers à leur disposition pour améliorer leur compétitivité :
- Redéfinition des modèles opérationnels de l’ingénierie
- Optimisation de la performance des processus et activités d’ingénierie-
- Amélioration de la compétitivité du coût produit
- Implémentation de la continuité numérique sur le cycle de vie d’un produit
Quelques exemples de missions
- Ascendance Flight Technologies, faire de l’aviation décarbonée une réalité : rendre le pilotage d’un avion hybride le plus simple possible à utiliser pour que le pilote d’avion traditionnel ne soit pas dépaysé.
- Opérations nouvelle génération : contribuer à la transformation en participant à des programmes d’avions verts, des opérations axées sur les données et des systèmes autonomes. Aider à améliorer les opérations grâce à la production basée sur des données et des modèles, ainsi qu’à des services futurs tels que la mobilité urbaine, les dispositifs de surveillance des émissions de CO2 pour les compagnies aériennes et l’optimisation des opérations de démantèlement.
Votre profil
- Diplôme en Commerce, Ingénierie, ou Université avec intérêt pour transformation d'entreprise et innovation digitale.
- Expérience en conseil ou rôles opérationnels dans de grands groupes - à partir de 3-5 ans pour un rôle de Senior Consultant, à partir de 5 à 7 ans pour un rôle de Managing Consultant.
- Forte expertise sectorielle et connaissance des problématiques technologiques dans l’aéronautique, le spatial, la défense ou la construction navale.
- Expérience de pilotage des projets de transformation digitale dans les métiers de l’ingénierie et des organisations R&D.
- Français et anglais courant, mobile, curieux, et adaptable.
3 raisons de nous rejoindre
Qualité de vie au travail : accord de télétravail en France et à l’international, accord sur l’égalité professionnelle, la parentalité, l’équilibre des temps et la mobilité durable.
Apprentissage en continu : certifications et formations en libre accès, accompagnement sur mesure avec votre career manager, parcours d’intégration sur plusieurs mois.
Avantages groupe & CSE : plan actionnariat, tarifs préférentiels, remboursement partiel vacances, remboursement de votre abonnement sportif ou culturel
Nos engagements et priorités
Le groupe Capgemini encourage une culture inclusive dans un cadre multiculturel et handi-accueillant. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez un collectif qui valorise la diversité, développe le potentiel de ses talents, s’engage dans des initiatives solidaires avec ses partenaires, et se mobilise pour réduire son impact environnemental sur tous ses sites et auprès de ses clients.

Capgemini Invent est la marque d’innovation digitale, de design et de transformation du groupe Capgemini. Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

In this role, you'll work in one of our IBM Consulting FutureNow Centers, where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your role and responsibilities

As a Business Transformation Consultant specializing in Finance Transformation, you will help clients develop strategies that create and sustain competitive advantages. You will identify the necessary strategic capabilities and assess client performance gaps to deliver comprehensive transformation recommendations.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Develop Transformation Strategies: Develop comprehensive transformation recommendations addressing financial consolidation, close and reporting, planning, budgeting & forecasting, and financial business intelligence, analytics, and information management.

• Optimize Financial Processes: Help clients optimize financial consolidation, close and reporting processes, including chart of accounts design and configuration, and accelerate close processes.

• Support Planning and Budgeting: Assist with planning, budgeting & forecasting strategies, including Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) package evaluation, selection, and design.

• Enhance Financial Intelligence: Support financial business intelligence, analytics, and information management initiatives, such as financial and non-financial KPI rationalization, balanced scorecard design, and executive dashboard development.

• Assess Client Performance: Identify the necessary strategic capabilities and assess client performance gaps to inform transformation recommendations.

Required education
Bachelor's Degree
Preferred education
Master's Degree
Required technical and professional expertise

• Finance Transformation Expertise: Experience with financial consolidation, close and reporting processes, including chart of accounts design and configuration, and accelerating close processes.

• Strategic Capability Assessment: Experience in identifying necessary strategic capabilities and assessing client performance gaps to inform transformation recommendations.

• Enterprise Performance Management: Experience with Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) package evaluation, selection, and design for planning, budgeting, and forecasting strategies.

• Financial Intelligence Development: Experience in supporting financial business intelligence, analytics, and information management initiatives, such as financial and non-financial KPI rationalization and balanced scorecard design.

• Transformation Strategy Development: Experience in developing comprehensive transformation recommendations addressing financial consolidation, close and reporting, planning, budgeting, and forecasting.

Preferred technical and professional experience

• EPM Package Evaluation: Experience with evaluating, selecting, and designing Enterprise Performance Management packages for planning, budgeting, and forecasting strategies, including identifying client needs and assessing package functionality.

• Financial KPI Rationalization: Experience in rationalizing financial and non-financial KPIs, designing balanced scorecards, and developing executive dashboards to enhance financial business intelligence and analytics.

jd_text:
This Opportunity
WSP has an opportunity for an Environmental Compliance Consultant to join our Earth & Environment Team. The position will be based out of our Exton, PA office (Hybrid). This is an excellent opportunity for a mid-level professional to advance their career and collaborate with technical and professional experts within a leading global consulting company.
This role is ideal for a professional who enjoys supporting complex environmental compliance programs while remaining actively involved in regulatory compliance, auditing, technical reporting, and project delivery. The position combines environmental compliance consulting with opportunities to support project execution, develop client relationships, and mentor junior staff. 
The successful candidate will play a key role in:
- Supporting environmental compliance programs for industrial clients
- Conducting environmental regulatory compliance audits
- Preparing technical reports and communicating regulatory findings
- Managing tasks and projects in accordance with client-approved scopes of work
- Assisting in managing and developing client relationships
- Mentoring junior staff
Key Responsibilities
Technical Responsibilities
- Provide environmental compliance program support for industrial clients including but not limited to development and review of ongoing and new environmental compliance projects focused on:
- National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) stormwater permitting and management support
- Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plans (SWPPPs) and other Pollution Prevention Plans
- Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure (SPCC) and storage tank management programs
- Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) hazardous waste and non-hazardous waste reporting
- Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act (EPCRA) Tier II and Toxic Release Inventory (TRI) reporting
- Provide multi-media environmental support for compliance with applicable regulations, permits, and plans
- Conduct environmental regulatory compliance audits 
- Synthesize large amounts of information contained in regulatory files, environmental permits, and other environmental documentation 
- Prepare written and verbal technical reports, including documentation of audits and field investigations, evaluation of regulatory findings, and development of graphical and tabular presentations for data interpretation
Project Management & Team Leadership Responsibilities
- Manage tasks and projects according to client-approved scopes of work and deliver high-quality reports on time and within budget 
- Assist in managing and developing client relationships 
- Mentor junior staff 
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor of Science degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Earth Science or a related discipline 
- 7-10 years of experience with a working knowledge of U.S. environmental laws including but not limited to Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA), Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act (CERCLA), Superfund Amendments and Reauthorization Act (SARA), Clean Water Act (CWA), and Clean Air Act (CAA), and New Jersey and/or Pennsylvania state environmental regulations. 
- Experience evaluating and maintaining environmental regulatory compliance in industrial settings
- Strong analytical skills, independent problem solving, and application of knowledge gained through progressive experience 
- Interest and proficiency in investigative work with a high attention to detail
- Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills
- Self-sufficient, self-motivated, and able to work under pressure to meet deadlines. 
- Job assignments may involve work on waste disposal sites and sites requiring cleanup of hazardous substances. Participation in an OSHA-mandated medical surveillance program will be required, and safety training will be provided before being assigned to work on these sites. 
- Valid U.S. driver's license
- Must be willing to travel to client sites on short notice, including travel by air or land
- Overnight travel is required 
- Understanding the importance of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP's health, safety, drug/alcohol, and harassment policies.
- International regulatory knowledge 
- Experience conducting Phase I Environmental Site Assessments following ASTM International Standard E1527-13
- Experience in air permitting and asbestos surveys and management 
- Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Initiative (PSCI) auditing or compliance experience
Preferred Qualifications
- International regulatory knowledge 
- Experience conducting Phase I Environmental Site Assessments following ASTM International Standard E1527-13
- Experience in air permitting and asbestos surveys and management 
- Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Initiative (PSCI) auditing or compliance experience

Alvarez & Marsal Private Equity Performance Improvement
Associate, Procurement & Sourcing
(OPEN TO ALL U.S. LOCATIONS)
About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 13,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
The Team
A&M’s Private Equity Performance Improvement Services (PEPI) practice, with offices throughout the US, focuses on serving the middle market and large cap private equity firms who have engaged A&M to help improve operating results at their portfolio companies.   
Our professionals are aligned with a PEPI service line to promote the development of deep functional skills & experiences and to maximize our ability to tailor solutions to solve our clients' business issues. 
Our PEPI services include:
Supply Chain
Transformation Services
Manufacturing Operations Improvement
Interim Management
M&A Services
CFO Services
A&M’s Supply Chain professionals assist our clients in analyzing each part of the supply chain process including Strategic Sourcing and Procurement, Logistics and Distribution, Integrated Demand and Supply Planning to identify value creation opportunities, develop a roadmap to accelerate those opportunities and assist with driving them to our client’s bottom line.  From our thorough fact-based analysis, we assess the state of the supply chain, identify key risks to investment and quantify potential EBITDA improvement plans. 
The PEPI Supply Chain group is a growing business with high growth projected throughout the next two to four years. We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement and build leadership skills. The leadership team is focused on providing development opportunities, training and exposure to international and domestic business assignments.
How You Will Contribute 
We are seeking individuals that can lead and deliver project work streams for complex client engagements working closely with Private Equity teams to identify, design, and implement creative business solutions for their portfolio companies. 
Associates support the following types of workstreams and may be asked to conduct analysis as well as execute with team members to deliver results:
Gain a comprehensive understanding of a client’s procurement organization and strategic sourcing capabilities
Assist in the development and implementation of sourcing strategies to meet growth and financial objectives through effective integration with forecasting, demand/supply planning, inventory management, and distribution & logistics
Assist in developing and managing efforts in sourcing and procurement
Lead supplier identification, approval, contract/pricing negotiations and vendor relations
Develop implementation plans to drive proposed changes in procurement and sourcing initiatives
 Conduct analysis depending on project scope.
Professional skills:
Strong written, oral, and analytical skills
Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
Structured project management (time, team and work-stream management)
Initiative and drive
Critical thinking skills
Ability to deliver time-pressured projects on-time and on-quality
Flexible and creative thinking
Client relationship building
Excellent presentation skills
Qualifications:
2-4 plus years of consulting or industry experience
Previous advisory experience from a top-tier strategy firm or Big-4 consultancy REQUIRED
Preference for industry roles within Sourcing and Procurement functions
Industry experience in direct and/or indirect categories
Bachelor’s degree required in Business Administration, Economics, Finance or related fields
MBA/Master’s degree preferred
Experience managing direct and / or indirect categories
Demonstrated track record of leading sustainable high-impact strategic sourcing approaches
Exemplary experience designing end-to-end procurement strategies
Excellent fact-gathering and analytical skills, including business process mapping and quantitative analysis
Flexibility to travel up to 80% of the time
Your journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
The salary range is $90,000--$130,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance.  Please ask your recruiter for details.
Full-time Positions and Part-time Positions Over 30 hours
Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined from time to time as well as a 401(k) retirement plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive a discretionary contribution to their 401(k) from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs.
Alvarez & Marsal recruits on an ongoing basis. Candidates are considered as they apply, until the opportunity is filled. Candidates are encouraged to apply expeditiously to any role(s) that they are qualified for and that are of interest to them.
A&M does not require or administer lie detector tests as a condition of employment or continued employment. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

At Alvarez & Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.

- Act as the entrepreneur of your own career by defining and executing business development and sales initiatives.

jd_text:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your role and responsibilities

This job can be performed from anywhere in the US.




As a Business Transformation Consultant specializing in the insurance sector, you will guide insurance institutions through strategic business transformation and related supply chain processes. Your focus will be on optimizing insurance operations, including core insurance back-office transformations, to drive business growth and efficiency.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Drive Business Transformation: Develop and implement transformative strategies that align with clients' business goals, leveraging your deep understanding of the insurance services industry and processes.

• Optimize Insurance Operations: Analyze and improve core insurance back-office processes to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer engagement.

• Integrate Third-Party Services: Collaborate with clients to integrate third-party services, streamlining operations and enhancing customer experience.

• Consult and Support Clients: Provide expert guidance and support to clients, helping them navigate complex business transformations and achieve their strategic objectives.

• Align with Business Goals: Ensure that transformation initiatives align with clients' overall business strategies, driving growth, and profitability.

Required education
Bachelor's Degree
Preferred education
Master's Degree
Required technical and professional expertise

• Deep Insurance Industry Knowledge: Proven expertise in the insurance services industry, including a thorough understanding of its processes, operations, and business goals.

• Business Transformation Experience: Experience in developing and implementing transformative strategies that drive business growth and efficiency in the insurance sector.

• Core Insurance Operations Understanding: In-depth knowledge of core insurance back-office processes, including the ability to analyze and improve operational efficiency.

• Supply Chain Process Expertise: Experience with insurance-related supply chain processes, including the integration of third-party services to enhance customer engagement and streamline operations.

• Strategic Consulting Experience: Proven ability to consult and support clients in implementing transformative strategies that align with their business goals.

Preferred technical and professional experience

• Insurance Technology Knowledge: Familiarity with insurance technology platforms and tools that support business transformation and core insurance operations.

• Data Analysis Skills: Ability to collect, analyze, and interpret large data sets to inform business transformation strategies and optimize insurance operations.

• Change Management Expertise: Experience with organizational change management principles and methodologies to support clients in implementing transformative strategies.

ABOUT BUSINESS UNIT
IBM Consulting is IBM’s consulting and global professional services business, with market leading capabilities in business and technology transformation. With deep expertise in many industries, we offer strategy, experience, technology, and operations services to many of the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Our people are focused on accelerating our clients’ businesses through the power of collaboration. We believe in the power of technology responsibly used to help people, partners and the planet.
YOUR LIFE @ IBM

In a world where technology never stands still, we understand that, dedication to our clients success, innovation that matters, and trust and personal responsibility in all our relationships, lives in what we do as IBMers as we strive to be the catalyst that makes the world work better.

Being an IBMer means you’ll be able to learn and develop yourself and your career, you’ll be encouraged to be courageous and experiment everyday, all whilst having continuous trust and support in an environment where everyone can thrive whatever their personal or professional background.

 

Our IBMers are growth minded, always staying curious, open to feedback and learning new information and skills to constantly transform themselves and our company. They are trusted to provide on-going feedback to help other IBMers grow, as well as collaborate with colleagues keeping in mind a team focused approach to include different perspectives to drive exceptional outcomes for our customers. The courage our IBMers have to make critical decisions everyday is essential to IBM becoming the catalyst for progress, always embracing challenges with resources they have to hand, a can-do attitude and always striving for an outcome focused approach within everything that they do.

 

Are you ready to be an IBMer?

ABOUT IBM

IBM’s greatest invention is the IBMer. We believe that through the application of intelligence, reason and science, we can improve business, society and the human condition, bringing the power of an open hybrid cloud and AI strategy to life for our clients and partners around the world.

 

Restlessly reinventing since 1911, we are not only one of the largest corporate organizations in the world, we’re also one of the biggest technology and consulting employers, with many of the Fortune 500 companies relying on the IBM Cloud to run their business. 

 

At IBM, we pride ourselves on being an early adopter of artificial intelligence, quantum computing and blockchain. Now it’s time for you to join us on our journey to being a responsible technology innovator and a force for good in the world.

IBM is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, disability, neurodivergence, age, or other characteristics protected by the applicable law. IBM is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

OTHER RELEVANT JOB DETAILS

IBM offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program. Eligible employees may have access to:

 

- Healthcare benefits including medical & prescription drug coverage, dental, vision, and mental health & well being

- Financial programs such as 401(k), cash balance pension plan, the IBM Employee Stock Purchase Plan, financial counseling, life insurance, short & long- term disability coverage, and opportunities for performance based salary incentive programs

- Generous paid time off including 12 holidays, minimum 56 hours sick time, 120 hours vacation, 12 weeks parental bonding leave in accordance with IBM Policy, and other Paid Care Leave programs. IBM also offers paid family leave benefits to eligible employees where required by applicable law

- Training and educational resources on our personalized, AI-driven learning platform where IBMers can grow skills and obtain industry-recognized certifications to achieve their career goals

- Diverse and inclusive employee resource groups, giving & volunteer opportunities, and discounts on retail products, services & experiences

 

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable law.

 

This position was posted on the date cited in the key job details section and is anticipated to remain posted for 21 days from this date or less if not needed to fill the role.  

 

IBM will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

The compensation range and benefits for this position are based on a full-time schedule for a full calendar year. The salary will vary depending on your job-related skills, experience and location. Pay increment and frequency of pay will be in accordance with employment classification and applicable laws. For part time roles, your compensation and benefits will be adjusted to reflect your hours. Benefits may be pro-rated for those who start working during the calendar year.

JOB REQUISITION
Business Performance Improvement - Strategic Sourcing & Procurement Senior Consultant
LOCATION
CHICAGO

JOB DESCRIPTION
You Belong Here
The Protiviti Career provides opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture. We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver. 
At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.
Where We Need You
Protiviti is looking for a Supply Chain & Operations Experienced Senior Consultant to join our growing Supply Chain & Operations Innovation team.
What You Can Expect
As an Experienced Senior Consultant, you will be a mentor, trainer, and coach to Interns and Consultants as you facilitate the successful completion of project work plans. You’ll identify areas of risk and opportunities to increase efficiency. You’ll strengthen relationships and deepen your abilities to communicate, gain trust, and network with client personnel and professional associates. At the direction of Managers, you may accept responsibility for decision-making in areas including establishing project scope and work plans, project staffing, preparation of deliverables, and application of methodologies.
What Will Help You Be Successful
- You enjoy process, relevant analytics and metrics, organization, and strategic design.
- You are motivated to learn and interested in all things related to strategic sourcing and supplier management, including the latest trends and developments.
- You are passionate about building relationships with clients and providing clients with exceptional experiences. 
- You have an inherent interest in project management and team leadership. 
- You contribute to a positive team culture that fosters open communication among all engagement team members.  
- You create development opportunities for others and ways for your team to improve our clients and communities. 
- You have interest in working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries. 
Do Your Talents Include the Following?
Demonstrated experience with:
- Core supply chain processes such as Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Contract Management, Supplier Management, Accounts Payable

jd_text:
ERM is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
Our Consulting Delivery Hub (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
Why this role matters?
As a Socioeconomic Consultant, you will support ERM's global Capital Project Delivery (CPD) work by leading discrete socio-economic workstreams and producing high-quality analysis, impact assessment and social value inputs to major infrastructure, energy, mining and transition projects. You will work within the Social Sustainability sub‑team, partnering with regional consultants across NEBU and EMEA — including Impact Assessment, Stakeholder Engagement, Sustainable Finance, Human Rights and Political Risk leads — to deliver defensible socio-economic baselines, impact assessments and mitigation frameworks that de-risk projects and maximise positive community outcomes. This role is critical to scaling ERM's socio-economic delivery capacity, supporting CPD projects to secure consents, achieve social licence to operate, and meet growing lender, regulator and community expectations for robust socio-economic evidence.
What your impact is?
- Support socio-economic baselines and impact assessment chapters.
- Lead economic appraisal, quantification of jobs and GVA effects, and social value analysis to strengthen client business cases, funding bids and consent applications.
- Manage discrete workstreams and small project teams (1–2 people), coordinating CDH and regional inputs to deliver on time, on budget and to quality.
- Act as a trusted day-to-day point of contact for clients on socio-economic workstreams, presenting findings clearly and responding to client and regulator queries.
- Contribute socio-economic evidence across CPD sectors.
- Support bids, proposals and thought leadership.
What will you bring?
- Bachelor's degree in economics, human geography, sociology, planning, public policy, development studies or a closely related social science discipline; a master's is desirable.
- 2–3 years' relevant experience in consulting, research or policy, with a demonstrable track record of delivering socio-economic analysis, impact assessment or economic appraisal outputs.
- Proven ability to independently draft socio-economic baseline and impact assessment chapters for EIA/ESIA, or comparable economic appraisal / business case outputs.
- Sound working knowledge of UK/Irish EIA and consenting regimes (e.g. DCO, Section 36, TCPA, Planning (Wales) Act) and/or international frameworks such as the IFC Performance Standards and Equator Principles.
- Strong quantitative and qualitative research skills, including confident use of Census, ONS/NRS/NISRA/CSO, Nomis, BRES, ASHE and IMD datasets, and application of HM Treasury Green Book principles to economic.
- Experience managing discrete workstreams or small teams, including planning, budgeting, quality review and client liaison.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex socio-economic evidence into clear outputs for regulators, clients and communities.
- Strong commercial awareness and ability to work efficiently within scope, budget and time constraints.
Preferred skills & competencies
- Experience delivering socio-economic chapters for NSIPs, DCOs or comparable major infrastructure consenting regimes, or ESIA socio-economics chapters aligned with IFC PS/Equator Principles.
- Exposure to Social Impact Assessment, social value, community benefits, just transition or deliberative engagement approaches.
- Experience working in a global delivery, shared service or hub environment across time zones.
- Familiarity with automation, AI-enabled tools or GIS to support socio-economic analysis and reporting.
Key responsibilities
- Lead the preparation of socio-economic baselines drawing on Census, labour market, deprivation, housing, health, tourism and industry datasets at national, regional, local and neighbourhood scales.
- Identify and assess likely significant socio-economic effects (employment, GVA, population and demographic change, housing, community infrastructure, tourism and recreation, sociocultural effects, sense of place) across construction, operation and decommissioning phases.
- Apply and, where appropriate, refine assessment methodologies covering sensitivity/magnitude, mitigation hierarchy, cumulative effects and distributional impacts.
- Draft scoping reports, EIA/ESIA socio-economic chapters, standalone Socio-economic Statements (SES), technical notes, and inputs to ESMPs, Livelihood Restoration Frameworks and community benefit strategies.
- Deliver quantitative economic modelling of direct, indirect and induced jobs and GVA, and qualitative assessment of wider socio-economic, sociocultural and tourism effects.
- Support stakeholder mapping and engagement and integrate stakeholder feedback into socio-economic scoping and assessment.
- Manage discrete workstreams end-to-end — including scoping, planning, delivery, quality review and client communication — and coordinate CDH inputs with regional teams.
- Contribute to bids, proposals and internal capability building, including standardising templates, tools and methodologies.
- Maintain current knowledge of UK, Irish and international socio-economic policy and guidance (e.g. ISEP SIA guidance, IFC PS, HM Treasury Green Book, Well-being of Future Generations (Wales) Act, NPF4).
- Adhere to ERM's Health & Safety, ethics and quality management systems in all project work.

Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

In this role, you'll work in one of our IBM Consulting FutureNow Centers, where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your role and responsibilities

As a Business Transformation Consultant specializing in Supply Chain Planning, you will help clients optimize their supply chain operations to achieve better advantaged pricing, greater efficiency, and improved service levels. This role involves identifying and implementing supply chain improvements, transforming operations, and refining or developing business strategies.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Identify Supply Chain Improvements: Analyze existing supply chain operations to identify areas for improvement, and develop strategies to implement changes that drive efficiency and effectiveness.

• Transform Operations: Work with clients to transform their supply chain operations, from suppliers to the ultimate client, to achieve better advantaged pricing and improved service levels.

• Refine Business Strategies: Collaborate with clients to refine or develop business strategies in targeted areas or across the whole supply chain, driving strategic change and competitive advantage.

• Drive Operational Improvements: Recognize operational improvements across various value chain areas, and implement changes to drive next-generation supply chain operations.

• Implement Supply Chain Solutions: Apply knowledge and expertise to implement supply chain solutions that meet client needs and drive business results.

jd_text:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

In this role, you'll work in one of our IBM Consulting FutureNow Centers, where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your role and responsibilities

As a Business Transformation Consultant with a focus on finance and business analytics, you will serve as a strategic advisor to clients for their Enterprise Planning and Performance Management needs. You will design, build, and manage planning and performance management technology solutions that assist clients' corporate strategy to execution process.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Design and Build Solutions: Design, build, and manage planning and performance management technology solutions that meet clients' needs, utilizing technical proficiency in AI-infused extended Planning, Analytics (xP&A) and Performance Management platforms.

• Analyze Data and Drive Insights: Analyze data to drive insights and make data-driven decisions, effectively communicating these insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive performance management discussions.

• Identify Performance Gaps: Identify performance gaps, implement change, and develop comprehensive transformation recommendations to address these gaps, combining business acumen, technical expertise, and strong communication skills.

• Deliver Client-Facing Solutions: Deliver client-facing solutions, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and preferences, and providing tailored solutions to meet their Enterprise Planning and Performance Management requirements.

• Apply Technical Expertise: Apply technical expertise in AI/ML infused forecasting algorithms and financial planning processes to drive successful Financial Reporting, Planning, and Performance Management projects at the Enterprise level.

Required education
Bachelor's Degree
Preferred education
Master's Degree
Required technical and professional expertise

• Exposure to AI-infused extended Planning, Analytics (xP&A) and Performance Management platforms: Proficiency in designing, building, and managing planning and performance management technology solutions using platforms like IBM Planning Analytics, Cognos Controller, and other cloud financial planning & performance management software.

• Experience working with AI/ML infused forecasting algorithms: Knowledge and application of AI/ML infused forecasting algorithms to drive insights and make data-driven decisions.

• Understanding of Financial Planning Processes: Familiarity with financial planning processes, including strategy, marketing, sales & operations planning, capital planning, project planning, production and capacity planning, long-range forecasting, rolling forecasts, cash flow forecasting, and financial statement (B/S and P&L) planning and financial modeling.

• Exposure to Data Analysis and Insights: Ability to analyze data to drive insights and make data-driven decisions, with effective communication of these insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience with Performance Management: Understanding of performance management principles, including identifying performance gaps, implementing change, and developing comprehensive transformation recommendations to address these gaps.

Preferred technical and professional experience

• Cloud Financial Planning Software: Exposure to cloud financial planning and performance management software, such as IBM Planning Analytics and Cognos Controller, to design, build, and manage planning and performance management technology solutions.

• Advanced Data Analysis Tools: Experience working with advanced data analysis tools and techniques to drive insights and make data-driven decisions.

• Machine Learning Algorithms: Exposure to machine learning algorithms and their application in financial planning and performance management to drive successful projects at the Enterprise level.

Years of Experience:6 - 7
ABOUT BUSINESS UNIT
IBM Consulting is IBM’s consulting and global professional services business, with market leading capabilities in business and technology transformation. With deep expertise in many industries, we offer strategy, experience, technology, and operations services to many of the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Our people are focused on accelerating our clients’ businesses through the power of collaboration. We believe in the power of technology responsibly used to help people, partners and the planet.
YOUR LIFE @ IBM

In a world where technology never stands still, we understand that, dedication to our clients success, innovation that matters, and trust and personal responsibility in all our relationships, lives in what we do as IBMers as we strive to be the catalyst that makes the world work better.

Being an IBMer means you’ll be able to learn and develop yourself and your career, you’ll be encouraged to be courageous and experiment everyday, all whilst having continuous trust and support in an environment where everyone can thrive whatever their personal or professional background.

 

Our IBMers are growth minded, always staying curious, open to feedback and learning new information and skills to constantly transform themselves and our company. They are trusted to provide on-going feedback to help other IBMers grow, as well as collaborate with colleagues keeping in mind a team focused approach to include different perspectives to drive exceptional outcomes for our customers. The courage our IBMers have to make critical decisions everyday is essential to IBM becoming the catalyst for progress, always embracing challenges with resources they have to hand, a can-do attitude and always striving for an outcome focused approach within everything that they do.

 

Are you ready to be an IBMer?

ABOUT IBM

IBM’s greatest invention is the IBMer. We believe that through the application of intelligence, reason and science, we can improve business, society and the human condition, bringing the power of an open hybrid cloud and AI strategy to life for our clients and partners around the world.

 

Restlessly reinventing since 1911, we are not only one of the largest corporate organizations in the world, we’re also one of the biggest technology and consulting employers, with many of the Fortune 500 companies relying on the IBM Cloud to run their business. 

 

At IBM, we pride ourselves on being an early adopter of artificial intelligence, quantum computing and blockchain. Now it’s time for you to join us on our journey to being a responsible technology innovator and a force for good in the world.

Our Consulting Delivery Hub (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
Why this role matters?
As an ESMS Specialist, you will support ERM’s global consulting delivery by developing and implementing Environmental and Social Management Systems (ESMS) that are aligned with international standards such as but not limited to IFC PS, WB ESS (knowledge of European, African and Asian IFI’s standard are a plus). You will work within the Impact Assessment capability of the CPD service line, partnering with regional consultants and global client teams to deliver robust, standards-compliant management systems. This role is critical to the quality, consistency, and international compliance of ERM’s environmental and social advisory delivery.
What your impact is?
- Environmental and Social Management Systems (ESMS) are developed and implemented in line with IFC Performance Standard 1 (PS1) and other relevant international standards.
- Environmental and Social Management Plans (ESMPs), manuals, action plans, and policies are delivered to a high, audit-ready standard.
- Regional consulting teams and clients receive timely, specialist ESMS support that strengthens delivery quality and efficiency.
- Management systems remain current and are continuously improved to reflect evolving international requirements and lender expectations.
- Client projects consistently meet regulatory, lender, and international governance requirements for environmental and social management.
What will you bring?
- Strong working knowledge of relevant international standards and associated lender frameworks.
- Experience developing and implementing Environmental and Social Management Systems (ESMS) within a consulting, sustainability, or industry environment.
- Proven ability to produce ESMPs, management manuals, action plans, and policies to a high standard.
- Proficiency in English (essential) together with French, Italian, or Spanish — priority given to French speakers.
- Experience working with global teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical writing capability.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver to deadlines.
Preferred skills & competencies
- Experience implementing ESMS across sectors such as infrastructure, energy, or industrial development.
- Exposure to global delivery or shared service environments.
- Familiarity with additional international frameworks (e.g., the Equator Principles, IFC Performance Standards 2–8, World Bank Group EHS Guidelines).
- Experience using automation or AI-enabled tools.
- Relevant certifications or advanced qualifications in environmental and social management.
Key responsibilities
- Design, develop, and implement Environmental and Social Management Systems (ESMS) aligned with international standards (IFC PS1, ESMPs, manuals, action plans, and policies).
- Prepare, maintain, and update Environmental and Social Management Plans (ESMPs) and supporting management-system documentation.
- Advise regional consultants and clients on the application of international environmental and social standards.
- Review and continuously improve management systems to ensure ongoing compliance with international and lender requirements.
- Collaborate with global project teams to ensure consistent, high-quality, and efficient delivery.

The Network Industries Strategies (“NIS”) group at FTI Consulting uses economic and financial analysis and market modeling to analyze complex issues involving pricing, valuation, sustainability, and costs of service across the spectrum of network industries. - Support clients in their inorganic growth agenda across the deal lifecycle, i.e., target screening, synergy assessment, due diligence, post-merger integration and portfolio interventions.

- Experience working with “C level” executive clients, with extensive experience in projects in which the primary stakeholder was the CEO; Chief Strategy Officer

ARE YOU READY to step up to Accenture’s Strategy and Consulting role?
There is never a typical day at Accenture, but that’s why we love it here! This is an extraordinary opportunity to build a rewarding career at Accenture Strategy & Consulting. Working in highly collaborative teams for world-leading clients, we’ll nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. Whatever your work and life goals, we’ll help you achieve them. Sooner.
Join Accenture Strategy & Consulting and thrive in a digitally driven, innovation-led environment where you can help clients shift to the New using leading-edge technologies on some of the coolest projects you can imagine.
WORK YOU’LL DO
Technology Strategy & Consulting works with senior leaders to shape direction and deliver technology-enabled transformation with enduring impact. As an Analyst / Consultant, you will operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution, helping clients make sense of complexity, forming clear perspectives, and translate ideas into meaningful change.
You will be driven by curiosity, energized by complex problems, and eager to explore how emerging technologies-including AI-can be applied thoughtfully to create real business advantage. From day one, you will be exposed to senior stakeholders, intellectually demanding work, and opportunities to grow rapidly through experience and mentorship.

- Contribute to client engagements through rigorous analysis, structured thinking, and a relentless focus on insight and impact
- Break down complex, loosely defined problems into clear hypotheses, logical workstreams, and robust analytical outputs
- Research and assess technology & business trends, developing informed perspectives on how organizations can innovate, compete, and adapt
- Prepare concise, executive-ready materials that communicate complex ideas with clarity, precision, and confidence
- Work collaboratively within high-performing teams, contributing reliably while maintaining exacting standards for quality and intellectual rigour
- Engage with Digital, Data & AI initiatives, helping to explore innovative use cases, assess value potential, and understand implications for operations, risk, and governance
- Demonstrate continuous learning and curiosity-staying abreast of emerging technologies (including GenAI), evolving business models, and industry developments
- Contribute to practice development through research, knowledge assets, and support to proposals, thought leadership, and innovation initiatives

The Team
The Performance Improvement (Management Consulting) Practice works with Private Equity and Corporate clients all over the world. Conduct research and gather from all sources of information

Cooperate with the team leader to understand different stakeholders’ perspective

Analyze & present statistical & market data, and perform financial analysis

High energy, autonomous, get-it-done, entrepreneurial mindset—seizing small moments to make them bigger
Thrives in a fast-paced, challenging, and unpredictable environment—looking beyond constraints for solutions

Keenesss to go above and beyond, with integrity and empathy, to create lasting results
Passionate about quality and objectivity of your work

We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey.
