jd_text:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client’s challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
About the Job You’re Considering
As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.
frog is the customer experience and design practice of Capgemini Invent and the reinvention and experience partner for the eco-digital era. We work at the intersection of business strategy, experience design, and applied technology, bringing together strategists, designers, engineers, and data scientists. We start with the customer and carry our ideas through to production.
Within frog’s Customer Transformation practice, we help clients reinvent how they serve their customers. Our work combines business strategy, service and experience design, data, technology, and AI to transform contact centers and customer service operations. We help clients determine what to automate, what to augment, and how to improve customer outcomes while reducing cost to serve.
Your Role
As a Consultant or Senior Consultant, Service & Contact Center Transformation, you will lead or support workstreams focused on transforming how organizations serve their customers across voice, digital, and assisted channels. You will use quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify the drivers of customer demand, evaluate operational performance, and build the case for service transformation.
Working alongside practice leaders and multidisciplinary teams, you will contribute from current-state diagnostic and experience design through solution development, implementation, adoption, and value realization. You will collaborate with client stakeholders, designers, technology specialists, and operational leaders to develop practical recommendations that improve customer experience, frontline effectiveness, and contact center economics.
Key responsibilities include:
- Lead or support workstreams within contact center and customer service transformation engagements, from current-state assessment and discovery through solution design, production, adoption, and value realization.
- Conduct client and customer interviews, journey mapping, call-driver and intent analysis, operational benchmarking, and cost-to-serve modeling to identify the root causes of contact demand and performance challenges.
- Develop current-state assessments, journey maps, service blueprints, operating model options, transformation roadmaps, financial models, and business cases that translate analysis into clear recommendations.
- Support the design of AI-enabled service solutions incorporating voice AI agents, agent assist, next best action, intelligent routing, knowledge management, digital self-service, real-time monitoring, and effective human handoffs.
- Facilitate client workshops and working sessions, support proposals and oral presentations, contribute to change management and adoption, and help develop points of view, reusable assets, and junior team members.
Your Skills + Experience
You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI-driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.
You are skilled at structuring complex business problems, finding insights in qualitative and quantitative data, and building a compelling case for change. You understand how service strategy, experience design, operations, data, and technology come together to shape customer and frontline experiences.
You can engage in discussions about how telephony, routing, IVR, Contact Center as a Service, CRM, agent desktops, knowledge management, workforce management, quality management, and analytics operate as an integrated ecosystem. You bring deeper expertise in at least one area and have the curiosity and aptitude to build broader platform knowledge.
You understand the operational and financial measures that underpin service transformation, including containment, average handle time, first-contact resolution, transfer rate, customer satisfaction, and cost per contact. You can use these measures to establish performance baselines, evaluate opportunities, and support a credible business case.
Required Experience:
- Three or more years of relevant experience in management consulting, digital services, contact center operations, or customer service transformation. Candidates with five or more years of relevant experience may be considered for the Senior Consultant level.
- Functional depth in at least two areas such as customer service transformation, service experience design, contact forecasting and workforce management, quality management, IVR and routing design, conversational AI, speech analytics, performance measurement and KPIs, or omnichannel engagement.
- Strong analytical capabilities, including experience working with customer interaction data, call drivers, intent analysis, operational benchmarks, financial models, and contact center performance measures.
- Ability to collaborate across business strategy, experience design, operations, data, and technology; facilitate client workshops; synthesize findings; and communicate clear recommendations to client and project stakeholders.
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, with the ability to travel up to 50% on average based on project and client needs.
Preferred Experience:
- Experience combining business strategy with experience design, service design, conversation design, or user research, including exposure to both sales and service transformation.
- Exposure to Google’s contact center portfolio, including Customer Engagement Suite, CCAI Platform, Agent Assist, Conversational Agents, and Dialogflow CX, or emerging conversational AI platforms such as Sierra or Decagon.
- Familiarity with platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud CX, NICE CXone, Five9, Verint, Salesforce Service Cloud Voice, Agentforce Contact Center, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Contact Center, Cresta, or Observe.AI.
- Experience in telecommunications, insurance, or financial services, with an understanding of how regulatory requirements affect automation and customer interactions.
- A current Contact Center as a Service or conversational AI platform certification, a willingness to obtain relevant certification, or an advanced degree such as an MBA.

jd_text:
Présentation 
Chez Capgemini Invent, nous croyons que l’innovation est le moteur du changement. En tant que consultant en transformation digitale, nous combinons nos capacités stratégiques, créatives et scientifiques, en collaborant étroitement avec nos clients pour leur fournir des solutions de pointe. Rejoignez-nous pour conduire une transformation adaptée aux défis d'aujourd'hui et de demain.
Au sein de Consumer Product Retail Distribution (CPRD), nous travaillons pour la plupart des leaders des secteurs suivants :
- Luxe
- Retail
- Produits de consommation
- Agroalimentaire et Food & Beverage
Le secteur CPRD est prioritaire pour le groupe Capgemini. Il mobilise environ 4500 collaborateurs et implique près de 500 experts à travers le monde. Nous intervenons sur l’ensemble de la chaine de valeur de nos clients: innovations technologiques au service d’une nouvelle expérience client, développement du e-commerce renforcé par le social commerce, réinvention de la fidélité, design et mise en œuvre de nouveaux modèles opérationnels, économiquement viables et permettant le développement de nouveaux services, identification et mise en œuvre de nouveaux business models, optimisation de processus métier, définition de Target Operating Models, développement de solutions permettant de répondre à l’accélération d’une consommation responsable, sociétale et environnementale, etc.
Vos missions
Intégrez notre équipe Consummer Products Retail Distribution pour participer à des projets de transformation d’envergure, de la définition de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle, en passant par la refonte des organisations et des processus, en lien avec l’intégration d’innovations technologiques et d’enjeux de data. 
Vous accompagnerez vos clients dans la résolution de problématiques liées aux fonctions cœur de métier du secteur : (Digital, Vente, E-commerce, Achat, Supply Chain, Marketing et Finance) pour les aider à mettre en place de nouvelles solutions clients ou réponses organisationnelles améliorant leur compétitivité.
Vous travaillerez sur les problématiques liées aux enjeux du secteur dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : Digital, Marketing, Vente, Achat, Supply Chain, Finance, RH, IT, RSE, etc. 
Vous accompagnerez vos clients dans l’activation de l’ensemble des leviers à leur disposition pour améliorer leur compétitivité.
Exemple de missions
- Transformation du modèle opérationnel omnicanal pour une marque de maroquinerie de luxe
- Lancement d’un programme de fidélité innovant permettant de transformer la relation client pour un retailer spécialisé
- Cadrage et mise en place d’un outil de développement produit pour un acteur de la cosmétique 
- Transformation de la direction Digitale d’un acteur de la distribution spécialisée
- Refonte du processus de développement produit de la marque distributeur d’un acteur de la grande distribution alimentaire 
- Refonte de l’ensemble du schéma directeur supply chain pour un acteur de la grande consommation
- Cadrage des use case innovants technologiques pour un acteur de la distribution B2B
- Définition d’un schéma directeur IT pour un acteur de l’agroalimentaire
- Mise en œuvre d’un audit IT pour un acteur de l’agroalimentaire
- Structurer les possibilités de financement de la transition bas-carbone pour l’agriculture, pour une association française leader en label bas-carbone
Votre profil
- Diplômé(e) d’une école de Commerce, d’une école d’Ingénieur ou d’une Université, vous avez une appétence marquée pour les sujets liés à l’innovation digitale, la transformation et la conduite de projets. 
- 3+ ans d'expérience idéalement dans les deux domaines : secteur CPRD et conseil en organisation, stratégie et transformation. 
- Forte expertise sectorielle et connaissance des problématiques du secteur. 
- Excellentes compétences analytiques et capacités d’organisation, force de proposition, curieux, adaptable et mobile.
- Excellentes capacités d’expression, orale et écrite, français et anglais courant. 
3 raisons de nous rejoindre
- Communauté d’experts : rejoignez un réseau international de consultants, managers et directeurs engagés dans la transformation digitale. Participez à des programmes comme l’IMA (Invent Manager Academy) ou l’IDE (Invent Director Experience) pour renforcer votre leadership et échanger avec la communauté mondiale de Capgemini Invent.
- Apprentissage en continu : bénéficiez d’un accompagnement dédié, et accélérez votre montée en compétences grâce à des formations ciblées et à votre implication dans le Consulting Skills Workshop.
- Événements : participez à InventX, notre événement mondial organisé à Paris et en ligne, réunissant la communauté Capgemini Invent autour d’expériences de formation innovantes.
A propos de Capgemini Invent
Capgemini Invent est la marque d’innovation digitale, de design et de transformation du groupe Capgemini. Etablie dans plus de 30 studios et plus de 60 dans le monde, elle compte une équipe de plus de 12 500 experts en stratégie, data scientists, concepteurs de produits et d’expériences ou encore experts en marques et en technologie qui développent de nouveaux services digitaux, produits, expériences et modèles d’affaire pour une croissance durable.    
Get The Future You Want* | www.capgemini.com/fr-fr

jd_text:
ERM Australia is looking for early career consultants who are inquisitive, inspired, bring a new way of thinking, who can challenge the status quo to address the sustainability challenges facing businesses around the world and who want to work with companies that are leading the change.
ERM is in the business of sustainability shaping a sustainable future with the world’s leading organisations. As an early career consultant, you will kick start your career in the world’s largest pure-play sustainability consultancy, supporting Australian and global clients on climate strategy and emissions accounting.
During your career at ERM, you will have unrivalled professional development opportunities, made possible by the breadth and complexity of projects our clients trust us to deliver, from operations in more than 40 countries.
We offer a career path and training that supports both your technical and consulting development. Our public and private sector clients operate across a range of industries and stakeholders that present significant environmental and social sustainability issues and opportunities.
The role provides the opportunity to work with the world’s leading organisations to help solve some of the most challenging sustainability issues that our clients face globally.
Some of our clients operate in fields such as Renewable Energy, Resources, Chemicals, Power, and Technology. Many face challenges as they look to reduce their GHG emissions, manage risks posed by climate change and move towards a circular economy.
We as an organisation support our clients with facing their challenges as they look to optimise their environmental, safety and social performance, while also maximising positive impact and navigating societal and economic sustainability challenges.
We help organisations with climate change and sustainability strategy, including climate risk assessment, scenario analysis and resilience strategy. We also support them in deriving meaning from complex datasets, including carbon emissions, to support compliance and strategic priorities.
If you are motivated and up for the challenge, we have vacancies in our Melbourne office.
Our Corporate Sustainability & Climate Change teams are looking for candidates who have interest in the following topics:
- Carbon emissions accounting, analytics and reporting
- Climate risk, resilience and adaptation
- Mandatory climate disclosures (e.g., AASB S2)
A career at ERM will provide you with:
- An entrepreneurial and performance driven culture; allowing you the ability to craft your future career.
- Immediate opportunities to work on large, complex, long-term projects which make impacts at the local, national, and global levels.
- Engagement with a strong global technical network enabling you to work and learn alongside leading industry professionals.
- A company with a solid reputation and strong client focus, working with clients in emerging and established markets creating sustainable plans to deliver growth.
Your first 12 months as an entry level employee will include:
- Access to a buddy who will guide you through life at ERM and support your development and career aspirations.
- Comprehensive onboarding program to ensure you have all the tools to hit the ground running as a consultant at ERM.
- Core consulting skills training (face-to-face and e-learning) to build your key capabilities.
- Getting straight to work – access to exciting projects and clients to put your skill into action!
Some key attributes for success:
- Relevant tertiary education in climate or environmental science
- Experience in (or demonstrated interest in) Australian climate policy and regulations through coursework, internships, research, or applied projects.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, with the ability to quickly get across new systems.
- Ability to multi-task, handling multiple project assignments with strict deadlines.
- Demonstrated analytical skills with excellent written and verbal communication.
- Ability to understand complex numerical information and use it to tell a story in reports. 
- Strong motivation and willingness to be flexible across different technical disciplines.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
- Ability to confidently engage and consult with internal and external stakeholders.
- Strong commitment to safety; ability to follow established health and safety protocols.
Highly desirable
- Prior consulting experience
- Experience with data visualisation tools (eg. PowerBI)
- Experience in Python or R
- Experience in GIS mapping tools
- Knowledge of climate risk assessments (physical and transition risks) and scenario analysis
- Familiarity with emissions accounting and modelling, including Australian emissions regulations/process (e.g. National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting (NGER) or Greenhouse Gas Protocol)
If you are interested in an outstanding opportunity to join ERM, please apply to this Job Advert where you will be asked to complete a short application form. 
We look forward to receiving your application!

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail and data accuracy.
- Demonstrated ability to convert qualitative ESG and sustainability insights into robust quantitative parameters.
- A proactive, self-driven professional comfortable working in an offshore, team-oriented environment.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- Passionate about sustainability and committed to ensuring that ESG factors are precisely priced in financial evaluations.
Key responsibilities

- ESG Translation: Transform qualitative ESG and sustainability concepts into quantifiable parameters that can be integrated within traditional valuation frameworks.

- Thought Leadership: Stay abreast of emerging trends, and market innovations in ESG and sustainability, ensuring that your models reflect the most current industry practices.

Bist du bereit, etwas zu bewirken?

Du berätst Kunden in Krisen- und Transformationsphasen, je nach Erfahrung, u.a. in den folgenden Bereichen:

What You Will Do:
The Senior Acquisition Consultant acts as a strategic advisor and team lead within the Department of State’s IT Acquisitions Office, overseeing approximately 20 enterprise software and hardware licensing agreements. This role manages the full federal acquisition lifecycle, supporting Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs) from requirements gathering through post-award management. The consultant leads a cross-functional team of 9 (analysts, SMEs, and program support staff) to develop comprehensive acquisition packages and ensures compliance with federal regulations and internal standards. The Senior Acquisition Consultant ensures acquisition packages meet FAR, State policy, Small Business requirements, and internal quality standards, while also supporting strategic planning, operational governance, financial tracking, and stakeholder communications across the Division.
Responsibilities include:
Acquisition Strategy & Package Development
- Support the development of acquisition package including Requests for Information (RFIs), Requests for Quotes (RFQs), Statements of Work (SOWs), Acquisition Plans (AP), Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs), Justification for Other than Full and Open Competition (JEFO/J&A), bid sheets, and supporting materials for federal IT enterprise agreements.
- Ensure compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Department of State Acquisition Manual (DOSAM), NASA Solutions for Enterprise-Wide Procurement (SEWP)/ General Services Administration (GSA) policies, small business requirements, and internal quality standards.
- Maintain a master acquisitions schedule that tracks expiring agreements, periods of performance, renewal windows, package timelines, and milestones across the enterprise portfolio.
- Develop acquisition strategies in collaboration with CORs across contract vehicles, including SEWP and GSA, and contract types, including Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP), Time-and-Materials (T&M), Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPAs), and Delivery Orders (DOs).
- Lead discussions with information technology software and hardware original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), resellers, and subject-matter experts regarding pricing, terms and conditions, catalog discounts, BPA structures, and acquisition strategies.
Program Office Support & Stakeholder Engagement
- Facilitate weekly or bimonthly meetings with CORs, Global Acquisitions representatives, OEMs, and resellers to manage portfolio activities and brief leadership on risks, decisions, and next steps.
- Coordinate with Chief Information Officer (CIO) offices, Legal, Office of Small and Disadvantaged Business Utilization (OSDBU), Finance, and customer bureaus to align requirements and streamline procurement activities.
- Prepare executive communications, talking points, whitepapers, and presentations for Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs) and Division leadership.
- Lead the design and implementation of innovative processes, operating models, and strategic initiatives that address complex procurement challenges and advance mission objectives.
- Oversee and support the analysts in managing office funding budgets, submitting funding requests, tracking and analyzing sales and operational reports, and coordinating reporting to other offices.
Team Leadership & Operational Support
- Oversee team operations, including coaching, workload management, and quality assurance.
- Support program leadership with weekly reports, burn-rate analyses, dashboards, deliverable trackers, and executive briefings.
- Collaborate with vehicle managers and Guidehouse leadership on daily operations, resource planning, progress reporting, and project financials.
- Mentor junior consultants and contribute to business development and integrated solution delivery.
 What You Will Need: 
- An ACTIVE and MAINTAINED "SECRET" Federal or DoD security clearance
- Bachelor's degree
- FIVE (5) years or more of experience leading or supporting multi-disciplinary teams or in management consulting
- Ability to work onsite in Washington, DC 2-3 days per week

- Prior experience with the Department of State
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent project/program management certification

- Strong risk identification, issue escalation, and problem-solving skills
- Excellent attention to detail, organizational, and prioritization skills
- Familiarity with core acquisition documentation
- In-depth knowledge of federal procurement processes and acquisition package requirements

jd_text:
Introduction

In this role you will join IBM Consulting via our world class Associate Program for university hires. As an Associate at IBM Consulting you will have the opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients worldwide. Our clients' technical and business needs are constantly evolving. We're hiring inspired, talented individuals, who believe no problem is too big to solve.

 We focus on your professional development through ongoing learning, mentorship, development of technical skills, and continuous personal growth, all grounded in a culture of coaching and career advancement. If you see yourself as someone who never stops learning and who wants to unleash your potential, the IBM Consulting Associates Program is for you.

 A career in IBM Consulting is rooted by long-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe.

 You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio; including Software and Red Hat.

 Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in ground breaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and development opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience.

Your role and responsibilities

You will be joining the Product & Experience Practice which sits within the Strategy & Transformation Service Line in IBM’s Consulting organisation in Australia. The team’s core purpose and capabilities are Business Strategy and Experience Design enabled by AI. We take on the biggest challenges facing businesses today and design the operating models, workflows, new products and services, technical architecture and AI assets to power employee and customer experiences of tomorrow.

As an entry level Experience Consultant, you will use human-centered design to solve business challenges through a human lens. We build empathy with the people we are designing new technology for and ensure we are meeting their needs, while delivering measurable business value. You will work alongside a diverse team of strategists and technologists to deliver real solutions for our clients, not just strategies.

The ideal candidate will bring a mindset which:

Thinks critically and can assess AI-generated outputs with sound judgement
Communicates clearly and can distil insights into simple, well-structured written and spoken ideas
Takes initiative, is self-starting, and approaches every task as an opportunity to learn
Brings both a design mindset and a strategic mindset to problem solving
Works well with others, contributes constructively in team settings, and helps build ideas collaboratively
Is comfortable working in ambiguity, knows when to ask questions, and knows when to investigate independently
Is curious, reflective, and open to learning
Is confident challenging ideas and providing thoughtful pushback when needed
Builds strong relationships and brings authenticity, interest and enthusiasm to the team
Approaches challenges with a positive, practical attitude
Demonstrates commitment, clear communication, care for others, a sense of community, and recognition of shared success




In your role you will be responsible for:

Design for AI 

Leveraging methods such as IBM Enterprise Design Thinking and IBM Design for AI
Familiarising yourself with service design principles to re-imagine human / agentic workflows
Develop insights from qualitive user research through observation and interview
You will be adept at drawing and communicating insights from quantitative research
Support Change Management and Experience Led Adoption of new technology
Developing design artefacts such as Persona, Service Blueprints, User Journeys
Facilitating and Supporting workshops to align stakeholders around new ways of working
Designing front-end user experience interactions
Rooting your methods and values in Ethical AI
Support senior strategists in designing new operating models for transformation which enable organisations to deliver human-agent workflows




AI for Design

Leverage AI tools and models to augment/automate research tasks (e.g. using AI to synthesis findings, create report structures)
Develop your own AI assistants to accelerate your work
Build high-fidelity and functional prototypes of front-end experiences or agents leveraging IBM’s tools such as Enterprise Advantage, IBM Bob and watsonx orchestrate
AI-assisted artefact creation, leveraging partner tools such as Figma and Figma Make (e.g. user journey and persona development)
Rapidly test and iterate designs with prototyping and user testing




The ideal candidate will have work experience or qualifications in the fields of business management, engineering and/or design. You will be deeply curious about artificial intelligence and its evolving impact on the world. You will be a core team member, keen to collaborate with a diverse, cross-functional team from business, technology and design who are aligned around a common goal.

Required education
Bachelor's Degree
Required technical and professional expertise
Be an Australian Citizen
Exceptional quantitative analysis skills and ability to derive recommendations informed by data and insights

keywords: Coaching, Consulting, DAS, Process Excellence, Benefits, Employee Assistance Programs
jd_text:
Über uns

	Slalom ist ein modernes Beratungsunternehmen, das sich auf Strategie, Technologie und IT-Transformation konzentriert. In acht Ländern und 49 Offices auf der ganzen Welt haben unsere Berater:innen die Möglichkeit, nach dem lokalen Ansatz schnell bei unseren Kunden zu sein und vor Ort zu helfen.

	Slalom wurde 2001 gegründet, hat seinen Hauptsitz in Seattle und ist organisch auf über 12.000 Mitarbeitende gewachsen. Slalom wurde acht Jahre in Folge von Fortune zu einem der 100 besten Arbeitgeber ernannt und wird regelmäßig von seinen Mitarbeitenden als bester Arbeitsplatz ausgezeichnet.

	Das sind deine täglichen Aufgaben
	* Als Consultant bei Slalom arbeitest Du mit Kunden daran, deren operative Herausforderungen zu verstehen, Verbesserungspotenziale zu identifizieren und nachhaltige Prozess- und Transformationsinitiativen umzusetzen
	* Du leitest Prozessinitiativen, führst Workshops durch, strukturierst komplexe Problemstellungen, definierst Zielbilder und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit Kunden Roadmaps für Prozessverbesserung und Umsetzungsstrategien
	* In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Technologie- und Plattformpartner übersetzt du Kundenbedürfnisse in überzeugende Use Cases und entwickelst wirkungsvolle Demos und Business Cases - gestützt auf Datenanalysen und Best Practices
	* Du begleitest Transformationsprogramme von der Analyse über die Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass strategische Ziele in konkrete Veränderungen von Prozessen, Organisationen und Arbeitsweisen übersetzt werden und misst die Wirksamkeit der Initiativen

	Das bringst du mit
	* Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Managementberatung, Prozessoptimierung, Operational Excellence oder digitalen Transformation
	* Du hast Erfahrung in der Analyse, Gestaltung und Verbesserung von End-to-End-Prozessen und verstehst die Zusammenhänge zwischen Prozessen, Organisation und Technologie
	* Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte strukturieren, überzeugende Business Cases entwickeln und diese adressatengerecht bis auf C-Level präsentieren
	* Ein solides Verständnis von Geschäftsprozessen in Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Shared Services
	* Du begeisterst dich für Themen wie Process Excellence, Automatisierung, Process Intelligence und KI-gestützte Transformation
	* Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Process Management, Process-Mining- und Process-Intelligence-Plattformen wie Celonis oder vergleichbaren Lösungen
	* Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse, BI-Tools, SQL oder Python sind ein Plus
	* Du verfügst über sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch (min. C1-Level)

	Deine Benefits
	* Hybrides Arbeiten im Home Office und in unseren modernen Offices in den Herzen von München, Düsseldorf oder Frankfurt am Main
	* Bis zu 30 Tage Arbeiten im Ausland nach Absprache jährlich möglich
	* 30 Tage Urlaub und die Möglichkeit des Erwerbs von bis zu zehn zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen pro Jahr
	* Eine monatliche individuelle Mobilitätspauschale für private Reisen mit der Bahn, Auto, Flugzeug, Rad, Tank- oder Werkstattkosten
	* Monatliche Smartphonepauschale von 100€ (Brutto) und freie Wahl deines Laptops (Apple oder HP)
	* Mit deiner Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM Wellpass hast du Zugang zu über 2.800 Sport-, Fitness- und Wellnesseinrichtungen sowie zu Apps und Home Workouts
	* Jährliches Budget von rund 300€ für dein Well-being. Ob Yoga, Fitnesskurs, Massage oder doch einer Spende für einen guten Zweck, du entscheidest
	* Wir kümmern uns um deine Zukunft - mit einer jährlichen Zahlung in unseren Pensionsfond (4% des Grundgehalts)
	* Zwei Impact Days für Volunteering in deiner Community pro Jahr
	* Du bist uns wichtig - neben Coaching und weiteren Unterstützungsprogrammen bieten wir umfangreiche Versicherungspläne für dich und deine Familie an
	* Regelmäßige Teamevents, Get together und Lunch & Learns mit den besten Kollegen:innen in unseren zentralen Offices

	Was uns ausmacht

	Unsere zehn „Slalom Core Values" sind ein fester Bestandteil von allem, was wir bei Slalom tun, und prägen unsere mitarbeiterzentrierte Kultur.

	Wir fördern die Vielfalt am Arbeitsplatz und stellen sicher, dass alle unsere Mitarbeitenden ihr Potenzial voll entfalten können, unabhängig von ihrem persönlichen, kulturellen und sozialen Background. Wir bauen Teams auf, die die Vielfalt der Communities widerspiegeln, für die wir arbeiten.

	Come as you are!

	Deshalb Slalom

	Obwohl Slalom schon seit 2001 ein globaler Player ist, befinden wir uns in einer für unsere Branche besonderen Ausgangslage und werden nach wie vor von unseren Gründern geführt.

	Dies bedeutet konkret, dass unsere Ziele nicht von externen Stakeholder:innen getrieben werden, sondern stets die Mitarbeitenden und unsere Kunden im Vordergrund stehen.

	Unser Ziel ist es, unsere Kunden mit allen nötigen Skills auszustatten, damit diese vollumfänglich hinter ihrer Reise in die Cloud stehen und nach dem erfolgreichen Abschluss der gemeinsamen Projekte diese Veränderung eigenständig und nachhaltig leben.

	Man könnte fast sagen: „wir kommen, um zu gehen".

	Milestones

	Mehr als 12.000 Slalomer:innen. Acht Länder. 45 Standorte. Und stetiges, schnelles Wachstum.

	In Deutschland haben wir unseren ersten Standort 2022 in München eröffnet, Düsseldorf und Frankfurt folgten in den Jahren 2023 und 2024. Das Team ist auf über 170 Mitarbeiter:innen angewachsen und wird sich auch in den nächsten Jahren stetig vergrößern.

	Wenn du dich angesprochen fühlst, freuen wir uns von dir zu hören!

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
summary:
The role involves applying AI tools to develop supply chain AI strategies, identify use cases, and create business and functional requirement documents.
Responsibilities include client engagement, data analysis, and supporting AI framework development.
Required skills encompass supply chain knowledge, AI concept familiarity, data synthesis, and strong communication, with preferred qualifications in advanced education and consulting experience.
qualifications_required: BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATIONS
1.5- 4years of experience (co-ops, or coursework) in supply chain management, operations, business analysis, or a related field.
Demonstrated functional understanding of at least one supply chain domain: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, or Fulfillment / Logistics.
Familiarity with core AI concepts — including Agentic AI fundamentals, AI use case identification, and AI reference architecture at a conceptual level.
Experience writing or contributing to structured business documents such as process maps, requirements documents, or functional specifications — in an academic or professional setting.
Demonstrated ability to work with and synthesize data into clear, structured insights or recommendations.
Experience using AI tools (e.g., GenAI platforms, AI-assisted research or productivity tools) in an academic or professional context.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
education: Bachelor Degree, Graduate Degree/PhD
keywords: AI & Data Operating Model, AI & Data Patterns & Technologies, AI & Data Processes, AI & Data Solution Architecture, AI & Data Strategy, AI Platform Strategy, Data Value Articulation, Enterprise Data Strategy, Responsible AI
jd_text:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients. 
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking. 
THE WORK 
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate: 
Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development 
- Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states. 
- Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context. 
- Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools. 
- Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives. 
Client Engagement & Advisory Support 
- Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions. 
- Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders. 
- Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams. 
- Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples. 
Data & AI Foundations 
- Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems. 
- Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations. 
- Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows. 
- Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.
BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATIONS 
- 1.5- 4years of experience (co-ops, or coursework) in supply chain management, operations, business analysis, or a related field. 
- Demonstrated functional understanding of at least one supply chain domain: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, or Fulfillment / Logistics. 
- Familiarity with core AI concepts — including Agentic AI fundamentals, AI use case identification, and AI reference architecture at a conceptual level. 
- Experience writing or contributing to structured business documents such as process maps, requirements documents, or functional specifications — in an academic or professional setting. 
- Demonstrated ability to work with and synthesize data into clear, structured insights or recommendations. 
- Experience using AI tools (e.g., GenAI platforms, AI-assisted research or productivity tools) in an academic or professional context. 
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical audiences. 
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 
- MBA or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline. 
- Coursework, certifications, or self-directed learning in AI, machine learning, or data platforms (e.g., cloud certifications, AI/ML specializations). 
- Exposure to consulting environments through internships, case competitions, or strategy project work — with demonstrated ability to structure problems and communicate recommendations. 
- Familiarity with enterprise planning or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP IBP, o9, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Oracle SCM) in an academic or professional context. 
- Participation in supply chain case competitions, AI hackathons, or strategy projects with measurable outcomes. 
- Working knowledge of data visualization or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL) applied in a supply chain or operations context. 
- Understanding of Prompt Engineering or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques — even at a foundational or experimental level.

The Work 
We are Technology Strategy and Transformation. We help organizations reinvent technology by aligning business strategy, digital foundations, and AI-driven innovation to unlock measurable enterprise value.
As a Junior Technology Strategy & Transformation Consultant, you will work alongside senior client stakeholders and C-suite leaders to solve complex business and technology challenges. You will help shape technology strategies, design future-ready digital architectures, accelerate AI adoption, and deliver transformation programs that create sustainable business outcomes. Working in high-performance teams, you will combine strategic thinking with analytical rigor to help clients make critical technology investment decisions, modernize their technology landscape, strengthen their digital core, and realize value from transformation initiatives. From technology strategy and enterprise architecture to AI-enabled operating models and transformation delivery, you will play a key role in helping clients stay ahead in an increasingly digital world. 
- Team you will serve as a trusted advisor to our clients: In Technology Strategy & Transformation, we articulate a compelling technology vision with industry expertise and context. You will work with C-level executives, digital marketers and/or IT managers. With your ~100 direct colleagues you are at the heart of the change, developing value case and operating model with disruptive technologies in short to medium engagements. As a TS&T junior consultant you will be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and the industry. We devise creative new digital strategies, implementation roadmaps and guide digital transformations based on trends, insights, data and our expertise. Our work always comes down to one thing: unlocking value and creating real, tangible impacts. 
- Processes you get energy from solving complex puzzles and working in teams: Our consultants in Digital Core are changing businesses every day using industry insights, knowledge and innovative ideas. Applying data-driven methods to analyze our clients’ strategic challenges, solving complex problems and helping them realize their business strategy through the right use of new technologies. Beside the work for our clients you will also be contributing to our practice and help the team grow and develop by e.g. participating and organizing events, creating points-of-view, and sharing your knowledge. 
- Technology Convey deep understanding of technology platforms and architecture at intersection of client's industry to (re)define the client’s technology stack. Realize value, advise, and execute medium to longer term technology transformations such as multi-year Cloud journeys with a clear industry focus, leveraging cloud partners and platforms to drive innovation, flexibility and agility across enterprise and build new businesses. 
- AI & Data: You will help clients unlock business value through AI and data. From shaping AI and data strategies to designing operating models and digital foundations, you will support organizations in becoming truly AI-driven enterprises. You will identify high-impact AI opportunities, help scale Generative AI and advanced analytics solutions, and embed data-driven decision-making into business processes and operations. By combining technology, business insight, and storytelling, you will help clients turn data into actionable intelligence and measurable outcomes.
With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs. 
Who we are - Accenture Digital Core 
In today’s world, business leaders want to rapidly and confidently reinvent to increase resilience, mitigate risk, and grow with sustainable value. That’s where Accenture Digital Core comes in. We bring together strategic visionaries, industry experts, practitioners from across every enterprise function, business intelligence professionals, change specialists, data and AI authorities, and many other specialized skills to co-create each client’s unique path to reinvention. You will be a trusted partner to business leaders, working with a diverse team of experts to deliver successful tech-enabled transformation and new kinds of value for your clients. Join our global network of people using the latest assets, platforms and partnerships to help bring ideas to life. 
Digital Core is one of seven services that make up one Accenture – the others are Cybersecurity, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, Talent, AI & Data, Industry & Process and Technology

- Strong personality, presentation, and communicative skills
- Fluent in Dutch and English - spoken and written
- Proven affinity with Digital/IT and Technology (e.g., in your hobbies or work experience)
Bonus points if you have
- Analyzing current issues and building a fact-based approach to developing and implementing client visions, road maps and governance to address today's business needs and support future growth 
- Strong desire to work in technology-driven business transformation and curiosity around opportunities and threats posed by innovation and industry convergence. 
- Developing a deep understanding of emerging technologies to feed value creation opportunities that often disrupt traditional industry value chains and challenge orthodoxies 
- Intellectual capacity to develop creative and breakthrough solutions 
- Communicating complex technology concepts easily towards clients and build lasting trusted relationships 
- Strong analytical skills, understanding of complex issues, the ability to quickly absorb information, conceptual and creative problem-solving excellence 
- First class written and verbal communication skills; the ability to articulate complex problems and solutions in a simple, logical and impactful manner. 
- Proven success in contributing to a team-oriented environment 
- Leadership qualities; the ability to easily establish trust-based relationships and gain valuable insights through collaboration and communication 
- Drive; enjoys a challenge, proven ability to adapt and remove obstacles to achieve results, determination and optimism 
- Multiple years of external consulting experience 
- 0-3 years of experience on a transformation program driving value realization, executive storytelling or managing measures of success 
- Certifications e.g., Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), SAFe, TOGAF, DAMA, ML, Data Science, Finops, TBM
What's in it for you?
Accenture is a global company with a world-class brand and reputation. Our people are Change Makers, and to support them as an employer, we make five promises:
- Work with flexibility, in a culture based on trust
- Embrace a sustainable growth mindset
- Live a human-led culture of Inclusion & Diversity by caring deeply for all our people.
- Lead and transform our clients with technology
- Connect with our global network of 700.000 colleagues.
These promises are reflected through our excellent employee benefits, including:
- Unlimited learning: access to thousands of free courses, classes and workshops.
- Flexible working hours (4x9) & work location
- ‘Do Good’ volunteering program
- 26 vacation days per year
- A laptop, iPhone, and home office setup allowance
- Accenture shares, annual bonus, collective health insurance scheme
- Social activities like Friday Drinks, sport events and parties.
What we believe
Accenture is an equal opportunity employer. Our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger and more equitable company for future generations to create positive, long-lasting change. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.
Our position as partner to many of the world’s leading businesses, organizations and governments affords us both an extraordinary opportunity and a tremendous responsibility to make a difference. Sustainability is one of our greatest responsibilities, which we embed into everything we do and for everyone we work with.
Accenture is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all.

Broaden your expertise, build your skillset

ERM is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
Our Consulting Delivery Hub (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
Why this role matters?
As a Socioeconomic consultant, you will support ERM’s global Impact Assessment teams by contributing social and human rights expertise to environmental and social assessments across a range of sectors and geographies. Working within the Capital Project Delivery Impact Assessment capability, you will help project teams identify social risks and impacts, apply international standards, and develop robust, practical recommendations for clients. This role is critical to ensuring the quality, consistency, and efficiency of social and human rights inputs across ERM’s global project portfolio.
What your impact is?
- Support the preparation of social and human rights inputs for environmental and social impact assessments, human rights assessments, due diligence reviews, and management plans.
- Contribute to the review and analysis of project documentation against international standards, including IFC Performance Standards, EBRD Performance Requirements, Equator Principles, and other relevant good international industry practice.
- Assist project teams in identifying social risks, human rights considerations, stakeholder engagement needs, and mitigation measures across different sectors and geographies.
- Help prepare clear, well-structured deliverables, including baseline summaries, impact assessment sections, stakeholder engagement materials, and action plans.
- Support consistent and efficient delivery across regions by working closely with senior consultants and technical specialists.
- Contribute to high-quality client outputs by applying strong research, analytical, writing, and organizational skills.
What will you bring?
- Academic background in social sciences, human rights, international development, sustainability, environmental/social management, law, political science, anthropology, sociology, or a related field.
- Initial experience or strong interest in social performance, human rights, impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, or responsible business practices.
- Understanding of international standards and frameworks relevant to social and human rights matters, such as IFC Performance Standards, EBRD Performance Requirements, Equator Principles, UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, and/or OECD guidance.
- Strong research, analytical, and written communication skills, with the ability to summarize complex information clearly and accurately.
- Ability to support multiple workstreams, manage priorities, and deliver quality outputs within agreed deadlines.
- Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn from senior technical specialists.
- Ability to work effectively with international and cross-functional teams.
- Ability to travel to project sites in remote locations.
- Fluency in English, plus French, Italian, or Spanish. Priority will be given to candidates with French and/or Italian language skills.
Preferred skills & competencies
- Exposure to international development finance institutions, lender requirements, or sustainability advisory work.
- Familiarity with labour and working conditions, community health and safety, land acquisition, indigenous peoples, cultural heritage.
- Experience working in consulting, international organizations, or development agencies.
- Ability to work in additional languages relevant to ERM’s international project portfolio.
Key responsibilities
- Support senior consultants in preparing social and human rights deliverables for international client projects.
- Conduct desk-based research, document reviews, and gap analyses against applicable international standards and client requirements.
- Assist in drafting sections of social and human rights assessments, stakeholder engagement plans, management plans, corrective action plans, and related technical outputs.
- Contribute to the identification of social risks, human rights impacts, affected stakeholders, vulnerable groups, and appropriate mitigation or management measures.
- Support the preparation of project materials, including interview guides, stakeholder mapping tools, meeting notes, data summaries, and presentation materials.
- Help maintain consistency, quality, and traceability across project documentation and deliverables.
- Collaborate with regional consultants, technical specialists, and CDH colleagues to support timely and efficient project delivery.
- Participate in internal learning, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement activities related to social performance and human rights consulting.

This is a hands‑on, high‑visibility role for individuals who thrive in fast‑moving deal environments and enjoy solving complex operational and technology challenges under pressure.
What You’ll Do
- Technology Due Diligence:
- 
- Evaluating architecture, infrastructure, product roadmap, cybersecurity posture, and technical debt.
- Identifying scalability constraints, single points of failure, and hidden cost drivers.
- Quantifying required investment (capex/opex) to support the growth plan.
- Value Creation & Tech Modernisation:
- 
- Identifying automation, cloud migration, and platform consolidation opportunities.
- Building investment cases for modernisation and cost optimisation.
- Assessing whether the tech team and processes can deliver the roadmap.
- Sign‑to‑Close:
- 
- Defining IT TSAs and separation requirements.
- Building Day 1 readiness plans for infrastructure, access, data, and security.
- Post‑Deal Integration / Separation:
- 
- Leading carve‑out IT builds, system migrations, or integration of platforms.
- Working directly with CTOs, CIOs, and engineering leads to deliver change.
How You’ll Grow
We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth. 
As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.
What You Will Need to Succeed
- Comfortable working with limited data, tight timelines, and ambiguous situations.
- Ability to translate technical and operational issues into clear commercial insights.
- A hands‑on mindset - willing to dig into data, processes, systems, and operations directly.
- Strong stakeholder management skills with both technical and non‑technical audiences.
Basic Qualifications
- Experience in technology consulting, IT due diligence, software engineering, product management, or IT transformation.
- Familiarity with modern tech stacks, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, and product roadmaps.
- Experience working with or advising PE‑backed businesses.
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting technology due diligence or post‑deal tech integration/separation is strongly preferred.

summary:

Responsibilities include leading SAP workstreams, demand forecasting, data migration, and client workshops.
Required skills include 3–10 years SAP experience, consulting exposure, strong communication, and supply chain expertise.
qualifications_required: Preferred Experience
3–10 years of experience in aftermarket / aftersales service operations, supply chain, or logistics, including exposure to SAP-based environments.
Hands-on experience in SAP SD and SAP EWM, gained through project delivery, support, or configuration work (SAP MM a plus; SAP Service Module experience a strong plus).
Exposure to, or techno-functional experience integrating, master data management, data migration, and inventory/warehouse processes with underlying SAP technology solutions.
Ability to support or lead client workshops, fit-gap analysis, documentation, and requirement gathering, scaled to level.
Experience contributing to business development, RFP responses, or opportunity shaping in a consulting context is a plus at the Consultant level.
Your experience counts:
Deep domain expertise in SAP based projects across industries
education: Bachelor Degree, Graduate Degree/PhD
keywords: Business Process Design, Change Management, Management Service, Research Analysis and Interpretation, Solution Architecture, Value Architecture & Realization
jd_text:
Role Description: 
We are looking for SAP-skilled professionals to join Accenture's Smart Aftersales Service practice, focused on Spare Parts Planning & Logistics Management – a priority growth capability within our Global Network Aftersales organization, where SAP expertise is the primary hiring driver. 
In this role, you will work on service parts planning, warehouse and logistics execution, order fulfillment, and master data management for aftersales clients across asset-intensive industries. You will collaborate with leadership and peers to deliver best-practice SAP-based supply chain and logistics solutions and contribute to the development of new assets and offerings for our global COE. 
Focus will be on applying SAP EWM, SAP SD, and SAP MM to spare parts segmentation, inventory optimization, warehouse operations, and order-to-cash processes, alongside master data management (MDM) and data migration for the aftersales value chain. SAP Service Module experience is a strong plus. 
Key Responsibilities include: 
- Deliver and/or lead SAP EWM, SD, and MM workstreams addressing inbound/outbound logistics, warehouse structure design, inventory management, order-to-cash processes, pricing, billing, and customer service for our clients across the globe. 
- Drive spare parts planning activities: demand forecasting, parts segmentation, inventory optimization, and fulfillment & logistics execution. 
- Lead or support data migration and harmonization activities (e.g., LSMW, SAP BODS, or equivalent tools), ensuring clean master data and a seamless transition to SAP S/4HANA. 
- Lead or participate in workshops, blueprinting, and fit-gap analysis to align SAP solutions with client-specific spare parts and logistics processes; own delivery quality against client KPIs. 
- Interface with client teams to gather requirements, document business processes, and lead or support solution walkthroughs and demos. 
- Work closely with technical teams (ABAP, Basis, Integration) to support end-to-end solution delivery. 
- Contribute to business development / RFP responses and opportunity shaping to expand Spare Parts Planning & Logistics offerings. 
- Build reusable assets, accelerators, and frameworks for spare parts planning, inventory management, and logistics; mentor junior team members as applicable.
Preferred Experience 
- 3–10 years of experience in aftermarket / aftersales service operations, supply chain, or logistics, including exposure to SAP-based environments. 
- Hands-on experience in SAP SD and SAP EWM, gained through project delivery, support, or configuration work (SAP MM a plus; SAP Service Module experience a strong plus). 
- Exposure to, or techno-functional experience integrating, master data management, data migration, and inventory/warehouse processes with underlying SAP technology solutions. 
- Ability to support or lead client workshops, fit-gap analysis, documentation, and requirement gathering, scaled to level. 
- Experience contributing to business development, RFP responses, or opportunity shaping in a consulting context is a plus at the Consultant level. 
Your experience counts: 
- Deep domain expertise in SAP based projects across industries 
- At least partial consulting experience as a MUST 
- Experience in some of the industries like: Industrial, Med-Tech, Oil & Gas, Life Sciences etc 
- Exceptionally organized 
- Detail oriented 
- Strong communication skills 
- Proactive and able to work independently 
- Sensitivity and skill at working with different cultures and styles 
- A highly motivated self-starter 
- Engineering background with MBA preferred

At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
What you’ll do
An opportunity has become available for a Consultant (equivalent to an Associate in banking/Big 4 terms) with excellent financial analysis and written communication skills to join our Corporate Finance team in London. Over the course of the past 5 years, we have defined a clear pathway for consultants looking to build a career in Corporate Finance with no prior experience required. The role will at times be demanding, but with that will also come significant reward, and the ability to accelerate quickly. You will be working on complex, time-sensitive engagements with very high stakes and with visibility to leadership from day one. Throughout our process, you will have the opportunity to speak to one of the several team members who joined the Corporate Finance and Capital Advisory team via this channel, to understand how we support you in forging your career and tailor your learning to facilitate individualised progression.
Corporate Finance is a key part of our practice and provides a range of specialist services including business disposals, accelerated M&A, acquisition advisory, management buy outs, equity and debt fund raising and valuations. The Corporate Finance team plays a key role in the firm’s sector initiatives and has particular expertise in Consumer Products, Tourism, Hospitality & Leisure and Industrials. Working with the firm’s broader client base, the corporate finance team advises on projects across all industries. The team provides advice to a range of stakeholders including corporates, management teams, private equity and hedge fund investors and lenders.
This opportunity would suit an enthusiastic and committed individual who combines strong accounting and financial skills with sound commercial judgement. The ability to work effectively as part of a team, to deliver high quality written output to tight deadlines and to have the confidence to challenge views and make recommendations are key requisite skills.
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Taking an active role in the execution of transactions.
- Assisting in the conduct of valuations of businesses using a variety of valuation methodologies such as comparable companies’ analysis, comparable transactions analysis and discounted cash flow.
- Reviewing and critically analysing financial information or projections and testing their veracity.
- Producing financial models.
- Assisting in the preparation of marketing materials and other documentation including pitches, management presentations and client reports.
- Supporting sector initiatives and other business development opportunities through conducting research and analysis.
- Assisting in Corporate Finance development projects, such as internal training and internal and external presentations.

- Previous Corporate Finance or due diligence experience is desirable but not essential.
- Possesses strong written and oral presentation skills, able to produce strong written outputs.
- Acquires and applies commercial and technical expertise.
- Able to work under pressure to meet challenging deadlines whilst being involved in a portfolio of projects.
- Demonstrates understanding of the importance of the risk management process.
- Focused on achieving success in individual and team projects and focused on self-development.
- Approachable and able to relate to people at all levels of the organisation.
- Is open-minded and agile with change.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
- Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
- Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday

jd_text:
About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
For details, please visit the company website: http://www.alvarezandmarsal.com
The Team
Alvarez and Marsal’s dedicated Consumer and Retail Group (CRG) professionals work with global CRG companies to provide independent analysis and end-to-end services across Corporate Transformation programs. Pulling from Alvarez & Marsal’s restructuring heritage, A&M’s Consumer and Retail Group combines the best of A&M’s bias toward action and practicality with deep industry experience as both consultants and operators.
We are a team of seasoned consultants and world-class operators who are truly passionate about the consumer and retail industries we serve. Through our deep experience in the industry, we first-hand witness the overwhelming disruptions and challenges facing consumer and retail companies. Alvarez & Marsal’s Corporate Transformation business is rapidly growing its GCC CRG team. To continue our success and to support our ambitious growth plans, we are currently looking for a Senior Associate to join our Gurgaon team.
This is a fantastic opportunity for you to use your outstanding business and analytical acumen, along with problem solving skills to become an integral part of our successful ‘hands-on’ team. As a valued member of the A&M Global
CRG team based in Gurgaon, you will be working on high-impact projects across A&M’s Global offices, and across the entire project life cycle, including conducting detailed market analysis, developing and executing growth strategy,implementing operational improvements, and driving financial performance enhancements to deliver measurable results for our clients.
How you will contribute?
As a Senior Associate, you will be working closely with Managers and Directors in a flat team structure. You will likely lead key work streams and benefit from constant exposure to the senior members of the team and client, and gain ‘on-the-job’ learning and development, leveraging on their substantial experience. Alongside, you will also be validating and executing on operations-focused problem solving and transformation activities on our clients’ projects. Additionally, you will also have the chance to contribute to business development activities, discuss and suggest the development of innovative offerings for our market and considerably nurture and enlarge your professional network as well.
Considering the pace of targeted growth, we are keen to find people who are entrepreneurial, driven by a passion to drive significant growth (people who can think in multiples of growth rather than percentages), are comfortable with ambiguity, will roll up the sleeves and be hands on to get things done and can be independent requiring limited cover.
The role will be initially based in Gurgaon. However, the person should be open to travel as and when needed and should be open to relocate to Mumbai or Bengaluru as the capability center scales and decide to relocate.
 Develop/ Deliver CRG solutions
• Actively contribute as a member of the CRG team to develop/ deliver solutions within the Consumer Products (Food & Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health & Wellness, Electronics etc.) and Retail domain (Grocery, Apparel, Department Stores/ General Merchandise, E-Commerce, B2B Retail etc.)
• Own medium to complex work-streams with support from supervisors
• Perform benchmarking across relevant CRG financial and operational metrics to identify areas of potential underperformance
• Develop expertise on various Consumer Products and Retail industry sub-sectors or clients to enhance overall project insights and strategies
• Work with different analytical tools with focus on building expertise in Tableau/ Power BI, Alteryx/ Python, Excel and PowerPoint
 Own stakeholder relationships
• Interpret, understand and break-down client data/ requirements and project goals across various scenarios and adapt to them
• Communicate information/ insights, and the impact of the analyses to the clients and internal team
• Manage important work streams and own key business processes to solve client problems
• Lead meetings with senior CRG clients, A&M Managing Directors, and third parties about your workstreams.
• Lead pitch preparation with senior staff and support business development and marketing efforts
 Prioritization and Growing A&M
• Identifying project needs and milestones to manage & accomplish assigned work by agreed deadlines
• Collaborate with team members to create and deliver client outputs
 Contribute to office management roles (such as trainings, marketing, recruitments etc.)
Qualifications
 Graduate from tier-1 college with 3-8 years of experience within a leading strategy/ analytics/ analytics Consulting/ operational Consulting house is preferable, with at-least 5 years of experience working with CRG clients
 Possess a good understanding of the Consumer Products and Retail industry, with keen insights into sector data and metrics across various areas, including but not limited to Digital, Brand Assessment, Pricing, Merchandising, General & Administrative, Supply Chain, Inventory Planning, Store Operations etc.
 Guide/ mentor Analysts and Associates during projects and business development work
 Excellent analytical, problem-solving, business acumen, writing, research and presentation-building skills; attention to detail and striving to produce zero-defect deliverables
 Excel modelling skills - structure data within Excel in a way to draw conclusions and support timely decision making with our clientsPowerPoint skills - preparation of defect-free, high-quality client presentations
 Experience working in tools such as Alteryx or Python for data analysis, and Power BI or Tableau for data visualization
 A strong team player and demonstrated ability to motivate team members
 Ability to prioritize - especially in highly pressured situations
 High integrity that is characterized by the ability to deliver messages even when they are difficult to hear
 Fact-based and analytical approach, solution-focused, action-oriented, determined to make a difference and not afraid to challenge the status-quo, self-starter with entrepreneurial flair
Your journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
Culture & Values
At Alvarez & Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.

Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.
