title: Banking Reinvention & Value Engineering Analyst
summary:
The role involves analyzing and mapping current banking processes, designing AI-enabled future operating models, translating business problems into AI use cases, and building business cases with ROI models.
Required skills include strong structured thinking, communication, fluency in Greek and English, and a degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or related fields.
Experience in consulting or banking and curiosity about AI are essential.
qualifications_required: Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field
1-2 years of experience in consulting, banking, transformation, business analysis or a comparable analytical role
Strong structured thinking; comfortable building and defending a quantitative model in Excel
Clear communicator who can turn analysis into a narrative a senior stakeholder will act on
Fluent written and spoken Greek and English
Curiosity about AI and the judgement to ask the right questions — you do not need to build models, but you do need to know what they can and cannot do
Comfortable with ambiguity and cross-functional environments
Exposure to banking domains, e.g. onboarding and KYC/KYB, lending, payments, custody
education: Bachelor Degree, Graduate Degree/PhD
keywords: AI & Data Strategy, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Banking, Data Science, Data Visualization, Industry Insight, Machine Learning (ML)
jd_text:
ARE YOU READY to decide what AI is actually worth building?
Every bank now has AI ambition. Very few can tell you which use case is worth funding, what the process has to look like for it to work, or whether the value ever arrived. That gap is the job.
As part of Accenture's AI & Data practice in Greece, you will join the team reinventing core banking domains with AI — working inside live engagements with systemic institutions, from client onboarding and KYB through lending, payments and servicing. You will sit between the business and the build: analysing how a process actually runs today, designing how it should run when an agent holds part of the decision, defining what gets built, and quantifying and tracking the value it delivers.
This is a role for people who want to understand the business, not only the technology.
What you'll do
- Analyse and map current-state banking processes — cycle time, effort, handoffs, rework, decision points — and distinguish the process as documented from the process as actually run
- Design future-state operating models for AI-enabled processes, including control points, exception paths and human-in-the-lead patterns
- Translate business problems into structured AI use cases, user stories and functional requirements, including acceptance criteria for probabilistic output
- Build business cases and ROI models: baselining, benefit quantification, phasing, sensitivity analysis
- Define KPIs and value tracking mechanisms, and build reporting that shows senior stakeholders where value is landing
- Contribute to discovery workshops with senior banking stakeholders — preparation, structured capture, synthesis and follow-up
- Act as a bridge between business and engineering teams through delivery
What we need
- Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field
- 1-2 years of experience in consulting, banking, transformation, business analysis or a comparable analytical role
- Strong structured thinking; comfortable building and defending a quantitative model in Excel
- Clear communicator who can turn analysis into a narrative a senior stakeholder will act on
- Fluent written and spoken Greek and English
- Curiosity about AI and the judgement to ask the right questions — you do not need to build models, but you do need to know what they can and cannot do
- Comfortable with ambiguity and cross-functional environments
Nice to have
- Exposure to banking domains, e.g. onboarding and KYC/KYB, lending, payments, custody
- Process mapping or business analysis experience
- Hands-on experience with GenAI tools, agents or prompt-based workflows
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
- Competitive salary and benefits, including but not limited to: life/health insurance, performance based bonuses, monthly vouchers, company car (depending on management level), flexible work arrangements, employee share purchase plan, TEA Accenture, parental leave, paid overtime (if needed) and various corporate discounts
- Access to enterprise AI development tooling and the internal community building with it
- Continuous hard and soft skills training & development through global platforms & local academy, including cloud certification paths (Azure, GCP)
- Career coaching and mentorship to help you manage your career and develop professionally
- Ongoing strengths and skills based evaluation process
- Various opportunities to develop your career across a spectrum of clients, industries and projects
- Diverse and inclusive culture
- Corporate citizenship initiatives (access to volunteering opportunities, charity work etc.)
- Under our Brain Regain initiative, extra relocation benefits may apply
To learn more about Accenture, and how you will be challenged and inspired from Day 1, please visit our website accenture.com/gr-en/.

jd_text:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

In this role, you'll work in one of our IBM Consulting FutureNow Centers, where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your role and responsibilities

As a Business Transformation Consultant specializing in Warehouse & Logistics, you will optimize and streamline warehouse and logistics operations to enhance productivity, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction. This role requires a deep understanding of supply chain and logistics principles, as well as strong analytical and communication skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Analyze Current Processes: Analyze existing warehouse and logistics operations to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement, applying knowledge of supply chain and logistics principles to inform recommendations.

• Implement Innovative Solutions: Develop and implement innovative solutions to optimize warehouse and logistics operations, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure successful transformation projects.

• Enhance Productivity and Customer Satisfaction: Deliver solutions that enhance productivity, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction, driving business growth and competitiveness.

• Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs and preferences, ensuring that solutions meet expectations and drive successful outcomes.

• Drive Transformation Projects: Support the development and implementation of transformation projects, applying analytical and communication skills to drive successful project outcomes.

Required education
Bachelor's Degree
Preferred education
Master's Degree
Required technical and professional expertise

• Supply Chain Principles Knowledge: Experience with supply chain and logistics principles, including analysis and application of these principles to inform operational improvements.

• Analytical Skills: Exposure to data analysis and interpretation, with the ability to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement in warehouse and logistics operations.

• Logistics Operations Understanding: Experience working with warehouse and logistics operations, including knowledge of processes and procedures.

• Communication Skills: Exposure to effective communication with stakeholders, including collaboration and presentation of recommendations and solutions.

• Transformation Project Experience: Experience with transformation projects, including development and implementation of innovative solutions to optimize operations.

Preferred technical and professional experience

• Supply Chain Optimization Techniques: Exposure to advanced supply chain optimization techniques, including modeling and simulation, to further enhance warehouse and logistics operations.

• Data Analysis Tools: Experience working with data analysis tools and software, such as Excel, SQL, or Tableau, to analyze and interpret complex data sets and inform operational improvements.

• Industry Benchmarking Knowledge: Exposure to industry benchmarking and best practices in warehouse and logistics operations, including knowledge of relevant regulations and standards.

Years of Experience:3 - 5
ABOUT BUSINESS UNIT
IBM Consulting is IBM’s consulting and global professional services business, with market leading capabilities in business and technology transformation. With deep expertise in many industries, we offer strategy, experience, technology, and operations services to many of the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Our people are focused on accelerating our clients’ businesses through the power of collaboration. We believe in the power of technology responsibly used to help people, partners and the planet.
YOUR LIFE @ IBM

In a world where technology never stands still, we understand that, dedication to our clients success, innovation that matters, and trust and personal responsibility in all our relationships, lives in what we do as IBMers as we strive to be the catalyst that makes the world work better.

Being an IBMer means you’ll be able to learn and develop yourself and your career, you’ll be encouraged to be courageous and experiment everyday, all whilst having continuous trust and support in an environment where everyone can thrive whatever their personal or professional background.

jd_text:
Le rôle
En tant que Consultant au sein de notre practice Rewards Data Intelligence (RDI), vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la gestion complète de projets d’enquêtes et de benchmarks de rémunération et d’analyses sur-mesure pour nos clients, tout en contribuant activement au développement de nos clients et à l’acquisition de nouveaux. Vous serez responsable de la conduite de projets de petite à moyenne envergure et interviendrez en soutien sur des projets plus complexes aux côtés de consultants seniors.
Votre mission couvrira l’ensemble du cycle des enquêtes et de la gestion des rémunérations : suivi d’un portefeuille de clients et support à l’acquisition de nouveaux clients, accompagnement et support de bout en bout sur l’ensemble du cycle annuel, formation à notre méthodologie de raccordement et accompagnement au raccordement des postes, collecte, analyse, revue et validation des raccordements et des données, analyse, validation et interprétation des résultats, analyse et restitution des tendances marché et recommandations stratégiques. Vous serez également amené(e) à devenir un interlocuteur de référence pour vos clients et vos collègues sur votre périmètre.
Votre mission couvrira également l’identification, le développement et la réalisation de missions de conseil sur des sujets divers : conseil en politiques de rémunération, conseil en gestion des emplois, des compétences et des carrières, conseil en équité et transparence salariale, etc.
Vos missions au fil de l’année
- Janvier à mars : Participer à l’élaboration des priorités opérationnelles de votre périmètre, organiser le cycle annuel avec vos clients, participer à la prospection de nouveaux clients, organiser les réunions de lancement individuelles et collectives des enquêtes de rémunération.
- Mars à juin : Former et accompagner vos clients dans leur participation aux enquêtes de rémunération et garantir une compréhension claire de notre méthodologie et de nos outils, piloter le statut de participation aux enquêtes pour vos clients,
- Juin à août : Analyser et valider les données reçues, assurer leur complétude, cohérence et précision, échanger avec vos clients pour ajuster ou compléter les informations, piloter le statut de validation des données pour vos clients.
- Août à décembre : Produire et interpréter les résultats, identifier les tendances marché, présenter vos analyses et constats lors de restitutions collectives et individuelles.
- Toute l’année : Intervention sur des projets de conseil en gestion des rémunérations, en gestion des emplois, des compétences et des carrières, en équité et transparence salariale, etc.
Pourquoi ce rôle est unique
- Une exposition directe à des clients prestigieux, en France et à l’international.
- La possibilité de construire des relations de long terme avec vos clients, tout en contribuant à leur stratégie de rémunération.
- Un rôle mêlant analyse de données, conseil stratégique et développement commercial, avec un fort degré d’autonomie.
- Un plan d’intégration complet et exhaustif et un environnement stimulant offrant des programmes de formation et de développement internationaux, et de réelles perspectives d’évolution.
- L’opportunité de devenir un référent interne et externe sur votre périmètre.
Ce poste combine expertise technique, sens du service client et dynamique commerciale, dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, offrant de réelles perspectives de développement professionnel au sein d’un groupe international leader sur son marché.
Les exigences
- Bac+5 (commerce, ingénierie, data, RH ou équivalent) et un minimum de 2 ans d’expérience en conseil, C&B ou analyse de données RH dans un environnement international et avec une forte exposition.
- Excellente maîtrise d’Excel et aisance avec la manipulation et l’interprétation de données complexes ; excellente maîtrise de PowerPoint et capacité à en tirer et illustrer des tendances et des recommandations claires ; maîtrise démontrée de l’utilisation des nouveaux outils d’intelligence artificielle (IA).
- Excellente communication en français et en anglais, sens du service client et aisance dans la présentation à des interlocuteurs de haut niveau.
- Capacité d’organisation et d’autonomie dans la gestion de projets et goût du challenge commercial
- Capacité à collaborer en tant que ressource pour l’équipe et mentor pour les nouveaux membres.
Nous recherchons des profils variés, des personnalités créatives et enthousiastes, avec de réelles qualités relationnelles pour lesquelles nous proposons des parcours de carrière dynamique.
Le processus de candidature
- Étape 1 : Candidature en ligne et examen par la recruteuse.
- Étape 2 : Entretien téléphonique avec la recruteuse.
- Étape 3 : Entretien présentiel ou visioconférence avec le directeur.
- Étape 4 : Entretien présentiel ou visioconférence avec les managers.
- Étape 5 : Offre et onboarding.
Nous nous engageons à offrir l’égalité des chances en matière d’emploi et à fournir des ajustements et aménagements pour les candidatures, les entretiens et les conditions de travail à tous les candidats. Si vous anticipez des obstacles, depuis le processus de candidature jusqu'à votre intégration chez WTW, veuillez envoyer un e-mail à : candidate.helpdesk@willistowerswatson.com.
Qui sommes-nous ?
Depuis plus de 100 ans, nous sommes un acteur majeur du conseil et du courtage, accompagnant nos clients PME, ETI, et grandes entreprises privées et publiques.
En rejoignant notre équipe, vous intégrerez un environnement stimulant où innovation et collaboration sont valorisées.
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
En nous rejoignant, vous allez bénéficier :
- D’un package de rémunération complet comprenant un salaire fixe, une rémunération variable, des primes et d'autres dispositifs d'épargne salariale.
- D’un rythme de télétravail flexible : jusqu'à 3 jours de télétravail possible par semaine. N'hésitez pas à en discuter avec votre recruteur.
- D’un pack de jours de congés : 25 jours de congés payés, auxquels s'ajoutent des RTT et d'autres avantages visant à garantir un équilibre optimal entre votre vie professionnelle et personnelle.
- D’une riche politique de mobilité interne au sein du groupe : WTW offre de nombreuses opportunités d'évolution, de mobilité nationale et internationale, ainsi que de développement des compétences tout au long de votre carrière.
- D’un vaste catalogue de formation : Proposant des formations en présentiel ainsi que sur des plateformes dédiées, nous offrons une variété de programmes tels que des formations en assurance, des formations commerciales, des sessions sur la prise de parole en public, l’efficacité professionnelle, les outils bureautiques et informatiques, et bien plus encore.
Pour plus d’informations, suivez-nous sur LinkedIn :
https://www.linkedin.com/company/wtwcorporate/mycompany/
WTW, employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances.

For more than 25 years, Guidehouse has been a proud and trusted partner to the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, supporting their mission of providing exceptional healthcare that improves the health and well-being of America's Veterans and their families. The Sustainability team within Arup’s Property London division works with a range of property clients to develop and deliver sustainability and carbon strategies for property development and refurbishment projects, both independently and as part of multi-disciplinary Arup teams. Increasingly the brief for these developments includes an aspiration to achieve Net Zero Carbon, and so energy performance is a key focus.
We are seeking an energy modelling consultant to join the growing energy modelling group within the sustainability team. This group provides some oversight of general IES modelling for Part L compliance, but is primarily focused on advanced energy modelling, including for TM54, NABERS and LEED, as well as early stage parametric modelling using tools such as Grasshopper. In addition to delivering more advanced energy modelling, this core team is responsible for training and skills development for engineers working in these areas.
The successful candidate for this role will be responsible for delivery of advanced energy modelling across a number of projects, including both undertaking modelling directly and guiding graduates and apprentices in the development of IES models. We are able to support the successful candidate through their Chartership journey.
The role will include: 
· Undertaking advanced energy modelling including for TM54, NABERS and bespoke project requirements, using a combination of IES-VE, including APACHE HVAC, spreadsheets and other advanced analytics tools as needed.
· Oversee junior engineers/modellers in the delivery of advanced energy modelling.
· Engage with project mechanical designers to ensure the energy model is a close representation of the design, and that the modelling outcomes inform the design development.
· Review/assist junior engineers in the delivery of Part L energy /compliance models.
· Contribute to the development of training resources and the delivery of advanced energy modelling training for our engineers.
· Contribute to the delivery of research focused on improving the tools, techniques and approaches we employ for advanced energy modelling.
· The role will be based in Central London but may involve some travelling nationally and internationally.

· At least 2 years using IES VE with ApacheHVAC for advanced modelling (TM54 or NABERS or LEED) as a major part of current or previous role.

· Experience/awareness of TM54 / BREEAM Ene01 / NABERS UK and/or LEED.
· Experience in Data Analysis using Excel.
· Developing understanding of building HVAC systems and controls.

· Able to work autonomously, stay focused and with attention to detail.
· Experience of working in multi-disciplinary teams.
· Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines.
· Excellent communication skills (both written and oral).

· Highly motivated and willing to take on new challenges.

· Experience with another package such as DesignBuilder or EDSL TAS is a bonus.
· Experience in parametric energy and thermal modelling using Grasshopper, Ladybug and Honeybee.

· Ability to work 3D/3D CAD software i.e. AutoCAD, Sketchup, Rhino and Revit etc.

Working across diverse advisory and audit/verification propositions  
Contributing to business development efforts when required

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

Consultant - Business & Investor Advisory
Shape a future with purpose at Arup in Milan
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.  
The Opportunity
The BIA team provides technical, commercial and strategic advice to financial investors, infrastructure operators, developers, public sector clients and international financial institutions across the infrastructure sector.
The successful candidate will support the delivery of a wide range of projects within the transport, telecommunications and social infrastructure sectors. Typical assignments include technical and commercial due diligence, asset reviews and strategic advisory services supporting investment, acquisition, financing and development decisions.
Working as part of multidisciplinary teams, you will contribute to the assessment of technical, operational, commercial and ESG aspects of infrastructure projects and portfolios, helping clients understand risks, opportunities and key value drivers.
The role offers an excellent opportunity to develop both technical and commercial skills while working alongside experienced advisors on high-profile infrastructure transactions and projects.
As Consultant at Arup, you will:
- Contribute to technical, commercial, and ESG due diligence assignments, supporting clients in evaluating projects and investment opportunities
- Research and analyse project information, reviewing data and documentation to identify key risks, opportunities, and investment considerations
- Prepare clear, high-quality client deliverables, including due diligence reports, presentations, and decision-making materials
- Engage with clients and project stakeholders through meetings, workshops, and site visits, contributing insights throughout the assignment
- Support business and team development by contributing to proposals, market research, sector knowledge, and continuous improvement initiatives
Does this role inspire you?
We're looking for someone who enjoys working with clients and multidisciplinary teams on diverse projects. We also value:
- Degree-qualified in Engineering or another relevant technical or infrastructure-related discipline
- 3–6 years’ professional experience in infrastructure advisory, consulting, project delivery, or technical and commercial due diligence
- Experience in at least one relevant infrastructure sector, such as transport, social infrastructure, telecommunications, digital infrastructure, or data centres
- Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to interpret complex technical and commercial information and translate findings into clear reports and presentations
- Fluent in Italian and English, with good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and the confidence to work effectively in multidisciplinary and client-facing teams

At Arup, we believe in rewarding our members for their contributions to our shared success. jd_text:
About the role:
The Energy Transition team’s purpose is to enable the development of an affordable, secure consumer centric, flexible and decarbonised global energy system. The team do this through taking a whole system thinking approach underpinned by innovation, impartiality, and robust evidence generation. We are focused on three key topics within the Energy Transition agenda: coal transition, grid development and renewable integration. 
The successful candidate will support our growth through developing new business and delivering energy transition projects that will deliver high quality and high impact advice to our Southeast Asia clients.
The ideal candidate is a passionate and motivated individual with energy market experience and business development and consulting skills. You will have a grasp of various electricity policies, market arrangements and regulatory frameworks and how these may evolve in the Southeast Asian region.
About us:
The Carbon Trust are global climate transition experts who deliver effective sector-wide and cross-sector solutions for our partners and the systems they operate to accelerate the transition towards a prosperous, resilient, low carbon future. For over 25 years we have joined the dots within sectors working alongside businesses, governments, public sector bodies, financial institutions and philanthropies, and across sectors from ICT, agriculture, food and drink to mining and metals, pharmaceuticals and chemicals, energy and offshore renewables around the world.
Main duties and responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will drive business development by proactively pursuing sales opportunities and responding to competitive tenders, including writing bids and proposals. You will develop and strengthen relationships with key clients in the low carbon energy sector, attend conferences and external meetings, and build connections with key stakeholders.
You will also work on client projects of varying complexity from inception through to completion. This includes problem-solving, managing analysis, research and quality assurance, working as part of project teams and the QA of subcontractors, and liaising with client contacts on day-to-day project matters.
You will maintain and grow a network of stakeholders, clients and partners across the low carbon energy sector, helping the Southeast Asia team meet its targets for revenue and business development activity in the Energy Transition sector by achieving your own targets. 
Your success will be reflected in positive client feedback, leading to greater and more favourable Carbon Trust brand recognition, particularly in its target client markets.
Key skills we are looking for:
Strong business development skills, the ability to build client and partner relationships and influence stakeholders and a proven ability in developing successful bids in the low carbon energy sector across a range of private and/or public sector clients in Southeast Asia
The ability to work effectively in a matrix team environment and to take initiative and deliver projects independently when required
Excellent project management and project delivery skills and proficiency with MS Excel, MS Word and MS PowerPoint
Fluent English speaker (C1/C2 ideally) as well as excellent communication skills (written and oral) and the ability to lead and run workshop sessions, present to small and large audiences and write high quality reports.
Qualifications and experience: 
Degree educated (or equivalent) 
Experience of working within one or more markets in Southeast Asia, ideally Malaysia, Philippines, Vietnam or Indonesia.  
Experience of working within energy transition and within technical sales
Experience in system modelling/whole system analysis is desirable
Experience of designing or delivering innovation projects and programmes is desirable
Salary & Benefits: 
We offer a competitive salary and a performance-based bonus. Our hours are 37.5 per week with 17 days paid annual leave rising to 18 after 1 full years’ service plus bank holidays and a generous pension scheme.
This role is based from our Singapore office, and at the Carbon Trust we offer flexible working, offering our employees the opportunity to work from home up to 3 days per week. 
Joining the Carbon Trust offers the opportunity to work alongside leading experts in the low-carbon field, contributing to innovative solutions for a more sustainable future. To apply, please visit our application page and submit your CV and cover letter.
We believe that when people feel respected and included, they can truly flourish. We’re committed to advancing equal opportunities and we’re dedicated to building a multifaceted, equitable and inclusive culture. If you don’t meet all the requirements but you have the skills and the experience, we would encourage you to apply and tell us why you are the right person for the job.
The application deadline is Sunday 16th August,  however, we may close the position early if we receive a high volume of applications. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Due to our hybrid and flexible working policies, some interviews and onboarding processes may be conducted via video conferencing.
At the Carbon Trust, we are guided by our core values: integrity, ambition, collaboration, and excellence.

jd_text:
Company Description
We are Analysys Mason, the award-winning specialist management consultancy for technology-intensive industries. We help clients make high stakes technology decisions with confidence, and we turn those decisions into action. Our sector expertise includes telecoms, digital infrastructure, software, IT services, space, defence, manufacturing and logistics. Since 1985 we have grown to 400+ professionals across 17 offices in 13 countries, and our experts have delivered work in more than 140 countries. We built our reputation on deep analytical insight and advanced economic modelling. Over more than four decades, Analysys Mason has evolved into a trusted adviser to businesses, investors and governments worldwide. Our experts deliver high-impact results and transformative change across our clients’ most critical strategic, regulatory, technology, transaction and transformation initiatives. Our vision is to be the leading authority and catalyst for digital change, connectivity and inclusion. We help businesses, governments and investors use technology to create a world that is more connected, competitive, sustainable and secure.

Job Description
Our early careers opportunities have a strong record of establishing early career foundations and developing well-rounded industry skills in our Associate Consultants. You will work on a diverse mix of international projects with the best-known brands in the industry, applying our deep domain expertise and methodology to solve complex business issues. You will attend our comprehensive training programme where you will learn essential consulting skills and industry knowledge through courses, networking and teamwork. After completing the training, you will join project teams and provide strategic advice and high-quality analysis on all aspects of strategy planning, transaction support, regulation and policy while continuing your professional development. Because our project teams are small, you will regularly get direct exposure to our world-class experts, not only in your office, but also across our global locations. You will receive hands-on mentoring from experienced members of the team, including our Partners. Our culture is collaborative and team-oriented, and you will have an impact on project delivery from an early stage, which will provide a steep learning curve and a structured career progression. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: conducting high-quality research offering quantitative and qualitative analysis of that research gathering and interpreting numerical data modelling and forecasting using various pieces of software presenting your main findings in written, graphical and live form contributing to proposal creation and client meetings collaborating with other teams across our global locations developing deep sector knowledge and more.

Qualifications
If you are a problem-solver who is critical and analytical in your approach, then this is the right job for you. You must have graduated by September 2027, or earlier, and you must have a degree from any academic background (including STEM, Humanities and others) from a top tier university. You must enjoy working with numbers as we are a quantitative data-driven business. As long as you are keen to learn about the sector, you do not need to have an industry background. As a matter of fact, many of our consultants only became experts after joining us. You must be fluent in English.

Additional Information
On top of an exciting opportunity, we offer many attractive benefits, including: annual bonus 25 days of annual leave employer pension contribution enhanced maternity leave enhanced family leave (paternity, adoption, shared, etc) private health and dental care mental wellbeing app flexible working your birthday off stepped career progression continuous training for professional and personal development career coaching programmes volunteering days Cycle-to-work scheme. We are proud to be an equal-opportunities employer and ensure fair work practices for all our employees, clients, candidates and other associated persons.

Job Description
Scaling our Commercial Excellence offering across technology intensive sectors is a crucial part of our growth strategy, as we aim to provide clients with comprehensive access to our full range of expert capabilities. As a Senior Consultant, you will play a key part in contributing to Analysys Mason’s global growth. You will work alongside our Commercial Excellence lead and a highly motivated team responsible for the growth of the practice, shaping and mentoring your career. You will work on complex and strategic projects for clients, partnering with them throughout the entire lifecycle. Acting as a bridge between Analysys Mason and our clients, you will support the delivery of value-led outcomes that meet our clients’ high standards and expectations. Our projects are diverse, and your focus could include pricing strategy, monetisation, revenue growth management, sales effectiveness, commercial operating model working alongside corporate and PE clients. You will also play a significant role in the coaching and mentoring of internal and client teams. Our culture is highly collaborative and team-oriented, and our people enjoy a hybrid work model, balancing client proximity, the convenience of remote work, while enjoying team spirit through work in our offices. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: Delivering a wide variety of international commercial excellence and transformation projects across technology intensive industries. Taking ownership of key project workstreams, from analysis through to recommendations. Engaging directly with client stakeholders on your workstream, presenting findings and helping clients address complex commercial challenges. Producing high-quality analysis and deliverables, and supporting the day-to-day development of junior colleagues. Contributing to thought leadership and intellectual capital in specialist topic areas, helping bring new insight to our clients. Supporting proposals, client meetings and business development activities to drive the continued growth of the practice.

Qualifications
We recognise and celebrate the fact that not everybody is the same, and we value the diversity of backgrounds and skillsets you will add to our team. Senior Consultants are critical members of our project teams, having a clear impact on the company growth and the development of our team of experts. This role is ideal for someone with an entrepreneurial spirit, seeking autonomy and the chance to make an impact on a growing team, on leading clients and on the market. This is why, as a minimum, you need: consulting experience delivering commercial excellence engagements for high-profile clients across technology intensive sectors such as TMT, Utilities, Industrials, Space and Satellite, Transport & Mobility, B2B Software or Consumer Tech project experience within pricing strategy, monetisation, revenue growth management, sales effectiveness or commercial operating model.
